question: Mu somo ly'Essomabiramu, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa kino eri Ekibiina ekisooka: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo." Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera obumanyirivu bw'abayizi?
answer_a: Bawe akapapula omwereere muyizi era omugambe okuzimba omuti gw'ekibala ky'asinga okwagala mu biseera by'omwaka bibiri.
answer_b: Waawa abaana ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo ebiraga emiti egy’engeri ez’enjawulo, oluvannyuma obasabe okugigawula mu miti egibala ebibala n’egitaliimu bibala.
answer_c: Ggwe omuyizi, kuliko olupapula olulina ebifaananyi by'emiti gy'ebibala. Buli muti guliiko ekiseera kyagwo eky'omwaka ekyolekeddwa. Ggwe kolela buli muti langi eyo etuukana n'ekiseera kyagwo ekyolekeddwa.
answer_d: Bawe abaana kaadi eziriko ebifaananyi by'emiti egy'enjawulo n'endala eziriko ebibala, oluvannyuma obasabe okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala ekigugwanira.

question: Ekibiina ky'abaana abato balaba ng'oluggya lujjudde ebimuli by'engeri n'ebiragala eby'enjawulo. Omusomesa akozesa omukisa guno okubakubiriza okunoonyereza ku nsonga eno okuyita mu mitendera gino: 1. Bakuŋŋaanya ebikoola by'ebimuli eby'enjawulo ebigudde mu luggya. 2. Bageraageranya enkula n'ebiragala by'ebikoola bye bakuŋŋaanyizza. 3. Baddamu ekibuuzo ky'omusomesa: "Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?" 4. Bateeka ebikoola mu kintu omuli amazzi. Kintu ki omusomesa ky'akubiriza abaana okukozesa mu kibuuzo ky'ababuuzizza mu kiseera ky'omulimu guno?
answer_a: Okukebereza
answer_b: Okwekenneenya okukulemberwa
answer_c: Okuteebereza ebinaavaamu
answer_d: Okugeraageranya ku bubaka

question: Omusomesa annyonnyola abaana ku nkyukakyuka y'embeera amazzi ze gayitamu. Mu mbeera zino wammanga, y'eriwa eyinza okulagibwa ng'ekyokulabirako ky'ekifulukwa (condensation)?
answer_a: Okugwa kw'omuzira ku mazzi g'omugga
answer_b: Enkyukakyuka y'omuzira okufuuka omukka olw'amaanyi g'omusana
answer_c: Okuwoola kw'amazzi g'ennyanja n'okufuuka kwayo omuyembe.
answer_d: Okufukirira amayinja agalekebwa ku mukka oguva mu kasulo k’amazzi agabuguma

question: Omusomesa alaga abaana ekifaananyi ekiraga enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’ekintu okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi. Kyaki erinnya ly’enkyukakyuka y’embeera omusomesa gy’ayagala okukolako?
answer_a: Enfuufu
answer_b: Okufuuyuka
answer_c: Okutulukuka
answer_d: Okutabika

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa ali mu kusomesa ebikwata ku nnyanja mu kitundu ekikwata ku Biramu n’Obutonde Bwebyetoolodde. Ku lw’ekyo, alaga vidiyo eraga ennyanja ng’eri mu mpewo ezikunta. Omu ku baana ababuuza lwaki empewo zikunta. Ku bino ebiddako, kiki omusomesa ky’asaanidde okwogerako ng’ensonga enkulu evaako empewo okukunta?
answer_a: Omuyaga
answer_b: Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi
answer_c: Enjawulo mu bwoki bw’omu bbanga
answer_d: Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'abaana abato, Ignacio ayanjula ku ky'ekyennyanja ekya clownfish eraannyonnyola bagenzi be nti ekika kino kifuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja okulwanyisa abalya ebyennyanja ebirala, ate era n'ettooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga ekyennyanja kigoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya. Omusomesa ayingirawo okubannyonnyola erinnya ly'ekika ky'enkolagana y'ebiramu ekyogeddwaako omwana. Nkola ki ey'enkolagana y'ebiramu omusomesa gy'asaanidde okwogerako mu kunnyonnyola kwe?
answer_a: Obuwangwa obw’okubeera awamu nga ekimu ku biramu kiganyulwa ate ekirala tekirina kye kifuna wadde okufiirwa.
answer_b: Amensalism kitegeeza omukwano wakati w'ebiriwo ebimu gye kiremesa ekirala so nga kyo tekirina kye kifiirwa.
answer_c: Obutalina ludda lwe bayimiriddeko
answer_d: Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu

question: Omusomesa akoze emirimu gino wammanga ku kitundu eky’okuyiga ekikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba: 1. Abayizi basoma era neekebejja ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba ey’omulembe n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu. 2. Abayizi bakola ku bizibu ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba n’ebintu ebigirimu, n’enteekateeka y’amasannyalaze, n’ennamba za kwantaamu. 3. Abayizi bakubaganya ebirowoozo mu bibinja ku biwandiiko ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu ndabika y’akaziba n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu nga balina ebifaananyi ebigyoleka (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Abayizi bakola okugeraageranya ku ndabika z’akaziba ez’enjawulo nga booleka ebipimo byazo ebikulu. Mu nteekateeka zino wammanga, engeri ki esinga okukubiriza okuyiga okutondekawo okutegeera okw’amaanyi ku ndabika y’akaziba?

Mu kukebera okw’enkomerero, omusomesa w’ebiramu akwataganya ekibuuzo kino: ‘Nkyukakyuka ki mu mubiri omukazi ze yandibadde nazo singa aweereddwa eddagala eriziyiza omulimu gwa GnRH? Zinnyonnyole.’ Kintu ki ku biragiro by’okukebera ekolebwako n’ekibuuzo kino?
answer_a: Omulimu gw'obuwangwa oguleeta enkyukakyuka mu buvubuka.
answer_b: Nnyonnyola engeri omutwe gw’obwongo gye gufugaamu omusinde gw’eb激素 eziva mu kitundu kya hypothalamus ku musinde gw’ebisa eggi n’omubiri gw’ennyingo.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’ekizadde ng’okozesa omutendera gw’obuwulukuto, okuva kw’eggimu, n’omutendera gwa luteal.
answer_d: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’omubiri gw’ekyenda nga bikwatagana n’okukyenga omusaayi, ekiseera eky’okukula, n’ekiseera eky’okukola ebintu.

question: Mu kitundu "Amaanyi G'amasannyalaze n'Emigugu gy'amasannyalaze" mu kibiina ekya kkumi na bibiri, omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika. Mu mbeera y'etteeka lya Ohm, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisaana okukozesebwa ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Abayizi bakola eggulaafu eraga amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agavaamu (current intensity) okusinzira ku voltisi mu sikito entuufu, nga balowooza nti obuzibu (resistance) bwa nkalakkalira.
answer_b: Abayizi bakola ggulaafu okuva mu mmeeza erimu ebipimo by'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agayita mu waya ku buli voltisi, oluvannyuma ne baginnyonnyola.
answer_c: Abayizi bakkaanya ku buzibu bw'ebintu ebikulembera amasannyalaze; buli omu aweebwa omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze n'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze nga bipimiddwa mu nkola.
answer_d: Abayizi baweebwa ebipimo by'amasannyalaze ebitali bifaanagana ne bakakasa, nga bayisaawo omugatte gw'amasannyalaze agasaliddwa ku buli kimu, oba ng'ekipimo ky'amasannyalaze ekyatuukirizibwa omukolezi kituufu.

question:
Kusooka, abayizi balina okuba nga bamanyi ebikwaata ku:
1. Empalirizo eziri mu atomu (atomic structure)
2. Enkyukakyuka z’enukiriya (nuclear reactions)
3. Okusattuluka kw’enukiriya (radioactive decay)
4. Ebika by’obusattuluzi (types of radiation) nga alufa, beta, ne gamma.
answer_a: Ensibika y'obusirikale bw'akaziba
answer_b: Ensibuko y'obutoffaali bw'ebintu
answer_c: Enkola y'obusengeke bw'amasannyalaze mu atomu
answer_d: Endabika y'ebipimo by'obuzito bw'akaziba k'ekintu

question: Kintu ki omuyizi ky’alina okuba ng’amanyi okusobola okukola ku musingi gwa VSEPR mu molekyu ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Omugatte gw'akanyigirizi ka dipole oguvaamu molekyu ez'enjawulo
answer_b: Eteeka lya duet ne octet ku nkola y'obuziba.
answer_c: Okukiikirira empandiika z'ebisengeke bya kemiko ebiri mu molekyuulu
answer_d: Akakodyo ka valence shell electron pair repulsion (VSEPR) nga kakozesebwa ku molekyu ez'enjawulo.

question: Mu kiseera ky’eklassi ku nkola enkulu eza obutaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko mu makolero, pulofeesa ayogera ku butaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko obutundibwa obuyitibwa akataffaali ka Downs, akasobozesa okufuna sodiyamu ow’ekyuma nga tuyita mu kuyabuluza omunnyo gwa sodiyamu kkalolayidi (NaCl) oguyengeddwa. Ku bino ebikulu wammanga, kiki ekisobola okulabwa mu kiseera akataffaali ka Downs we kakolera?
answer_a: Sodiyamu ey’ekyuma eterekebwa ku anode olw’okukendeeza kwa ayoni za sodiyamu
answer_b: Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa ku cathode okuyita mu oxidation ya chloride ions.
answer_c: Ayoni za kkalolayidi zigenda ku anode okwoksidizibwa
answer_d: Obutaffaali bwa sodium butambula okudda ku cathode olw'enkendeeza yaabwo.

question: Omusomesa akola ku mutindo gw'ebintu by'omubumbire bw'ensi n'abayizi be ab'ekinaana era ayagala okukozesa ekintu ekya bulijjo okulaga ebika by'ensi. Mu bintu bino wammanga, kiki ekisobola okukozesebwa okwanjula omutwe guno obulungi?
answer_a: Egga enjigge enfumbe.
answer_b: Akawo ka Russia akateekateekaamu obukawo obulala
answer_c: Ebibala ebirimu ebitundu
answer_d: Akapiira ak'ebbombo

question: Omusomesa yateekawo ekibuuzo kino mu kigezo ky'ebikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu: “Omubiri gutambula okusinziira ku kibalangulo kino: x=25+40t−5t2 (nga t ali mu sikonda ate x ali mu mita). Omubiri gunaaba gutambudde mita mmeka nga wayiseewo 5 s ne 6 s?” Bw’amaze okukebera eby’okuddamu, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi be tebakimanyi nti, okusinziira ku by’okuddamu byabwe, omubiri guba gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu, kubanga abasinga obungi baddamu nti omubiri gutambudde mita 100 mu sikonda 5 ate mita 85 mu sikonda 6. Ku ngeri eziri wammanga, engeri ki esinga okuba nga yaleetera abayizi abasinga obungi okuzibuwalirwa?
answer_a: Obuzibu obuli mu kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bibuuzo bya kinemaatika
answer_b: Obutabaawo kwetendeka mu kumanya ebintu ebirambiddwa n'okukozesa ennyingo ezisaana.
answer_c: Okuteebereza okutali kukkufu ku nsonga ezitali nnamba eziva mu bibuuzo bya kinemattika.
answer_d: Obunafu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kubala okusobola okwaŋŋanga okugonjoola ebizibu bya kinemattika

question: Okukola ku kigendererwa ky'okuyiga ekigamba "Okulaga engeri enjawulo mu bwoki bw'ekintu gy'ekwatagana n'okuweereza amasoboza ag'ebbugumu wakati w'ebintu eby'enjawulo," omusomesa alina abayizi be okukola ebikolwa bino nga bakozesa ebintu bibiri. 1. Okubala ebbugumu eriyimbibwa ekintu. 2. Okupima n'okugeraageranya obwoki bw'ebintu ebyo ebibiri. 3. Okutegeera olukalo lw'ebbugumu we lutambulira wakati w'ebintu ebyo ebibiri. 4. Okubala obusobozi bw'ebintu okuyimiriza ebbugumu. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olutalo olulaga omulandira ogutandikira ku birowoozo ebya bulijjo okudda ku birowoozo ebikalu ennyo?

Mu mutwe gw'ekitabo "Akaziba n'obusibe bwako," omusomesa ateesa omulimu ogugenderera abayizi be ab'omwaka ogw'okuna mu siniya: "Mukaanye ku makulu g'okuyiga obusibe bw'akaziba n'engeri tekinologiya gy'ayinza okubukozesaamu, nga mutunuulira nti, okuva ku ekyo ekigenda mu maaso mu busibe bw'akaziba obw'ebintu ebimu, kisoboka okufuna amasannyalaze n'okukulaakulanya tekinologiya aganyula abantu. Mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ngeri gye tuyinza okuzimbamu ebimera ebikozesa amaanyi ga nyukiriya mu ggwanga lyaffe okukola amasannyalaze." Mulimu ki omuyizi gw'ayinza okutuukako ng'akola omulimu oguteeseddwa?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola engeri atomu n’obusirikale bwamu gye bitegekeddwamu, ng’omanya enjawulo wakati w’ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebipimo byabyo, wamu n’amaanyi ag’omusingi agalimu.
answer_b: Okukulaakulanya mu bayizi okutegeera obutonde bw’okumanya okwa ssaayansi okw’obusirikale bw’akaziba n’omulimu gw’abasaayansi b’obusirikale bw’akaziba
answer_c: Okubuguumiriza abayizi okwagala okukwataganya okusoma ku nnyukiriyaasi y'akaziba n'enkola za tekinologiya n'ebintu ebibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_d: Kulakulanya mu bayizi obusobozi okunyonyola engeri amaanyi gye gaggibwa mu nnyuklia y'akaziba n'engeri amaanyi gano gye gasobola okukyusibwamu okufuuka amasannyalaze.

question: Omusomesa ayagala okukebera obusobozi bw'abayizi be okutegeka ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi okugenderera okumanya ebintu ebyeyambisibwa okuleetera ekintu okubuguma. Ku mirimu gino emikutudde, gumu ku gyo omusomesa gw'ayinza okukozesa okukebera obusobozi bw'omuyizi?
answer_a: Bakola okunoonyereza okuteekawo ebintu ebikozesebwa ebiyamba ekitu kibuukira ku mazzi, nga bateesa ebintu ebyetaagisa n'ebikozesebwa (ebikulukusi eby'enjawulo, ebintu eby'omutindo ogw'enjawulo, obuzito, n'enkula)
answer_b: Bakunganya ebipimo byebafunye okuva mukupima obukwafuwavu (densities) nokwetegereza engeri ebintu ebyenjawulo bwebiyimirira mumazzi ag'enjawulo, nga bakekkereza era nebamaliriza kubintu ebireetera ebintu okuyimirira mumazzi.
answer_c: Bakozesa obukakafu okuva mu kwetegereza engeri ebizimbulukuka bwe bibuutira mu bikulukusi eby’enjawulo n’okupima obukwafuwavu, nga bakozesa amagezi n’okuzimba ensonga ezinyweza okunnyonnyola kwabwe kwe basinziirako.
answer_d: Bakola ekirowoozo ekikeberebwa ekikwataganya okubuuka kw’ebintu ku nkyukakyuka ez’enjawulo, gamba ng’enkula, obukwafuwavu, n’obungi, nga bassaawo enkolagana entuufu wakati w’emiramu gy’ekisaayansi gino okuluŋŋamya enteekateeka yaabwe ey’okugezesa.

question: Mu birowoozo ebikyamu ebiri wammanga, kiki abayizi kye batera okuba nakyo ku bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi mu nkola ya sayansi w'amasoboza (thermodynamic processes)?
answer_a: Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.
answer_b: Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.
answer_c: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.
answer_d: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n’okusaasaanya amasoboza.

question:
Omusomesa ayagala ekibiina kye okumanya etteeka lya Hund erikwata ku bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo.
Kati ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku gyo gwe gwandisinze okulaga obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Okuwandiika endagiriro z'obusannyalaza ez'ensi yonna ez'atomi ez'enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera ey'ettaka.
answer_b: Okuwandiika empandiika enfunze eya elekitulooni ez’enjawulo mu atomu nga ziri mu mbeera ey’obutebenkevu.
answer_c: Okugeraageranya okusaasaanya kw'obusannyalaza mu dayagulaamu z'obusa okwetoloola akakungulu k'amasannyalaze agali ku ngulu mu atomu ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okukenenula endabika y’amasannyalaze ag’ebweru aga atomu ez’enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera eya bulijjo n’eya kusisimuka.

question: Mu kibiina eky’omunaana, mu somo ly’ebizimbamubiri, omusomesa alimu okusomesa ku buzimbe bw’akaziba. Okukakasa oba abayizi bategeera enjawulo wakati w’omuwendo gw’akaziba n’omuwendo gw’obuzito, abasaba okulaga omuwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu aluminiyamu ataliimu kyagi, nga balowooza nti omuwendo gw’obuzito bwayo guli 27 n’omuwendo gw’akaziba guli 13. Abayizi bangi balaga bino wammanga: Aluminiyamu erina elekitulooni 27, purotoni 13, ne nnyutulooni 14. Buzibu ki abayizi bwe balaga mu nkola yaabwe ey’okuyiga ku bikwata ku ebyo ebiri mu somo?
answer_a: Okukkiriza nti omuwendo gw’obusannyalaza bugendana n’omugatte gwa puletoni ne nnyutroni
answer_b: Nga tebategedde nti namba y'akaziba etambulira wamu n'omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze ag'ekika kya pozitiivu
answer_c: Okukkiriza nti namba y'obuzito etegereza omuwendo gwa chaji ennungi n'embi
answer_d: Nga tetumanyi nti namba y'obuzito etambulira wamu n'omugatte gw'obuntu obuli mu busibe

question: Omusomesa ategekera ekibiina ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogwokusatu mu siniya, ng'ekigendererwa kyabwe kiri "Okutegeera empewozeso eya sentripeta n'amaanyi ga sentripeta ng'ebireetera ekintu okutambula mu ngeri ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi". Mu kumanya okukulembedde kuno okukwata ku vekita kuki abayizi kwe bateekwa okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera amaanyi ga sentripeta bwe gakola ku ntambula y'omubiri mu ntambula ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi?
answer_a: Okuggyako vekita
answer_b: Omugatte gwa vekita ezigayamu
answer_c: Omugatte gwa 'dot' wakati wa vekita
answer_d: Okutondeesa vekita nga tukozesa ebipimo bya Katisiyaani

question: Mu ndowooza zino ez'abayizi, eruwa ekoma ku kuyiga omusingi gwa Archimedes?
answer_a: Okulowooza nti puleesa y’omu bbanga terina nnyinirizo ku puleesa ya haidirositatiika eweebwa ekikulukusi
answer_b: Okulowooza nti obuziba ekintu kye kiyimiriddemu mu mazzi kye kireetera amaanyi agakirwanyisa okuba amangi oba amatono.
answer_c: Okulowooza nti akanyigirizi akakolebwa ku kintu ekiri mu mazzi kisinziira ku buziiba we kali
answer_d: Okulowooza nti akanyigirizi ka haidirositetiiki akateekebwa ekikulukusi ku ntobo y'ekintu ekirikulukusirwamu kisinziira ku ndabika y'ekintu ekyo.

question:
Omusomesa omukulu mu ssomero lya siniya ayagala abayizi be okutegeera ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya obunene bw’ekitundu ky’obulamu bw’akaziba ka leediyoakitiivu.
Kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa okuyamba abayizi okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Laga omuwendo ogugenda gukendeera ogw'ekintu ekiralaadiyo nga gweyoleka mu ngeri y'omugereeso.
answer_b: Teebereza ku nkola y'obuwakiso bw'obusirikale bw'ekintu ekirungo ekya leediyo.
answer_c: Gattako amawulire okuva mu mmeeza y'ebipimo by'obuzito okukontana n'ebiseera ku nkyukakyuka y'ebintu eby'obusiraamu.
answer_d: Gegeenya okubulukuka kw'akaziba ka leediyoaktifu era okutegeera omuwendo gw'obusirikale obubulukuse.

question:
Omusomesa w’essomero lya siniya ey’omwaka ogusooka, mu somo ly’Ekigeranyo ky’Obuzito bw’Ebintu Ebikola Ekintu, yeetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw’abayizi ku bukulu bw’ebigeranyo by’obuzito bw’ebintu ebikola ekintu mu kikontaananyo ky’ekemyo ekikwatagana.

Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okuteesa okukakasa okuyiga okwatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Balaza omuwendo gw'ekigeranyo ky'akazimbulukusa wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu mu kikolwa.
answer_b: Balanguula obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu era okakase omukwano oguli wakati waabyo mu kubala.
answer_c: Zimba akabalansira akalaga obwenkanankana wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu, n'omuwendo gwabyo mu buli kikumi.
answer_d: Zimba akatebe akalaga omuganda oguli wakati wa mole, molekyu ne atomu, nga kisinziira ku bintu ebiri mu kikolwa ekyo.

question: Okukyuka kw’embeera y’ebintu kuki abaana abato ab’emyaka egyo gye basobola okulaba nga bakozesa omuko gw’ekyuma ekimulukuta?
answer_a: Okutabika
answer_c: Okukwata
answer_d: Enfuufu

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza okunnyonnyola omulimu gw’ebitundu by’obutoffaali mu butoffaali bwa kika kya eukaryotic, omusomesa agenda kwongera okunnyonnyola omulimu gwabyo ng’akozesa olugero olufaananya ebyuma n’ebitundu by’ekkolero ku butoffaali. Mu ngero zino omusomesa z’agenda okwogerako, eruwa ku zino ekwatagana ne cytoskeleton?
answer_a: Ekyuma ekikyusa ebintu ebiramu okubifuula amaanyi
answer_b: Enkola etegeka ebintu mu ngeri esobozesa ebintu okutereera mu kkolero
answer_c: Ekifo ekikulu ekikulukusa amawulire agakwata ku kikolero era ne kiragira ebikolebwa mu kyo
answer_d: Ekyuma ekissa akabonero ku bintu ebiggyibwa mu ফ্যাক্টরি

question: Mu kukebera okw’akamalirizo, omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omunaana ategese ekigendererwa kino: “Okunnyonnyola emisingi gy’ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu.” Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga nti abayizi batuuse ku kigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo.
answer_b: Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw’obungi bw’obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky’ekemiko.
answer_c: Zigikwataganya obuzito bw'ebintu ebiri mu kintu ekigatte n'obuzito bw'ekintu ekigatte kyonna.
answer_d: Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu.

question: Omusomesa ow’omwaka ogw’okuna mu siniya ateekateeka essomo erigendereddwa okuyamba abayizi okutegeera omugaso gw’okugemesa okw’ekikolimo mu by’obulamu bw’abantu bonna. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga ekiyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino okutambulira wamu n’endagaano y’ebiri mu syllabus ekwata ku kumanya okw’ekisaayansi?
answer_a: Ban ব্যাখ্যা করে Edward Jenner এর মত ক্লাসিক পরীক্ষার ফলাফলের উপর ভিত্তি করে টিকাকরণের প্রভাব।
answer_b: Banoonyereza, nga basinziira ku chati, obungi bw’endwadde ezimu ezisiigala era ne bateebereza ebireeta obungi obwo.
answer_c: Bageraageranya, nga basinziira ku chati, omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa ne bagukwataganya n'okusaanyizibwawo n'okuddamu okubalukawo kw'endwadde ezimu.
answer_d: Bazimba olukalala lw'ebikulu ebyatuukiddwaako mu nkola y'okugema, nga balaga omukono gw'abasaayansi abaatandikawo omulimu guno.

question: Mu kibiina ky’omwaka ogusooka mu siniya, abayizi beenyigira mu bikolwa ebikwaata ku ngeri ebifaananyi gye bikolebwamu mu ndabirwamu empanvu ne mu ndabirwamu enkovu. Mu kiseera ky’ekikolwa, omuyizi agolola omukono gwe waggulu n’agamba: "Mwalimu, sikyategeera njawulo eri wakati w’ebifaananyi ebituufu n’ebifaananyi ebyekiise, wadde lwaki biyitibwa bitya." Kulaga ki omusomesa kw’anaakozesa okutangaaza okutabuka kw’omuyizi, ng’addamu mu ngeri etegeerekeka era n’obwegendereza obukulu ku kibuzo kye?
answer_a: Laba ku ludda olumu n'olulala olw'ekijiiko. Ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga bw'oli ddala kiba kya bweru ate ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga kikyuse kiba kya nnamaddala.
answer_b: Olukijjukira nti ebifaananyi ebituufu bulijjo biba bikkiddwa waggulu okudda wansi, ate ng’ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bulijjo biba bitereevu.
answer_c: Ebifaananyi eby'obulimba birabika ng'ibikolebwa emabega w'endabirwamu, ate nga ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa mu maaso gaayo era bisobola okukubibwa ku lutimbe.
answer_d: Ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bikolebwa mu kifo eky’obulimba ekireetera emiryango gy’omusana okugaziwa, ate ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa okuyita mu kulagula emiryango gy’omusana egidda waggulu.

question: Omusomesa w’eky’omubiri ow’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya, mu mutwe gw’eky’ensengeka y’ebintu ebiri mu mugendo, agenda kukola okukebera okuzuula okumanya abayizi kwe balina ku ntambula y’ebintu ebigwa nga tebikoleddwako maanyi gonna. Okusinziira ku nsonga eyo, kwe kukola ki okukebera okunaasobozesa omusomesa okufuna obukakafu obusinga obulungi ku kumanya abayizi kwe balina edda ku mutwe ogwo?
answer_a: Mu kifo ky'ebweru, basuula ebintu eby'enjawulo waggulu era ne bageraageranya ebipimo bya buli kusula.
answer_b: Baddamu ebibuuzo ebigendereddwa okugeraageranya n'okusuubira obungi bw'ebiseera ebyetaagisa ebintu eby'enjawulo okugwa okuva waggulu obuwunzifu.
answer_c: Balaga mu kiifananyi obwolekera bw’amasoboza agaleetawo emisinde gy’akapiira k’omupiira ogw’ettaniisi nga kali mu bbanga okuva eri omuzannyi omu okudda eri omulala.
answer_d: Bakola maapu y'endowooza erimu ensonga z'ekibalangulo ezikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu ebigwa nga tebiriiko kiguzza.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri mu siniya, mu mutwe gw’ekyegayiriro ky’ebintu (Stereochemistry) n’engeri ebintu bwe bifaanana (Isomerism), ateekateeka essomo eririna ekigendererwa kino: “Okutegeera obukulu bw’endaga ya R oba S mu bintu ebikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo”. Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe gufaanagana n’okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo eri abayizi?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okufumiitiriza ku makulu g'ebyenfuna agali mu kukola eddagala eririna ebika bya R ne S.
answer_b: Buuza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bintu ebibaawo ku bulamu bw’omuntu ng’akozesa eddagala ebbiri eriri mu ngeri ya enantiomers.
answer_c: Buuza abayizi okugeraageranya obuwangwa bw’ebintu ebirungo obwa R ne S stereoisomer obw’ebintu ebikozesebwa ennyo 5, gamba nga, ibuprofen
answer_d: Baagalire abayizi okukozesa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog okusalawo endagakubbo ya R ne S eya kampawundi 5 ezikozesebwa ennyo, ng'ekyokulabirako, frukitoosi.

question: Mu kibiina kya P8, omusomesa akoze ekigezo ku atomu n’engeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu. Ebivaamu biraga nti omuwendo munene ogw’abayizi balowooza nti okukolebwa kwa keyoni (cations) kuleetebwawo atomu okwongerako oba “okufuna” polotooni (protons). Mulimu ki omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi be okubayamba okutegeera obulungi engeri keyoni gye zikolebwamu?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okutegeera omuwendo gwa puletoni, erikitulooni, ne nyutulooni eziri mu ayoni ez’enjawulo nga basinziira ku namba y’akaziba (Z) n’ennamba y’obuzito (A).
answer_b: Basabye abayizi okukola, awamu n'omusomesa, akatebe akalaga omuwendo gwa puletoni, eretulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu katayoni ne anayoni ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Saba abayizi okukola ekibalanguwa ekiraga engeri emiramwa gino gye gikwatagana: akaziba, olububi, obusannyalaza, obukontanyo,obutaffaali, ayoni, kayoni, n’ayoni enkyamu
answer_d: Bayizi balambike okugeraageranya engeri atomu ya sodium entaanu gy'efaanana n'engeri sodium bw'efaanana ng'ekyebulukusi, nga balowooza ku muwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nyutulooni eza buli emu.

question: Omusomesa, mu mwaka ogusooka ogw'essomero eya Secondary, mu mutwe gw'eky'obulamu ogw'Enkyukakyuka n'Obungi bw'ebiramu, akola omulimu n'abayizi be mwe balina okugeraageranya amino asidi ez'enjawulo eza puloteni C okuva mu nsolo ez'enjawulo n'okuteebereza enkolagana y'eby'obusika wakati waazo. Mu kiseera ky'okukola omulimu guno, omuyizi abuuza: “Bwe kiba nti ekisukkulumya ebiramu kwe kuba n'amawulire mu DNA yaabyo, mugaso ki ogw'okugeraageranya ennyiriri za amino asidi eza puloteni?”. Nga tutunuulidde omutendera gw'omuyizi, mu nnyonnyola zino omusomesa gy'awa, eyiwa ku kibuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okweyoleka mu biramu by’ebika eby’enjawulo. Amawulire agazimba ekizimbamubiri ago galondoolwa mu busirikale bw’obutonde (genes). N’olwekyo, okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo wakati w’obusirikale bw’obutonde obukola ekizimbamubiri n’olukalala lw’ebitundu by’ekizimbamubiri (amino acid sequences), enkolagana z’emyaka gy’obulamu wakati w’ebika bisobola okuteeberezebwa.
answer_b: Puloteni zikolebwa mu nnamba ennungi ey'obucaafu bw'amino acidi ekkodeddwa mu DNA. Bwe wabaawo enkyukakyuka mu kino, kyakukyusa endagiriro y'obucaafu bw'amino acidi obwa puloteni eyo. N'olwekyo, nga tutunuulidde omuwendo gw'obucaafu bw'amino acidi obwenjawulo obwa puloteni y'emu, omuntu ayinza okumanya engeri ebika eby'enjawulo gye bikwatagana mu nkulaakulana.
answer_c: Puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu kunnyonnyolwa kw’obubaka bwa RNA, obuva mu kuwandiika kwa jjiini. Puloteni eno esobola okulagibwa nga waliwo enkyukakyuka mu nkola y’obusirikale bw’amino asidi. N’olwekyo, nga tukozesa okunoonyereza ku nkola zino, enkolagana z’endabika y’ebiramu ez’enjawulo zisobola okuteekebwawo.
answer_d: Enkola y’obusirikale bw’ekikulukuto kya amino mu poloteyini esalibwawo enkola y’obubonero bwa codons obuba ku bubaka bwa RNA obukolebwa. Okuva buli codon lulinga enkola y’obusirikale busatu obwa nucleotides, bwe kikyusibwa, poloteyini erina enkola y’obusirikale bw’ekikulukuto kya amino eyawukana ku ya poloteyini eyasooka eyinza okufunika. N’olwekyo, okumanya omuwendo gw’ebikulukuto bya amino eby’enjawulo wakati w’ebika bibiri, omuntu ayinza okumanya nga bwe bikwatagana mu nkulaakulana.

question: Omusomesa omukulu mu S.2, mu kiseera ky’essomo ku DNA n’okukubisaamu obutaffaali, ategeka omulimu gw’okukolera ku kiruubirirwa kino: “Okutegeera engeri ebizimba bya kansa gye bikolebwa”. Bintu ki abayizi bye balina okuba nga bamaze okubimanya okusobola okukola ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Ebiseera by'omutendera gw'obulamu bw'akataffaali
answer_b: Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosis
answer_c: Ebifo omukutu gwe kikula ky'obutaffaali mwe guyita
answer_d: Ebika by'enkyukakyuka mu DNA ne mu chromosome

question: Omusomesa omutendeke ateekateeka essomo ly'ekibiina eky'okubiri ng'agenda kulambulula ekigendererwa kino: "Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale". Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku guleka abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Bawa ebyokulabirako by’obutomere obulaga nti obungi bw’amasoboza busigala nga bwe bwali.
answer_b: Bapima obuzito bw'emmotoka n'embiro emmotoka ze zaabadde nazo nga tezinnatomeragana n'embiro ze ziba nazo nga zimaze okutomeragana ku ttuleeki etalina bukakafu bwonna.
answer_c: Bano balaga omukwano wakati w'amaanyi agakozeseddwa, obudde bwe gamazeeko, n'empalirizo omubiri gwe gufuna mu layini emu.
answer_d: Balindiriza ekinavaamu okugong'ana wakati w'ebibiina by'ebiziyiza bibiri ebifanana nga biserebuka awatali kukwatagana.

question: Omusomesa omubisi omwaka ogusooka mu Ssekendulewa ateekateeka essomo n’ekigendererwa kino: “Okukozesa omutindo gw’amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka era ne kimenyeka bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri.” Ng’enkola y’okuyigiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino, omusomesa asalawo okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby’okusomesa ebyanguya okutegeera ebyo ebiri mu somo. Kiki ku bikozesebwa eby’okusomesa wammanga ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’omusomesa kino?
answer_a: Ekitundu ky’ekitabo ky’essomero ekinnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’endowooza y’obuntu n’ey’amayengo ku musana, n’obubaka buli emu bwe yawa ku misinde gy’omusana mu kubulukuka.
answer_b: Okutengejja okw’ekikompyuta okulaga mu bujjuvu engeri ebyoya by’omusaayi gw’amazzi gye bikosebwa olw’okukyusa n’okumenyeka kw’ekitangaala nga kikuba ekifo wakati w’ebintu bibiri
answer_c: Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza nga gukuba amazzi agali mu akuliyamu, we kiyinza okulabirwa nti ekitundu ku mutangaavu guddamu waggulu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kimenyeka ku mpalazo engeri engeri.
answer_d: Omulimu ogukolebwa ku kompyuta ogusobozesa omuyizi okulaba nga omutangaavu bwe gutumizibwa ku kintu ekigabanya ebintu bibiri eby’enjawulo, ekitundu kimu kiguddamu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kiyitamu nga buli kimu kirina engeli yakyo.

question: Omulimu gw'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri gwe gumu ku mirimu gyebakolako kwe "Kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola ebikwaata ku physicochemical properties z'ebintu ebirina obutonde bw'obutonde." Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe guleka omuntu okukebereza ekigendererwa ekyo waggulu?
answer_a: Bawe abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokulukusi bya haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo era obasabe okukekkereza oba ziri mu mbeera ya kalimagezi, amazzi oba ggaasi ku tempulikya y’omu kisenge.
answer_b: Baliriza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bubonero bw’okubulukuka kw’ebinywamaji bya kaboni eby’obuwanvu obwenjawulo, babitegeke mu mmeeza, era balambulule oba biri mu mbeera ya kikalu, kikulukusi, oba ggaasi ku tempulikya eya bulijjo.
answer_c: Weebale abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokirokaboni ze zibulira ku buwanvu bw'enziringanya ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu tebuleni era obasabe okunnyonnyola empisa okusinziira ku mikwanaganyo egireeteddwa molekyuulu.
answer_d: Weebale abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokola bwa haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo, ze balina okutegeka mu tebuleni okusinziira ku muwendo gwa kaboni mu nziring’anya oluvannyuma bannyonnyole engeri eno gy’ekolamu okusinziira ku bunene bw’enkolagana molekyu ze ziraga.

question: Mu kibiina kya P3, omusomesa alagira abayizi be okuddamu okusoma olunyiriri olumpi oluli ku lubaawo. Okusooka bakisoma kasirise, buli omu yekka, oluvannyuma bakisoma mu ddoboozi erigulumivu, nga bassaamu ekitiibwa ebiwummulo n’amaloboozi agasaanidde nga bwe biragibwa obubonero bw’empandiika. Kuyiga ki kwe kuyambibwa omulimu ogwo ogubaddewo?
answer_a: Kukulaakulanya obwangu mu kusoma
answer_b: Kukubiriza okutegeera by'osoma
answer_c: Kebera okumanya eddoboozi ly'ennimi
answer_d: Yanjula enkola z'ebikolwa ebitayogera.

question: Mu bibuuzo bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira okukozesebwa okukulaakulanya endowooza y'abayizi ku ngeri gye basoma mu kibinja nga basoma wamu mu kibiina?
answer_a: Oyinza otya okuzuula amakulu g'ebigambo by'otamanyi?
answer_b: Ekigendererwa ekikulu mu katundu ke tumaze okusoma kye ki?
answer_c: Omutwe ki gwe wandiwadde omutwe guno gwe tusoma?
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekyo kye tumaze okusoma gwe gwa ki?

question: Mu kusoma ebiwandiiko ebinnyonnyola, abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okuna mu pulayimale balina obuzibu mu kwawulawo omutwe gw'ekigambo n'ekiteeso ekikulu. Mu nnyonnyola zino wammanga, ennyonnyola ki ennyonnyola enjawulo eno mu butuufu?
answer_a: Omutwe gw’ekigambo gwe gulinga ennyanjula y’ekyawandiiko era gukubibwawo nga tubuuza “Kiki kye twagala okwolesa mu kyawandiiko?” ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye biringana n’amalirizo g’omutwe.
answer_b: Omulamwa gwe tuteekateeka okumaliriza ku ki ekyogerwa mu mutwe, ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye bimu ku byo ebiyamba okutuuka ku malirizo ago.
answer_c: Omutwe gw'ekigambo kye kigenda okwogerwako era kizuulwa kubanga kiba mu mutwe gw'ekitabo, ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kibeera mu katundu akasooka.
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekigambo guddamu ekibuuzo “Ekiwandiiko kino kifa ku ki?” ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kigwa mu mugatte gw'ekyo ekigambiddwa ku mutwe ogwo.

question: Valentina ali mu kibiina kya PreK era akulakulanye mu bukugu bwe obw’okuwandiika, ng’asobola okugatta obutonnyeze okusiiga ennyiriri ez’enjawulo, n’okukuuma obutayosa mu makubo. Okusinziira ku mitendera gy’okutandika okuyiga okuwandiika, bukugu ki obuddako omuwala ono bw’asaanidde okutendeka, ng’assa ekitiibwa mu mutindo gw’obuzibu bwabyo?
answer_a: Koppa vawule mu ndaga eyawandiikidwa mu mukono ogwegattika.
answer_b: Balambulula ebifaananyi n'enkula ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Loba empandiika ezitaliimu kifaananyi ekigendereke kyonna ez’obunene obw’enjawulo.
answer_d: Londa amakubo ng'ogoberera obutindo n'enzigotta.

question: Omusomesa agenda kutandika omutwe ogw'okusoma okutegeera ebitabo by'ekikomediya. Nga tannatandika, agenda kukola akeesso akamuyamba okumanya obumanyirivu bw'abayizi, era ekigendererwa ky'akeesso kano kwe: "Okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebigendererwa mu bitabo by'ekikomediya." Kiki ekikulu ekyetaagisa okuba mu kkeesso lino?
answer_a: Ebyafaayo by'emizannyo egy'ekivulu
answer_b: Enkola ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru ey’emizannyo gy’ekigambo
answer_c: Enjawulo enkulu wakati w'emizannyo egy'ekiseko n'emizannyo egy'ennaku
answer_d: Enkola z’okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko eby’obuwangwa

question: Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসરૂম muno wammanga: Mu ক্লাস ze eziddako, omusomesa w’olungereza alina okusomesa akabonero kano ak’okuyiga: “Okuddamu okwogera ebiri mu kiwandiiko mu ngeri энжавуло.” Akabonero kano ak’okuyiga kakwatagana na kirubirirwa ky’okuyiga ki ku bino ebiddako?
answer_a: Londa ebigambo ebimu ebiri mu muwandiiko
answer_b: Fumiitiriza okuva mu biwandiiko okumanya ebintu ebikulu oba ebitono ebikulu ebiwandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Laga ekirowoozo ekikulu mu mawulire agawandiike obuwandiike obugazi oba obutongole.
answer_d: Laga okutegeera amawulire agawandiike obuntuntunu oba agawandiike mu bujjuvu.

question:
Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসিকroom eno wammanga:
Omusomesa w’olungereza asabye abayizi be okusoma ebiwandiiko mu bwangu ate oluvannyuma okuddamu ekibuuzo kino: “Ekirowoozo ekikulu mu biwandiiko kye ki?” Mu nkola z’okusoma zino wammanga, musomesa alina nkaayiira ki gy’asaba abayizi be okukozesa?
answer_a: Okukenenula
answer_b: Okutemera
answer_c: Okusoma okw'obwegendereza
answer_d: Okusoma okw'amaanyi

question:
Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসিকুমু eno:
Mme. Parada, omusomesa w’Olungereza, abadde akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku ngeri y’okukwatamu ebigambo eby’enjawulo n’ebigambo ebikwata ku bikolwa bya bulijjo okumala wiiki bbiri eziyise okusobola okubaleetera okubyogera mu kamwa. Leero awuliriza lipooti z’abayizi ze boogera ku “Ebikolwa byabwe ebya bulijjo”. Wadde nga Mme. Parada akimanyi nti abayizi bangi bakoze ensobi mu mpandiika y’ebigambo mu kiseera kye babadde boogera, tabalongoosa era abaleka ne bagenda mu maaso n’ebyogerwa byabwe.
Okusinziira ku mbeera y’omu ক্লাসিকুমু egambiddwa waggulu, kiki ku bino wammanga ekiyinza okuba ensonga esinga obulungi okuwagira endowooza y’omusomesa ono?
answer_a: Omusomesa atwala ensobi ng’ekitundu ku ngeri y’okuyiga.
answer_b: Omusomesa awagira endowooza nti ensobi za bulijjo era teziyinzika kwewalika.
answer_c: Omusomesa alowooza nti okukolola kiyinza okuleetawo obutategeeragana mu bayizi be.
answer_d: Omusomesa alowooza nti abayizi balina okwogera ku mutwe gw'ekigambo, kale obutuufu si kye kisinga obukulu.

question: Ssinga otunuulira embeera eri mu ssomero eno: Emu ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga olungereza mu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu kwe "kwogera omuntu ky’alowooza nga akozesa obwogezi obumala eddakiika nga ssatu n’emboozi ennyimpimpi nga mulimu okukyusa ebirowoozo emirundi nga kkumi na mukaaga nga mw’otadde n’emikolo gy’emyaka egiyise n’omukolo gw’okutegeeza ekyo abalala kye boogedde, ng’olaga ekigendererwa". Bwe baba bakebera obuwanguzi bw’ekigendererwa kino, abayizi mu mutendera guno basabwa kwanjula emboozi mu bubinja obw’abantu bana nga balina okukozesa ebigambo ebimu ebiweereddwa, n’enjogera era nga balina ekigendererwa ekimu. Buli bbinja lwe limaliriza okwanjula emboozi yaabwe, Mwami Fuentes, omusomesa waabwe ow’olungereza, ayimiriza emboozi okukola obulongoofu ku nsobi z’ebbalangulo oba enjatula abayizi ze bakoze. Okusinziira ku ndagiriro ezikwatagana n’okukebera eziragiddwa ku programu y’okusoma ey’omutendera guno, lwaki Mwami Fuentes aba takwatagana nazo?
answer_a: Olwokubanga enzirukanya z'ebigendererwa by'okuyiga ez'omulembe guno ziraga nti okwogera kulungi okukulaakulana mu mbeera ey'obuteefu.
answer_b: Olw’okuba okusalako omuyizi ebigambo ng’akyayogera okumukolako obubi ku ngeri gy’alimu okwogera.
answer_c: Okuva abayizi abava ebweru be bakola ensobi mu bigambo bye boogera era nga tebasobola kuziggwayo ddala.
answer_d: Olwokubanga okukola ensobi kitundu ku buli mukutu ogw'okuyiga era abayizi balina okuweebwa omukisa okwogera kyebalowooza nga tebatya.

question: Omusomesa mu somo erikwata ku nzirukanya y'ennimi awa abayizi be omutwe gw'amawulire guno: Ndi mukakafu nti Cristiano Ronaldo agenda kuwummulira mu Madrid. Kika ki kya kigambo ekiri wansi ekirina okukimanyibwa abayizi mu mutwe gw'amawulire oguli waggulu?
answer_a: Ekigerekera ekikola ekintu
answer_b: Ekigambo ekiggumiza erinnya
answer_c: Ekigattiro ekiggumiza embeera
answer_d: Ekigambo ekiggattiddwa ku kigambululo ekiraga obudde, ekifo, oba engeri.

question: Mu kitundu ky’ennyimba, omusomesa aleeta eri abayizi be oluyimba olulondoola: Mu nnaku ezo nnali emyaka amakumi abiri era nnali mulalu. Nnali mbuze eggwanga naye nga nfunye ekirooto. Era bwe nnali nina ekirooto ekyo ebisigala tebyali bya mugaso. Wadde okukola wadde okusaba wadde okusoma ku makya okumpi n’embwa ez’omukwano. Era ekirooto kyabeeranga mu bbanga ly’omwoyo gwange. Ekisenge eky’omuti, mu bisiikirize, mu kimu ku mawuggwe g’obutonde bw’ensi. Era oluusi nnakyukanga munda yange ne nkyalira ekirooto: ekibumbe eky’olubeerera mu birowoozo ebikulukuta, envunza enjeru eyeewetamu mu kwagala. Okwagala okutaliiko kifaananyi. Ekirooto munda mu kirooto ekirala. Era ekirooto ekibi kyambuulira: ojja kukula. Ojja kuleka emabega ebifaananyi eby’obulumi n’ekkubo erizibu era ojja kwerabira. Naye mu nnaku ezo okukula kwandibadde musango. Ndi wano, nnagamba, n’embwa ez’omukwano era wano nja kusigala. Embwa ez’omukwano, Roberto Bolaño. Kiki ekireetera omuyimbi okuyimba abayizi kye balina okutegeera mu luyimba oluyimbiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Omukwano omutaliimu bwagezi ogw'omuwandiisi w'ebitontome
answer_b: Obutaba na mizizi bw'omuwandiisi w'ebitontome
answer_c: Ekirooto ky'omuvubi omuto
answer_d: Emikwano gy'omuvubi omuvubuka

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri aleeta ebiwandiiko bino eri abayizi be okukola ku kutegeera byebasoma: "Waaliwo ekifo ekipppe era eky’ekizikiza. Akawungeezi ak’obunafu kaali kayingidde mu bisenge, era ebiyitiro ebiwanvu byaleetanga eddoboozi ly’ebigere byonna okudda nga teggwaawo." Oluvannyuma lw’okusoma, abayizi abasinga obungi tebaasobola kunnyonnyola kifo ekyo mu bigambo byabwe. Lwaki ebiwandiiko ebyo waggulu tebisaanira kukozesebwa kukola ku kutegeera ebiwandiiko n’abayizi b’ekibiina eky’okubiri?
answer_a: Lwakuba kirimu sentensi ezirina omuko gwazo ogutegeerekeka obutegeerekeka.
answer_b: Kubanga kirimu obunyiriri obutali bukulu.
answer_c: Olwekubanga mulimu ebigambo ebizibu.
answer_d: Kubanga bwe bunnyonnyofu bw’ekifo ekitayogerwako mannya.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okuna asaba abayizi okuleeta ebyokulabirako by’enfuumo okuva awaka. Ekklaasi bw’etandika, annyonnyola nti enfumo bububonero obumpi obusobola okukozesa oluyimba era obukiikirira ekitundu ku magezi agaliwo oba amagezi agabantu bonna. Abayizi baleeta enfumo ze baleese, nga muno mulimu: "Embuzi eweereddwa tekebera mannyo", "Mu nnyumba y’omuweesi, akambe k’omuti", era "Akanyonyi akali mu mukono kasinga ebikumi ebiwanuka." Oluvannyuma, mu bibiri bibiri, abayizi bakola kaadi z’enfumo ze baleese okuva awaka, banyumya ku makulu ga buli emu, era oluvannyuma, buli kibiri kinnyonnyola enfumo zaabwe eri ekklaasi. Kintu ki ku kusoma omusomesa ky’asinga okukwatako mu mulimu guno?
answer_a: Okunnyonnyola engeri ennimi ez'ekifaananyi gye zikozesebwa
answer_b: Omukwano wakati w'ekiwandiiko n'obulamu obwa bulijjo
answer_c: Okwekenneenya embeera ezivaamu engero
answer_d: Okutegeera ebikolebwa eby'omuwendo ennyo mu nnono y'abantu

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa atandika n'ekibiina kye eky'abaana abato akadde ak'okusoma olugero olwa bulijjo, era ku lw'ekyo awandiika ku lubaawo erinnya ly'olugero lwe bagenda okusoma: "Ekkungulu erisirusiru". Oluvannyuma, abasoomooza okunoonya olugero lwe bagenda okusoma. Josefina agolola omukono gwe waggulu n'agamba: "Ndisobola okukikola," era mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka atandika okusoma mpola, ng'addamu okusoma emirundi ebiri, okutuusa lw'agamba nti: "Tugenda kusoma Ekkungulu Erisirusiru." Josefina ali mu mutendera gwaki ogw'enkola y'okusoma?
answer_a: Ekyapaango ky'ennukuta
answer_b: Nga tannaba kuwandiika bigambo mu nkula yabyo
answer_c: Olunnukuta
answer_d: Ennyingo z'ebigambo

question: Omusomesa atunuulidde omuwala mu ssomero ly'abaana abato, bw'abadde awandiika erinnya lye, aliwandiise mu ngeri ekyamu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu kifaananyi kino: Nga tutunuulidde engeri omuwala gy'awandiiseemu, kiti kiki ekyetaaga okukolebwako naye okuyamba okuyiga kwe?
answer_a: Okulaba n'okutegeera ebintu
answer_b: Obukugu bw’omubiri obw’ekimu okuliko omulala
answer_c: Okutegeera obusangiro
answer_d: Entabaganya y'amaaso n'ebikolwa

question: Mu kibiina eky’omukaaga, omusomesa w’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya agenda kutandika omutwe guno: "Okuwandiika obutuufu, nga tukozesa amateeka g’akabonero akawunzifu." Kiki abayizi kye balina okumanya okusobola okutegeera akabonero akawunzifu?
answer_a: Omulamwa gw'ekiwummulo
answer_b: Omulamwa gw'akazannyo k'amaloboozi
answer_c: Okutegeera ebigambo eby'akawango kamu
answer_d: Okutegeera ebigambo ebifaanagana mu nnyingo

question: Mu kibiina ky'olulimi, okukozesa omulamwa gw'obubaka obw'ekikungo (propaganda), omusomesa asaba abayizi okukola kampeyini ekubiriza okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi munda mu ssomero. Ku lw'ekyo, emirimu egy'enjawulo gissibwawo, gamba ng'okutegeera embeera y'essomero ku by'okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi, okuteekateeka ebiruubirirwa bya kampeyini, okubaga omukutu ogw'obuwangwaazi, n'okunoonya ebikozesebwa eby'obukugu okutambuza omulimu guno. Okukekkereza okutuukirizibwa kw'ekitundu ekisooka ekya kampeyini, omusomesa awa buli kibinja olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola (checklist) basobole okwekebera bokka. Lwaki kisaanira okukozesa olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola mu kitundu kino ekisooka ekya kampeyini?
answer_a: Kubanga buli muyizi asobola okumanya engeri gy’akolamu mu mirimu gye gimuwebwa.
answer_b: Olw’okuba abayizi bajja kusobola okwawula ebikorwa bye bamaze okukola mu biti.
answer_c: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okwekenneenya mu bujjuvu buli kimu ku bikolwa bye bakoze.
answer_d: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okukakasa oba bamalirizza emirimu egibadde gibakwasiddwa egyekuusa ku kampeyini.

question: Abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'omusanvu bakola ku nkola entongole ey'empapula z'amawulire, era olw'ensonga eno, omusomesa abasabye okufulumya ebiwandiiko by'amawulire. Kiki ku bintu ebikozesebwa okukebera ebiri wammanga ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukakasa obanga ebintu ebikola empapula z'amawulire birabika mu biwandiiko ebyafulumiziddwa?
answer_a: Omutindo gw'okusiima
answer_b: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa
answer_c: Ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku mbeera y'omuyizi.
answer_d: Ekyokulabirako ekikulembera

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ekisoma okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko ebirimu okukaayana mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, ng’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga kiri ‘Kutegeera endowooza y’omuwandiisi, ensonga ze n’engeri gy’akozesaamu obukodyo bw’okuwandiika obulungi’, omusomesa ateekwa abayizi okusoma n’okugeraageranya ebbaluwa eri omukulu w’amawulire ezikwata ku nsonga y’emu. Ku biragiro by’okukebera ebiteereddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyateereddwawo mu kibiina?
answer_a: Londa omulamwa omukulu ogw'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'otunuulira enkozesa y'ebigambo n'engeri ebigambo bwe bitegekeddwa.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri emiramwa gy’emyawulo egyolekeddwamu mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo okusinziira ku ngeri ebirowoozo gye bitegekeddwamu n’engeri ebigambo gye bikozesebwamu.
answer_c: Kola endowooza yo ku nsonga eyanjuddwa mu biwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebikozesebwa eby'obumu n'obwegattiro.
answer_d: Wawula amakulu ag'omutwe, ng'osinziira ku by'obuwangwa ebikozeseddwa, okutegeera ekigendererwa ky'omuwandiiko.

question:
Omusomesa akola n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekyokusatu ku kutegeera ebyo basoma okusinziira ku lugero "Empungu Eyekka." Wammanga waliwo ekitundu ekiggyiddwa mu mwoleso guno:
Edda nnyo, kyategekebwa nti ebinyonyi byonna eby'oku lusozi oluli okumpi n'ennyanja birina okufumbiriganwa. Okutuukiriza ekyo, ebirango byateekebwawo buli we waali osobola okusobozesa ebinyonyi okukung'aana ku mukolo. Waali wasigaddeewo obutikitiki butono okutandika omukolo era ebinyonyi byonna byali birindirira nnyo akadde ako, naye empungu yali terina gw'efumbirwa. Nga anakuwadde, yagenda. Embaga zaakolebwa; ebinyonyi byajaganya, newankubadde tebyeerabira nnaku y'empungu.
Omu ku bayizi be abuuza omusomesa: "Okunakuwala" kitegeeza ki?
Kino ku bino wammanga kiki ekiyinza okuyamba omuyizi okutegeera amakulu g'ekigambo kino ng'ayita mu kumanya akatundu akasooka ak'ekigambo?
answer_a: Noonya ekigambo ekiri mu lusuku lw'ebigambo lwe lumu n'ekyo ekiri mu mutwe gw'ekibuuzo era olukwataganye ebigambo byombi n'obubonero obuli mu mutwe gw'ekibuuzo obusobozesa okutegeera amakulu gaakyo.
answer_b: Noonya ebigambo ebirala mu mutango ebiri n'ebinyigirizi, bisimbewo era obikwataganye okuzuula kiki ebigambo bino kye bifaanagana.
answer_c: Noonya ebigambo ebifaanaanyiriza empungu mu mutanda, bisimbeko olukoloboze era obigatte n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula amakulu gaakyo.
answer_d: Noonya ekikolwa ekyeyongera ku kigambo ky’oyagala okuzuula amakulu gaakyo era okwataganye ebigambo bino ebibiri n’ebigambo ebiri okumpi mu mutexti.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekika kya ‘kindergarten’ akola omulimu gw’okwanjula ng’ayita mu baana, ku kitundu kya Chile; ng’ayita mu nkola eno, akungaanya obukakafu ku busobozi bw’abaana “okwogera mu lulimi ku nsonga ze baagala, nga bakozesa ebigambo eby’enjawulo era nga bateekamu ebigambo ebipya era ebikwatagana n’embeera ez’enjawulo ez’okwogera n’aboogerezeganya.” Sofía ayanjula ekitundu kya La Araucanía era n’alaga nti mulimu endiga era nga zimanyiddwa okubeera n’emikwano gyazo. Nga tutunuulidde embeera eyo waggulu, kwe kulonda ki omusomesa kw’anaakola okuyamba Sofía okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyayogerwako?
answer_a: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, ogabanye amawulire ag'omugaso ku by'e La Araucanía. Biki ebirala bye wayize ku ndiga?
answer_b: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, amawulire g'otuwadde gatuyigirizza bingi. Omanyi endiga kye zeeyagalira okukola ne mikwano gyaazo?
answer_c: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, amawulire g'otuwadde gansanyusizza nnyo. Omanyi nsolo ndala ziri mu La Araucanía, okuggyako endiga?
answer_d: Weebale nnyo, Sofía, ogabanye obubaka obukulu obukwata ku La Araucanía. Omanyi ekibiina ky'endiga kiyitibwa kitya? Ebisibo biba bisobola okuba eby'embuzi era.

question: Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’omuwala oba omulenzi ali ku mutendera gwa “syllabic-alphabetic” mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukoppa amannya gaabwe
answer_b: Awandiika ebigambo ebyangu.
answer_c: Awandiika ennukuta ze bamanyi buli emu gyokka.
answer_d: Akoppoola ebigambo ebitono okusobola okubuulira abalala ekintu.

question: Ekitongole ekikuumira ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa mu ssomero kirina ebintu eby’enjawulo eby’okusomesa ebigendereddwa okukulaakulanya olulimi. Omusomesa w’abaana abato alina okulonda ekintu ky’ayagala okukozesa okusomesa abayizi be ku kumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okukozesebwa butereevu okukulaakulanya okumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi?
answer_a: Empapula eziriko ebigambo ebitegeeza ebitali bimu
answer_b: Domino y'eddoboozi ly'ennukuta entandisi
answer_c: Kaadi z’okulambika ebifaananyi n’ebigambo
answer_d: Kaadi z’okuzimbisa sentensi nga tukozesa obubonero bw’ebifaananyi.

question:
Mu katabo, omuntu asobola okulaba obutali bwadde eri abantu abasinga, naddala omuntu omukulu, okukola kyebaagala oba okweyisa nga bwe baagala. Ng’ekyokulabirako, mu kifo ekimu omuntu ayogera ku byafaayo agamba nti tewali n’omu asobola kuwasa gw’ayagala kubanga bwe bakwatibwa basobola okusibwa oba okuttibwa. Kino kindabika bubi nnyo kubanga omuntu tasobola kuba muddeeri okubeera n’omuntu gw’ayagala era, oluusi, mu nnaku zino, kino kisobola okulabika, ng’ekyokulabirako, abantu bwe bakakibwa oba okwekaka okubeera n’omuntu olw’obwangu oba olw’okweraga oba ssente so si lwa kwagala.
Ku bino ebiteekateeka ebisobola okuva eri omusomesa ku ky’omuwandiisi, kiki ku bino ekiyinza okuba eky’amugaso ku nkozesa y’ebikwata ku biwandiiko?
answer_a: Bw’otooteekemu biwandiiko eby’okukakasa, endowooza zo zijja kuggwaamu obutuufu.
answer_b: Yongera ku kamunnyeenye ako n’ensonga endala ey’ekizibu era ogiwagire n’ekigambo ekiggiddwa mu katabo.
answer_c: Singa mu kifo ky’okwogera ku katabo, onoonnyonnyola ekitundu ky’ekiwandiiko ky’oyagala okwogerako, kyandibadde kyeyolefu.
answer_d: Ddamu osome omulongoosa ogunnyonnyola ebyo ebinukuta ebyoleka bye bikola era otunule nnyo ku byokulabirako ebiragiddwa.

question: Omusomesa wa kkindagateni yeetaaga okukola okukebera okuzuula obukugu bw'abaana mu bigambo, naddala obusobozi bwabwe okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo n'okutegeera ekibinja kye birimu. Mbeera ki ey'omusomo esaanira okukungaanya obukakafu obukwata ku bukugu buno?
answer_a: Baaleete abaana okuzannya emizannyo gy'okubuzaabuza. Ebirungo ebikulu eby'ebigambo eby'enjawulo bigenda kwogerwa, nga tetukozesezza bikozesebwa okulaba. Kozesa olukalala okukweka ebyo ebituukiddwaako.
answer_b: Leeta abaana ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebisero ebikiikirira ebibinja eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu ku bintu ebyo, okwogera erinnya lyakyo, n’okukissa mu kibinja. Pima engeri gye bakozesezzaamu olubimbi.
answer_c: Baaleete abaana okwetegereza akataabaliro akalimu ebibinja eby’enjawulo, era obawa kaadi ze balina okukwataganya n’ekibinja ekikwatagana nazo. Kozesa empapula z’ebyo abanaakoze okukweka engeri gye bakolamu.
answer_d: Bawe abaana empapula erimu ebifaananyi by’ebika by’ebintu eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu bakinyonnyole nga tekyogedde linnya lyakyo. Bannaabwe balina okwogera ekigambo ekyo n’okwogera ekika kyakyo. Kebera engeri gye bakozesezzaamu ebipimo.

question: Omusomesa w’abaana abali mu myaka egya wakati akiraze nti ekibiina kye eky’abalenzi n’abawala banyumirwa nnyo ebintu ebibaleka nga beeyambisa emikono gyabwe okuyiiya n’okunoonya, era emirundi mingi bakoppa ennukuta okuva mu ngero, magazini, n’obubonero. N’olwekyo, ku ntandikwa ya semista ey’okubiri, ategese okukola ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: - Omusingi gw’Olulimi Olwogereke: “Okufulumya obubonero bwabwe obw’okuwandiika mu mbeera ez’omuzannyo.” - Omusingi gw’Omubiri n’Entambula: “Okulongoosa enkolagana wakati w’amaaso n’emikono nga bayita mu kukozesa ebintu, ebizannyisibwa, n’ebikozesebwa eby’enjawulo.” Kiki ekireetawo okuyiga okutumbula ebigendererwa ebyateekebwawo omusomesa?
answer_a: Mu kibinja ekinene, mukole omulimu gw'okusoma ebitontome; oluvannyuma, abaana bakoppe ebigambo ebimu nga bwe beetondeera obubaka bwabwe.
answer_b: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana basabiddwa okusalako ebigambo okuva mu magazini n'empapula z'amawulire, ate oluvannyuma okukoppa ebimu ku byo nga bakola ebiwandiiko ebipya.
answer_c: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana bakubirizibwa okuwandiika awamu ekifo ky’emmere, oluvannyuma bafumbe nga bakozesa ebijiko, enfuuwe, n’ebbakuli okukola omugatte.
answer_d: Mu kibinja ekinene, somesa olugero mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka ate oluvannyuma oyite abaana okusiiga ebifaananyi by'ekibaawo eky'omugongo oba ebifo eby'enjawulo okuva mu lugero nga banoonyereza amannya g'abazannyi.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okusatu agenda kukola omulimu gw’okuwandiika olugero n’abayizi be, ng’asinga kwetikka ku ngeri y’okukyusaamu okutambulira awamu n’embeera y’okwogera. Nga twejjukanya ku ky’omusingi kino eky’omulimu guno, mu bibuuzo bino omusomesa by’abuuza, kibuuzo ki ekisaanidde okusinga abayizi okutandika okuteekateeka engeri gye bagenda okuwandiikaamu ebyo bye baagala okuwandiika?
answer_a: Olugero lwaffe luliba lwa kitya?
answer_b: Tugenda kuwandiikira ani olugero lwaffe?
answer_c: Olugero lwaffe lugenda kusiimattuka wa?
answer_d: Lulimi ki lwe tugenda okukozesa mu lugero lwaffe?

question: Mu ssomero lya P7, mu kiseera kye bayiga ku Nfumo n'Engeri Ensi bwe yatondebwa, omusomesa akola ku kigendererwa kino: "Okwekenneenya omulimu gw'abantu abakulu mu nfumo z'okutonda." Okutuukiriza kino, alonzeemu emboozi ezakolebwa obuwangwa obwenjawulo. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira abayizi okukola okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a:
**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo enkulu**

*   **Zeusi:** Katonda omukulu mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Hera:** Mukyala wa Zeusi era kabona omukulu mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Poseidoni:** Katonda w'ennyanja mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Hadesi:** Katonda w'ensi embi mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.

**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo z'omu Misiri**

*   **Ra:** Katonda w'enjuba mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Isisi:** Kabona omukulu omukyala mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Osirisi:** Katonda w'abafu mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Horusi:** Katonda w'eggulu mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.

**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo z'omu Norse**

*   **Odini:** Katonda omukulu mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Tori:** Katonda w'enkuba n'okubwatuka mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Loki:** Katonda omulimba mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Freyja:** Kabona omukulu omukyala w'obugagga n'omukwano mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
answer_b: Leeta ebifaananyi ebyawula abazannyi abakulu, abaddako n’abatagasa nnyo mu ngero ze tulonze.
answer_c: Teeka mu mmeeza nga olaga engeri abamu ku bantu abali mu ngero ezo gye bakwatagana n’ebintu ebyogerwako mu ngero ezo.
answer_d: Wandiika obuwandiike obumpi mwe bannyonnyola empisa z'abantu abakulu abali mu ng'ano ze mwalonze.

question: Omusomesa akola ku nsonga z'obubonero bw'empandiika n'abayizi be aba 7. Okukola kino, agaba akatabo akalimu dduyiro eno: Soma ekitundu ekiddiring'ana era oteeke akakomera, wekisaanidde, mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi. Sergio Gómez muwandiisi w'empagi, omukulu w'abawandiisi, omusomesa w'Oluyisipaniya, era omuwandiisi Omu-Chile eyeeyunira obuganzi bwe nnyo ku bitabo by'abato by'awandiise, naddala eby'omuseries wa dayirekita omuvubuka Quique Hache. Abayizi bamaliriza omulimu mu ngeri entuufu nga bateeka akakomera mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi oluvannyuma lw'ebigambo: muwandiisi w'empagi era omukulu w'abawandiisi. Kutegeera ki abayizi kwe balina okusooka okuyiga okusobola okuteeka akakomera mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi mu ngeri entuufu?
answer_a: Tegeera ebintu ebirina engeri y’emu mu nnyingo.
answer_b: Londa obutundu obuwerekereza amannya.
answer_c: Londa ekigambo ekiri mu kiyita mu sentensi.
answer_d: Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w'ebigattabigambo ebikozesebwa okugatta ebirowoozo mu sentensi?

Nga tutunuulidde ebyo abayizi bye boogedde, kibuuzo ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okubuuza okubalagirira okutegeera ekitontome mu ngeri entuufu?
answer_a: Okuddamu-ddamu okwo n’ekirala ekirabika ng’ekitaliimu makulu kikwatagana kitya n’omutwe gw’omuzimu ogwo?
answer_b: Biki ebikozesebwa mu ngeri y'obuwandiisi ebiri mu kitontome ebitusobozesa okuddamu okutegeera amakulu g'emirongo?
answer_c: Omwogezi mu nnyimba ayagala okulaga ki ng'ayita mu bifaananyi eby'ekirooto by'azimba?

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina eky’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya, agenda kukola okunoonyereza n’abayizi ku byafaayo by’ebitabo eby’Omulembe Ogwa Zaabu, ng’asingira ku mpisa n’embeera y’ebyafaayo ey’ekiseera ekyo. Oluvannyuma lw’okunoonyereza ku intaneeti, abayizi bagenda kuteeka awamu olukalala lw’ebitabo olugazi, ate oluvannyuma balonde ebiwandiiko ebisinga okuba ebituufu okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza. Ku mirimu gino wammanga omusomesa gy’ateese, gumu ku gyo gw’osanga nga gwe gusinga okuba omutuufu okulonda ebiwandiiko ebinoonyerezeddwako?
answer_a: Teekawo empandiika y'ebitabo ebyakozesebwa okunoonyereza era olondeko ekijja okukozesebwa.
answer_b: Sooka osome ebiwandiiko mu bujjuvu okusobola okutegeera ensonga enkulu, oluvannyuma weerabirire obukulu bw'amawulire ago okusinziira ku bigendererwa by'okunoonyereza.
answer_c: Kozesa enkola okumanya omutwe n'ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'obubaka obuli mu buli kitabo ky'oyambiddwa era oluvannyuma okukungaanya ebimanyiddwa okusinziira ku mitwe emito, okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky'okunoonyereza.
answer_d: Nkoonya ensumbi z’ebigambo nga oziggyamu eby’obuwangwa by’omu makkati era oluvannyuma okole entegeka z’ebifaananyi n’ebigambo ebiyambako mu kunoonyereza.

question: Omusomesa omukulu mu kibiina eky’okuna, mu kitundu ky’ebyafaayo ebipya, agenda mu maaso n’okuddamu okuyigiriza ku nkola z’ebyafaayo ebipya. Oluvannyuma lw’okunnyonnyola amakulu g’eddoboozi ennyingi mu byafaayo n’okuwa ebyokulabirako, akizuula nti abayizi abamu tebannategeera bulungi kye kitegeeza. Okwanguya okutegeera, asalawo okunnyonnyola ensonga eno ng’ayitira mu lugero. Lugero ki omusomesa lw’ayinza okukozesa okwanguya okutegeera eddoboozi ennyingi mu byafaayo?
answer_a: Ekibiina ky'abayimbi ekya ssomero kiyimba oluyimba lw'essomero ku mukolo gw'eggwanga.
answer_b: Omukwano ogumu gusisinkana oluvannyuma lw'oluwummula okugabana ebifaananyi byabwe n'ebyo bye bayitamu.
answer_c: Omuntu ali mu kisaawe era n'ayogera ku nneeyisa y'abaana abakilizaawo.
answer_d: Omufumbo gw’ebimuli bwe gugwa okuva ku bbalakoni ne gugwa ku mmotoka eyimiridde, abalabye boogera bye baalabye.

question: Omusomesa ow’omwaka ogwokusatu, mu kiseera ky’essomo ly’okukubaganya ebirowoozo mu lwatu, akola omulimu gw’okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bikwaata ku kukozesa amaanyi mu ngeri entuufu. Mu mbeera eno, omuyizi omu awolereza eky’okukubiriza abantu obutasaasaanya maanyi. Omuyizi omulala awakanya endowooza eno, ng’alowooza nti kiyinza okuba ekizibu okusalawo obanga okukozesa amaanyi kusaasaanya oba tekwasaasaanya. Omusomesa asaba omuyizi eyasooka okuddamu okutegeeza endowooza ye. Nkola ki eyinza okuyamba omuyizi okuddamu okutegeeza endowooza ye mu ngeri entuufu mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo kuno?
answer_a: Okukozesa enkulukuta eziddiring'ana okutegeeza ku bintu ebijjawo olw'okwonoona amasannyalaze
answer_b: Okukozesa enkwaso ezigattika okwongera ku birowoozo ebikwata ku ngeri endala ezitaliimu bulungi ez’okukozesa amaanyi.
answer_c: Okukozesa enkulukuta ezannyonnyola okumanya amakulu amatuufu agakola okusaanyaawo amasannyalaze.
answer_d: Okukozesa ennyingo eziraga obuzibu okusobola okwawula mu buceerefu engeri ezitali zimu emannyo gisobola okusaanyizibwaamu.

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, omusomesa asaba abayizi okusoma olugero olumpi oluyitibwa 'Olugero' olwa Wislawa Szymborska ate oluvannyuma bakole ebibuuzo ebiyamba okutegeera obulungi ebyo ebiri mu lugero. Abalenzi abamu abavubi baaggya eccupa okuva wansi mu nnyanja. Munda mu ccupa mwalimu olupapula, era ku lupapula kwaliko ebigambo bino: "Muyambe!, Ndi wano. Ennyanja ensumuludde ku kizinga etaliiwo bantu. Ndi ku lubalama era ndinda obuyambi. Mwanguyiriza! Ndi wano!" –Tewali lunaku. Kijja kuba nga kiyiseewo ebbanga ddene. Eccupa yandiba nga emaze ebbanga ddene nga etengejja – omulenzi omuvubi eyasooka bwe yagambye. –Era ekifo tekiragiddwa. Tekimanyiddwa wadde nnyanja ki – omulenzi omuvubi owookubiri bwe yagambye. –Si kya lubeerera wadde kya wala. Ekizinga 'Wano' kiri buli wantu – omulenzi omuvubi owookusatu bwe yagambye. Embeera yafuuka mbi, obusirise ne bubaawo. Amazima agawamu galina ekizibu ekyo. Mu bibuuzo bino ebyakolebwa abayizi, kibuuzo ki ekikulembera okutegeera amakulu g'olugero olusomeddwa?
answer_a: Ennyingo "Wano" buli wantu kitegeeza ki?
answer_b: Enkomerero y’olugero yandibadde etya singa obubaka bwali butegerekeka bulungi?
answer_c: Lwaki abavubi tebawulira bulungi n’ekiddamu ky’omusajja owookusatu?
answer_d: Singa wandisangyeewo eccupa erimu obubaka ng’obwo, wandikoze ki era lwaki?

question: Mu kibiina kya P5, omusomesa agenda kukebera okumanya kw'abayizi be ku nkola y'emizannyo. Okukola kino, akola enteekateeka z'ebintu eby'enjawulo ebigenda okumuyamba okunoonya obukakafu obulaga ebyo bye bayize. Mu bintu bino ebigenda okukeberwa, kiki ekiraga okutegeera obuzibu obubeera mu mizannyo?
answer_a: Wawulaana ebikolwa ebikolebwa abantu abakola omuzannyo.
answer_c: Laga ensonga eziviiriddeko omuzannyi omukulu n’omuzannyi omubi okukola bye bakola mu muzannyo.
answer_d: Laga engeri ebikolwa by'omuntu omukulu n'omulabe mu muzannyo gye bikwatagana n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Omusomesa mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okutegeera engeri z’okuwandiika emboozi." Okukola kino, annyonnyola empisa za buli ngeri, oluvannyuma aleeta ebyokulabirako era awa abayizi omukutu okusobola okutegeera engeri zino mu bitundu eby’enjawulo. Ekimu ku bitundu mu ngeri etali butereevu era nga ya lukusa kiri nga bwe kiri wammanga: "Charles yeewuunyizza obweru bw’enjala ze. Zaali njeru, nga ziwawaala ku ntikko, nga zikoleddwa bulungi okusinga amannyo g’endovu ag’e Dieppe, era nga ziringa almondi. Naye omukono gwali si mulungi, oboolyawo nga si mweru kumala, era nga gufaanana embalaasi mu nnyingo; era gwali muwanvu nnyo era nga tegwaliimu bukugu bw’emigongo ku nkula. Ekyali kirungi amaaso; newankubadde nga gaali ga kyenvu, gaalabika nga maddu olw’emyoyo gy’oku maaso, era ng’atunuulira mu butuufu n’obuvumu obw’ekimoomo." (Madame Bovary, Gustave Flaubert). Omu ku bayizi azzeemu nti ekitundu kirimu engeri etali butereevu kubanga waliwo omwogezi ow’okusatu. Nga tutunuulidde okuddamu kuno, bya bya muwendo ki ebikwata ku ngeri z’okuwandiika emboozi omusomesa by’alina okwogerako abayizi basobole okutegeera engeri etali butereevu era nga ya lukusa?
answer_a: Okutegeera engeri omutontomi gy’atunuuliramu ebiri mu lugero
answer_b: Okutegeera ebika by’abanoonyereza mu mboozi
answer_c: Enjawulo wakati w'eddoboozi ly'omunnyonnyozi n'ery'abantu abakola ebikolwa mu lugero
answer_d: Okumanya omuntu annyonnyola byafaayo gy’ayimiridde okutunulira ebyo by’annyonnyola.

question: Ku mirundi gy'okuyiga egiddirira, gumu ku gyo ogikulaakulanya okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo (semantic awareness) era lwaki?
answer_a: Okutondekawo sentensi n'olukalala lw'ebiseera kubanga bikiriza okutegeka ebigambo.
answer_b: Okukola okwawula n'okufaananya okw'omumwa kubanga bikusobozesa okuwa amakulu eri ebigambo
answer_c: Okukola dduyiro y’okuwaana n’okwawula ebigambo mu nsalango kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeera eddoboozi ly’ebigambo.
answer_d: Okukozesa emizannyo gy'ebiseera by'ebikolwa n'okunnyonnyola empisa z'abantu kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeka ebigambo.

question: Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekireetera omuyizi okukulaakulanya okumanya engeri y’okukozesaamu olulimi mu mbeera ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Zuula obutali butuufu mu bigambo ebiri mu ngero ennyimpi.
answer_b: Kola engero ez'ebigambo ng'okozesa kaadi ez'ebifaananyi by'ebigambo.
answer_c: Ggwaamu ebyo ebiri mu bigambo eby'ebbugumu eby'ennono ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Tegeka sentensi ennyangu mu ngeri endala ku eyo eteereddwaawo.

question:
Nga tukolera wamu n'abayizi ku kigendererwa: 'Okukozesa langi mu ngeri y'okusiiga ey'Abaimpressionist.'
Nsobi ki abayizi ze bakola ebisinga obungi bwe bagezaako okufuna langi ez'enjawulo mu mutabulo gwabwe?
answer_a: Gattika langi ey'ekitundu n'enziru okugifuula enziru ennyo
answer_b: Gattika langi y'ekitundu n'eyo egigizuuza okufuna ekisiikirize.
answer_c: Gattika langi ey'omubalanguzi n'eruusi okugyongera obweru
answer_d: Gabula langi emu enkulu n'endala enkulu okukola eya sekenda

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi be ku mulamwa gw'ebiragiro by'ebbala. Mu kiseera ky'ekibiina, omu ku bayizi be amubuuza: "Mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, ddi ekibala ekiragiro lwe kikozesebwa?" Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olwo lukola ng'ekyokulabirako omusomesa ky'ayinza okuwa omuyizi we?
answer_a: Mu langi ezikozesebwa mu bukodyo bw'emikono obw'engoye, erangi ki efanaana n'erangi z'ebifo by'obutonde?
answer_b: Bwe mba nziriga era ne nnyoleseza embeera yange ey’obuntu okuyita mu langi.
answer_c: Bwe nkola ekiwooto ky'ekitabo
answer_d: Mu langi egatta era efuula, eky'okulabirako, olukalala lw'ebidduka okumanyika.

question: Omusomesa ayimiridde mu maaso g'ekibiina ng'ayogera ku mutwe gw'okukuba ebifaananyi, era omu ku bayizi be amubuuza: Kika ki kya kukuba bifaananyi ekiyitibwa intaglio era lwaki? Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki waliwo olukusa omusomesa lw'ayinza okukozesa okwongera okutangaaza ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Okuyoola ebifananyi, kubanga omuti ogukolebwako kiyoolwa n’ebyuma eby’enjawulo ebisala era ne bikola obutimba obw’omunda mu muti ogukolebwako.
answer_b: Okukuba ebifaananyi nga okuyita mu mutimbagiro, kubanga bwetaatira ayita mu busera bw’olutimbe okukola ekifaananyi ku bintu nga olupapula, engoye, oba ebintu ebirala.
answer_c: Okuyoola n'okukuba ebifaananyi nga bakozesa amazzi, olw'okuba bwino aba yeesigadde mu tunyiro otuba twakoze mu kikaati ky'ekyuma, n'olwekyo, ekifaananyi ekikubiddwa kiva mu tunyiro tw'ekikaati so si ku ngulu kwakyo.
answer_d: Obuwandiike bwa lithography, olw’obuzito bw’ejjinja erikozesebwa, nga bugattiddwa ku bunene bw’amaanyi agasaanikiddwa ekyuma ekikuba ebifaananyi, butondekawo akabonero omubala gwe gweyoleka nga gulinnye waggulu katono.

question: Ngeri ki esinga okusaana okukozesebwa okukola omulimu, okwanguya abayizi okutegeera enkola y'okusiiga ebifaananyi eya Jackson Pollock?
answer_a: Kozesa okutereeza ebifaananyi okukola omutindo gw'okutambula mu by'olaba
answer_b: Kozesa ebikolwa by'omubiri okuleka akabonero akali mu kifaananyi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebikwaso eby’enjawulo nga bw’okozesa engeri z’okusiiga ez’enjawulo.
answer_d: Kozesa ebifaananyi ebitaliimu mulamwa okukola ekikolage.

question:
Omusomesa ow'ekitabo ky'abataano alaga abayizi be ebifaananyi bya Chile okuva mu biseera eby'enjawulo, ng'annyonnyola engeri ez'enjawulo abakugu gye bakozesaamu langi, enkula, n'omusana. Oluvannyuma, abasoomooza okulonda ekifaananyi, ekitali mu byo bye balabye, okwekkaanya kinnoomu ebintu bye bimu eby'olulimi olw'okulaba bye bayigiriziddwa. Ku nkomerero, abayizi baleeta okwekkaanya kwabwe mu kibiina. Omusomesa akola omulimu guno ng'akozesa akabonero.

Lwaki okukozesa enkola eno kisaanira okukebera ekigendererwa ekiragiddwa mu mulimu oguyise?
answer_a: Kubanga kizingiramu omulimu ogw'enjawulo ogulina ebitundu eby'enjawulo ebiteekwa okwawulwa okusobola okuwa omuyizi endowooza.
answer_b: Olw’ensonga nti olukalala lw’ebipimo lukiriza okugattika kw’obubonero n’enzitoya ez’enjawulo.
answer_c: Olw’okuba lulimi olukozesebwa lukusobozesa okukebera omulimu gw’omuyizi nga togutaddeko manki oba okusalirawo oba mulungi oba mubi, wabula okusinziira ku ngeri omuyizi gy’akolamu omulimu gwe.
answer_d: Olwa lubalaza olukiriza okulonda ebisinga obulungi okuva mu kunoonyereza okukoleddwa abayizi

question: Omusomesa bw’aba ayagala abayizi be okusobola okwawula ekiseera kya Baroque okusinziira ku ndabika y’ebintu, ku ki ky’asaanidde okussa essira okusinga?
answer_a: Enjawulo wakati w'ebika by'ennyimba eziyimbirwa n'ezikubibwa.
answer_b: Okutegeera okubaawo kwa basso continuo
answer_c: Okumanyisa abatutumufu abaakola ennyimba: Vivaldi, Bach, Haendel
answer_d: Okunnyonnyola ebintu eby'enjawulo ebyaliwo ebyatandika era ne bimaliriza ekiseera wakati wa 1600 ne 1750.

question:
Soma embeera eno:
Omusomesa w'ebyamuziki asaba abayizi be okukola omulimu gw'okukuba ebintu mu bibinja, omuli, okusooka, abasomesa olunyiriri lw'entuumo olw'akatikitiki akawungeezi, ate oluvannyuma, olunyiriri olw'okubiri. Omusomesa yeesomesa entuumo mu ngeri eno: 1. Abayizi bonna wamu bakuba olunyiriri olusooka; oluvannyuma olw'okubiri. 2. Ekitundu ky'ekibiina kikuba olunyiriri olusooka n'ekitundu ekirala olw'okubiri, bwe kityo ne kireetawo ennyimba ez'enjawulo. 3. Abayizi bonna mu kiseera kye kimu baddamu okukola omulimu ogwakakolebwa, naye kati mu bubiri. 4. Oluvannyuma, abayizi balondeddwa kinnoomu okukuba buli lunyiriri lw'ennyimba ez'enjawulo. Nkulaakulana ya ngeri ki esinga okukuzibwa omulimu ogwo oguguddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Okutegeera
answer_b: Ekibiina
answer_d: Obwongo n'omubiri

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kiseera omusomesa ng’annyonnyola ebika by’obubonero bw’ebiseera, akiraba nti abayizi be abasinga obungi tebasobola kuwulira njawulo wakati w’ebika by’obubonero bw’ebiseera ebirina omuwendo gw’obukuba bwe gumu naye nga byawukana mu mugawanyo (2/4 ne 6/8, 3/4 ne 9/8, 4/4 ne 12/8). Kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okukola okuyamba abayizi okwawula enjawulo ezo?
answer_a: Weetebwa omuyizzi gw'ennyimba ogulaga enjawulo zino.
answer_b: Kyusa akabonero k'obudde aka melody ennyangu nga okukozesa omu kubambi akakola ebipande by'ennyimba.
answer_c: Mukoone oluyimba mu 6/8 n'abayizi, era amangu ddala nga mumaze, mukyuse akazimbulukusa kalyo okulukola mu 3/4.
answer_d: Okunnyonnyola engeri empalo gy’eyawulwamu mu bibiri n’ensatu nga tukozesa okumanya kw’abuyigirizwa kwe balina ku by’emikutule.

question: Omusomesa ateekateeka okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ab'omwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya ku pulojekiti ng'akozesa emiramwa gya Land Art. Mu biragiro bino wammanga, kiruwa ekisaanira okutandika nakyo omulimu guno?
answer_a: Teekawo omulimu mu bweru bw’essomero obutaliimu kintu kyonna, obwolesebwa eri enkyukakyuka z’obudde era ozikozese ng’ebintu eby’omugaso mu kyakuteekateeka.
answer_b: Teekateeka omulimu nga weekozesa ebintu eby'obutonde eby'enjawulo ebisangiddwa era okole n'akakodyo akaterekero mu kizimbe ky'essomero omutendekerwa emizannyo.
answer_c: Teekateeka omulimu nga weekozesa kazambi ava mu bibuga okukyusaamu ekifo munda mu kizimbe.
answer_d: Teekateeka omulimu ng'oyita mu bifaananyi okunyonyola ebifo eby'enjawulo ebiraga obulungi ensi yo.

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku mulamwa gw’ebintu eby’obuwangwa ebiggumire ebigenda. Okwanguya okutegeera, abalaga ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo ebiraga omulamwa guno. Mu ngeri ki eno wammanga mulimu ekyokulabirako ekituufu eky’ebintu eby’obuwangwa ebiggumire ebigenda?
answer_a: Ebifaananyi bya ppaaka n'obukuumi bw'obutonde.
answer_b: Ebifaananyi by'amayumba agalangiriddwa ng'ebintu by'eggwanga eby'omuwendo omungi
answer_c: Ebintu eby'omu bintu by'obuwangwa obwa edda
answer_d: Engero n'ebifa ku mulembe ogw'okwogerera waggulu

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Omusomesa omuto ow’omwaka ogusooka mu Ssomero lya Middle ategekka omukolo abayizi be mwe bagenda okukolera ebifaananyi ebisiigwa ebweru butereevu, nga batwala omugendo gw’abayimbi aba Impressionist ng’ekyakulabirako.
Kuyiga ki okw’emabega, okwogeddwako ku nkola z’obuyimbi, kwe kwetaagisa abayizi bano okukola?
answer_a: Okukozesa obutonotono obutadde okumpi okukola emibalabala egy'emikye.
answer_b: Okukozesa langi ezitali za bulijjo ku bintu eby'enjawulo ebiri mu mbeera y'obuntu.
answer_c: Okukozesa langi eziriwo mu kitundu nga bweziri ng’omutendera ogusooka
answer_d: Okukozesa langi enzirugavu okukiikirira ebisiikirize

question: Omulundi ogusoose, abayizi b’omwaka ogusooka mu Siniya basoomozebwa okukozesa okubaja embawo ng’engeri y’okweyoleka. Okunnyonnyola tekiniki eno bw’eri, omusomesa akozesa ekyokulabirako okuva mu bulamu obwa bulijjo okukola olugero olufaanagana n’enkola y’okukola ekifaananyi ekibajiddwa. Ku ndagaano zino wammanga, eruwa erimu olugero oluyamba okunnyonnyola okubaja embawo kwe kwesigamiziddwa?
answer_a: Ekikubiddwa ku kyapa okuva mu kyapaayi y’essomero
answer_b: Akabonero akakubiddwa siteampu ya ssaabawandiisi ku ssomero
answer_c: Engalo z’omuntu eziri ku kaadi y’omuyizi eraga obuntu bwe
answer_d: Ebipimo by'engatto z'abayizi ku ffloowa y'ekibiina.

question:
