question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'omunaana mu somero ateekateeka omutwe ogugenda okusomesa ogwa 'Enkola z'Okukulaakulanya Omuziki'. Kintu ki abayizi kye balina okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera ebiri mu mutwe guno ogugenda okusomesebwa?
answer_a: Enjawulo
answer_b: Omulembe gw'amaloboozi
answer_c: Omutwe gw'oluyimba
answer_d: Okukulakulanya oluyimba

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu ssomero erisookerwako, omusomesa ayagala okukolera awamu n’abayizi ku nkola y’ebibuga ng’asinziira ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ebintu bwe birabika mu bifo bya lukale eby’omukitundu ky’essomero. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira okukozesa okusobola okukolera awamu n’abayizi ku nkola y’ebibuga, okusinziira ku ebyo ebyogeddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Kuba ekifaananyi ky’endabika y’omulyango gw’essomero.
answer_b: TEEKI ebipande ebiraga engeri y'okukuuma n'okukozesa ebintu ebiterekebwa mu bibuga.
answer_c: Ddala eddamu okuteekateeka ekisenge nga kikolerwa okusobola okukijjukiza omuntu n'ebyo by'ayagala era n'ebimweraliikiriza.
answer_d: Teekateeka ebipande nga osinziira ku bye weetegereza ebyetaagisa mu ssomero.

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina kya S.6, mu mutwe 'Okunoonyereza ku nnimi z'eby'obukugu ez'omulembe guno', omusomesa ayagala okunnyonnyola abayizi be, ng'ayita mu kikolwa, enkola y'okukola sitensulo. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, engeri ki erimu ekikolwa ekisobola okunnyonnyola enkola eno?
answer_a: Kuba akakomo ku ssente n'ekikomo oluvannyuma okomeleleze.
answer_b: Langi ssente era okubisa ku lupapula.
answer_c: Siga ekkalaamu ku lupapula oluteereddwa ku ssente.
answer_d: Teeka ssente ku lupapula lwe biti era osige okwetoloola.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa ng'ali n'abayizi be ab'omwaka ogusooka mu siniya, ku nkomerero y'essomo eriri ku 'Kusiiga Ebifaananyi ku Bisenge', ayagala abayizi be beekebeere okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino: 'Okwekenneenya ebifaananyi byabwe bye basiize ku bisenge, nga batunuulira enkolagana wakati w'ekigendererwa eky'okwolesa, ebintu ebyakozesebwa, n'olulimi olw'ebyobulamu'. Kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa okusobola okugera okutuukirizibwa kw'ekigendererwa ekyogeddwako waggulu?
answer_a: Basiima ebintu by’olulimi olw’obuwangwa ebikozesebwa mu pulojekiti zaabwe ez’ebifaananyi eby’oku bisenge.
answer_b: Banoonyeereza ebifaananyi byabwe eby'oku bisenge nga basinziira ku mutwe gw'ekigambo, ebintu ebikozeseddwa ebitaaggwaawo, langi, enkula, n'emirongo egiri mu kikungo.
answer_c: Bagezesa ebintu eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku mutwe gw'omulimu gwabwe.
answer_d: Bateekawo emikwano wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa ebitali bya bulabe mu pulojekiti n'enkula, ennyiriri, langi, n'emitendera egy'ateesebwa.

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina eky'okutaano, ng'akozesa omutendera Gw'okuwuliriza n'Okusiima, akola omusomo ogw'emirundi egiwerako, ogugenda okumalirizibwa n'omulimu ogugenda okubalirwa okusobola okukebera ekigendererwa "Okwolesa enneewulira, ebirowoozo, n'endowooza eziweebwa ennyimba". Mu biraga by'okukebera bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga ekigguddwawo?
answer_a: Baleeta eri abantu bonna emirimu gye bakola mu kiseera kyonna eky’okusoma.
answer_b: Beeyoleka mu mubiri nga bawuliriza eby'emiziki ebikubirwa n'enyimba.
answer_c: Balaga obuntubulamu mu nnyimba zaabwe nga buli omu ku lwabwe n'abangi.
answer_d: Bayimba era ne bakuba eby'emiziki ebiva mu nsi ez'enjawulo, nga bateeka essira ku bulungi bw'amaloboozi mu nnyimba zaabwe.

question:
Mu kibiina kya munaana, omusomesa agenda kwanjula abayizi ku nkola y'amaanyi ag'enjawulo mu nnyimba ze bakuba.
Kiki ku bino wammanga abayizi kye bandibadde bamaze okukola okusobola okutegeera ebigenda okusomesebwa?
answer_a: Okutegeera obubonero bw'emisinde gy'ennyimba (Tempo)
answer_b: Okusoma ebigambo mu ngeri etegeerekeka.
answer_c: Okukola obulungi ritardando, accelerando, ne rubato
answer_d: Okunonyereza ku ngeri ebivuga bwe bikola omulimu gwabyo nga bikozesa amaloboozi

question: Mu kitundu "Okunnyonnyola ennyimba z'omu kibuga", omusomesa asaba omukubi wa bassi mu kibiina okukoppolola oluyimba oluwandiikiddwa okukubirwa n'eggita. Mmanyi ki omuyizi ly'alina okuba alimanyi okusobola okukola omulimu ogwo?
answer_a: Okusoma ennukuta z'ekivuvvuulo kya bass
answer_b: Okusoma akabonero ka treble
answer_c: Okusoma akalambuluzo k'Amerika
answer_d: Okusoma ebbaluwa y'ennanga ya bassi

question: Mu mutera gw'essomo “Okubumba n'engeri obutonde bw'abantu gye bulagibwaamu”, mu kibiina kya musanvu, omusomesa akola okukebera okuyamba okumanya obukugu bw'abayizi nga bakola omulimu gw'okubumba ebifaananyi by'abantu. Mu kukebera kuno, omusomesa akizuula nti abayizi balina obuzibu okutegeera amakulu g'okulaga endowooza y'omuntu n'engeri omuntu gy'akozesaamu emikono n'omubiri okumwawula. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, mulimu ki ogusinga okuba omulungi okukozesa okuyamba abayizi okugonjoola obuzibu buno?
answer_a: Laga ensobi eziri mu ngeri obwenyi gye bulagiddwamu mu birowoozo by'abayizi era obabuulire lwaki zibaddewo.
answer_b: Leeza mu buzibu obuzzeemu okulabika mu bifaananyi ebiraga endowooza y’omuntu era nonnyola emitendera egigoberelwa mu kulambika n’ebipimo ebigendererwa.
answer_c: Tegeka omwoleso gw'ebikozesebwa ebyogera ku ngeri y'okweyoleka era weekenneenye ebirimu ebiraga obuzibu mu bifaananyi by'abakugu abalina amannya.
answer_d: Nnyonnyola mu bujjuvu emiramwa gy’ekigereeso egy’ekitundu ekikwata ku bintu ebiraga endowooza mu byebijagalaggo era olongoose obubonero obukozesebwa okukebera ebintu abayizi bye bazibuwalirwa ennyo.

question: Mu kibiina kya musanvu, mu kiseera ky’okukulaakulanya omutwe gw’ekyokuyiga “Okutondekawo mu lukalu obuntu bwaffe obw’ennono”, omusomesa atunuulidde ekigendererwa “Okukozesa ebintu n’emisingi gy’olulimi olw’okulaba okusobola okubuunisa obuntu bwaffe obw’ennono”. Okukola kino, asabye abayizi okukola omulimu ogw’okukola ekifananyi nga bayita mu kukozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo, basobole okuteekateeka ekifo ky’ekisenge kyabwe. Omusomesa agenda kukebera ebintu ebyo ng’akozesa akalaga kabonero. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga obulungi okutuukirizibwa kw’ekigendererwa kino eky’okuyiga?
answer_a: Bakozesa ebifananyi ebisaliddwa okuva mu bifo eby'enjawulo okubisaanira nga bwe baagala okukyusaamu ekisenge.
answer_b: Bakola akatabo akalimu ebipande by’ebika by’ebiragala eby’enjawulo okusiiga ku bisenge by’ekisenge.
answer_c: Bakozesa okussa ebifananyi ebitundutundu by’ebintu waggulu na waggulu okubangulula obubanguko bw’ekisenge.
answer_d: Bakozesa tekiniki ya kukoppa na kuklejja okubikka ebifo ebyenjawulo ebikola obwagaagavu bw’ekisenge.

question:
Omusomesa ateekateeka essomo ly'ekibiina eky'omukaaga, ng'ekigendererwa kye kiri "Okukola omulimu ogwesigamiziddwa ku mpisa z'ebyakolebwa ebyomulembe guno."
Kino mu bikolwa bino wammanga kye kisinga okuba ekituufu, ng'entandikwa, abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Kebera emirimu gy'abayizi banno era ogaba endowooza yo.
answer_b: Kola ebifaananyi nga osinziira ku mulamwa oguweereddwa era obilage eri abayizi banne mu kibiina.
answer_c: Londa omulamwa ogw'omulembe guno oguliwo, ogukiikirire ng'okozesa endowooza y'omubiri.
answer_d: Kiki ekintu ky'oyagala okukozesa ebintu ebyabulijjo okukola ekifaananyi ky'ekintu ekyo?

question: Mu kibiina ky’okusatu mu siniya, mu mutwe gw’ekyokubiri ogwa "Ekibiina Ekikuba Ebivuga", omusomesa ategekategeka amasomo ng’alina ekigendererwa nti abayizi basobola okuteekawo amateeka gaabwe ku bwabwe agakozesebwa okukompoza ennyimba. Mu ngeri y’emirimu egiddibwako abayizi gyebagenda okukola, endi ki esinga okuba entuufu okukolerako okutuuka ku kigendererwa omusomesa kyeyateekawo?
answer_a: Bavumbula ebirowoozo by'endongo ey'omulembe, ne bategeera ebipimo byayo, era ne bateeka ennyimba n'obuwangwa waggulu, nga balonda ebyo ebisinga okusaana omulembe gw'endongo. Oluvannyuma, bakung'aanya oluyimba, ne batereeza ensobi, era ne balaga bannaabwe bye bakoze, abawa ebirowoozo ku byavudde mu nkomerero.
answer_b: Buli omu ayanjula ebirowoozo bye eri abayizi abalala mu kibiina. Balonda ekirowoozo ekisinga okukiikirira ekibiina n’ennyimba ze baagala. Oluvannyuma batendekka era bakikola nga ekibiina. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, bakebera ebyavuddemu nga bakola obulungiyizo obw’enkomerero okukyanjula.
answer_c: Baleetawo okusoomoozebwa era ne bakungaanya ebirowoozo ebisoose ebibasobozesa okussa essira n’okuteekateeka engeri omulimu gye gugenda mu maaso. Oluvannyuma, bagezesa era ne bakebera ebikwaata ku maloboozi ng’enteekateeka esooka, gye bakebera, balongoosa, era ne bagabana okuyita mu kubawa endowooza okuva eri bannaabwe n’omusomesa.
answer_d: Bawuliriza omutendera omulonde omusomesa gw’alonze, nga bakebejja ebintu ebigukola. Bageereza ebitundu eby’enjawulo ku bintu byabwe era ne bagukuba, oluvannyuma ne bakozesa omutendera ogwo okukola emikolo gyabwe, nga bassaamu ekitiibwa engeri omutendera ogwo gye gwakolebwamu.

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina eky’abali mu mwaka ogw’okubiri mu ssomero lya siniya ateekateeka okukolera awamu n’abayizi ku kumanya enjawulo mu bitundu by’ennyimba ezimanyiddwa nga bayita mu kuwulira. Okukola kino, mu masomo agamu, abayizi bagenda kuwuliriza ennyimba ezirondeddwa era bawandiike mu bukwati bwabwe ebitundu bya buli lumu (olunyiriri, oluyimba oluddwamu, akawungeezi, n’ebirala), ebitundu bye bitegeeza bigenda kuyigirizibwa mu myito gyonna egenda okukolebwa. Bukugu ki obw’okuwulira abayizi bwe balina okuba nabwo okusobola okuyiga ebipya bino obulungi?
answer_a: Wawulaanye enjawulo entono mu nnono z'amaloboozi.
answer_b: Londa enkola y'endongo ey'obuwangwa.
answer_c: Londawo ebiseera eby'ennyimba ebyeddiŋŋana n'ebyenjawulo.
answer_d: Tegeera ebika bya binary

question:
Omusomesa akola omulimu gw'ekibiina. Omusomesa ayagala okukozesa ebikozesebwa bibiri eby'okukebera. Ekikozesebwa ekisooka kyakukozesebwa mu nkola okurekodiya omutendera ogw'obukozi obw'omulimu obuggweereddwaawo mu buli kibiina, ate ng'ekikozesebwa eky'okubiri kyakukozesebwa ku nkomerero y'omulimu okwongera ku bukugu bw'abayizi okufumiitiriza ku nkulaakulana y'omulimu.

Mu ngeri ki ennungi esinga eyewooza, ebikozesebwa eby'okukebera ebisinga okutuukana n'ebigendererwa by'omusomesa?
answer_a: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa n'akabonero k'omuntu kinnoomu
answer_b: Empapula erimu ebyawandiikibwa eby'obukakafu n'ekipimo ky'omutindo ky'ekibiina
answer_c: Omubuulo ogw’okwekebejja n’okulambika ebikolwa by’abayizi
answer_d: Omutindo gw'okusiima n'ekyokulabirako ekikuyamba okwekebera.

question: Mu ssomero lya siniya ery’okusatu, omusomesa akola omutwe ogw’okuyiga ogukwata ku miziki egiriwo kati. Emu ku bigendererwa bye okuyigiriza kwe kuno: "Okutegeera mu bw’endowooza ne mu kuwulira engeri enzirukanya n’endabika y’oluyimba gye bitegekeddwa." Ku ngeri zino wammanga, eruwa eraga omutindo gw’omuyizi gwe bateekwa okutuukako ogukwatagana n’ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Kutondawo oluyimba olulina ekitundu ekisooka n’ekiddako
answer_b: Okutegeera ebitundu by'oluyimba olwa popu
answer_c: Okwekenneenya engeri ebimuumu bya rondo ebirina emitwe ebiri gye bitegekeddwa.
answer_d: Ategeera engeri enkulu ez’ekitundu ky’omuziki ekikubiddwa nga tekiriko muyimbi.

question: Omusomesa w’abaana abato abakolera mu kkomera n’abaana abakulu abato agenda kutekateeka ebintu eby’enjawulo mu kiseera ky’ekibiina ekinene okukubiriza ekigendererwa kino okuva mu kitundu ky’Ennimi z’Obuyiiya: “Okukoppa ebikolwa, emyendera, n’amaloboozi okuva mu mbeera yaabwe ey’amakulu, okuyita mu ngeri ez’enjawulo.” Ku bino wammanga, kiki ekikolwa ekiyigiriza ekikkiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Wa abaana olugero olw'ekisimulo era obasabe okukola ekikwaso ky'omuntu gwe baasinze okwagala mu lugero olwo.
answer_b: Leeta abaana ebifaananyi by'ebisolo eby'enjawulo ebirina engeri gye bivuga era obabuulire okubategeera nga babiyita amannya.
answer_c: Muwandiise abaana okuzannya omuzannyo gwa "Simon agamba" era mulage, nga mukozesa bigambo bya mukono, ebintu eby'enjawulo bye balina okunoonya n'okuleeta.
answer_d: Baaleete abaana bayimbe era bazine ennyimba ezikwaatagana n’omubiri, gamba nga "Ku Ddobozi ly’Engona" ne "Ekikere ky’omu Nnyanja."

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina kya 'kindergarten' ategese ekigendererwa kino okuva mu mutendera gw'ennimi ez'obuyiiya: "Okukiikirira enneewulira, ebirowoozo, ebintu ebyabayiseeko, n'ebigendererwa, nga bayita mu nkoola, ebika, langi, n'obukwafuwafu, nga bakozesa ebintu ebibayambako mu nnyiriri empanvu n'enzimbe." Okutuukiriza kino, bagenda kukola n'ekibiina kyabwe omulimu oguyitibwa "Okutondawo ekiwuka eky'omu nnyumba", nga bawandiika engeri abaana gye bakolamu nga bayita mu bifaananyi. Mu nkola zino wammanga, eruwa esobozesa omusomesa okukung'aanya obujulizi obukwata ku kutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyateesebwa?
answer_a: Leeta abaana ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo ebiraga ensolo era obasabe okunnyonnyola ku nneewulira ze bibaleetera. Oluvannyuma, obasabe okulonda ekimu kye baagala okukiikirira.
answer_b: Leeta abaana ebintu bisatu bye muyinza okulunda mu nnyumba, balonde kimu ku byo bakikoleese nga bakozesa ebintu ebikozeseddwa. Oluvannyuma, basabe boonereze famire zaabwe engeri gye bakozesezza okukikola.
answer_c: Leeta ebintu eby’enjawulo eri abaana obasabe okulondamu ebimu bakole ekifaananyi ky’ekiwuuka kyabwe eky’omunda. Oluvannyuma, bayite okwanjulira bannaabwe mu kibiina lwaki ekiwuuka ekyo kya njawulo.
answer_d: Laga abaana vidiyo ennyonnyola emitendera eginaagobererwa okukola ekiikirira ekisolo kyabwe eky'awaka. Oluvannyuma, bayite okutegeka akatale k'ebyemikono mwe banaalagirira ebyo bye bakoze eri abantu bonna.

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n’ekibiina ky’omunaana ku mutwe gw’okuyiga ogwa Okuwuliriza, Okuyimba, n’Okukuba ebivuga. Oluvannyuma, agenda kukebera ekigendererwa kino ekikulu: "Okunnyonnyola ebikwata ku miziki egiwuliriziddwa; ng’asinga kwetegereza enkulaakulana y’obukugu mu kuyimba obuteewakana n’amaanyi g’eddoboozi". Kiraga ki nti omuyizi atuukirizza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Bayimba era bazannya nga bateeka essira ku ntandikwa n’enkomerero y’omulimu, nga bagunnyonnyola n’amagezi ag’omuziki.
answer_b: Bayimba era ne bazannya nga bakozesa amaloboozi agasukka mu limu, nga bateeka essira ku nkulukuta z'ennyimba ezikwatagana n'omulimu n'endabika y'ennyimba.
answer_c: Bayimba era ne bazannya olukalala lw'ennyimba nga bakozesa ennyimiriza ey'ekika ky'omuziki ogwo gwe bakuba.
answer_d: Bayimba era bazannya nga bakozesa omukka n'ebipimo by'amaanyi mu mulimu ogunnyonnyolwa.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omusanvu, mu mutwe gw’ekitabo ogwa Okutondekawo Ebirabika, omuntu n’obutonde, akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku ngeri enkulu ez’ebikolwa by’obuyiiya obw’ettaka, ng’asinziira ku kwetegereza n’okwekenneenya ebikolwa by’abayiiya abakugu. Oluvannyuma, ateesa okussa mu nkola bye bayize mu pulojekiti y’okukyusa ekifo mu ppaaka eriraanye essomero n’okukwata ebifaananyi by’ebyo bye bakozesezza okuyiiya. Omusomesa agenda kukebera ebyavaamu ng’akozesa ekipimo ky’okusiima. Okusobola okukung’aanya obukakafu ku ebyo abayizi bye batuuseeko mu kuyiga, kiraga ki omusomesa ky’ayinza okulowooza okuteeka mu kikozesebwa okukebera?
answer_a: Bakola ebyafaayo by’ebifaananyi ebiraga omutindo gw’engeri omulimu gw’obuyiiya gye gukolebwamu n’ebivaamu eby’enkomerero.
answer_b: Balonda ebintu eby'obutonde oba eby'obulamu obutereevu ku lw'omulimu gwabwe, okusinziira ku mirimu gy'obuyiiya bw'ettaka.
answer_c: Bateekawo enkolagana wakati w’embeera y’obuwangwa gye bateekamu emirimu gyabwe n’ekigendererwa kyabwe eky’okwogera kye baagala okutuusa.
answer_d: Balondoola ebintu ebirabika mu bikolwa by'obuyiiya ebikwata ku ttaka okusobola okubikozesa nga tebannatandikaawo omulimu gwabwe.

question: Mu kibiina kya S.3, abayizi bakola ebintu eby'obuyiiya, ng'omusomesa w'essomo abasabye buli omu okukola oluyimba olutono olw'amaloboozi agatuukagana. Omu ku bayizi teyategeera mangu biragiro n'asaba omusomesa amunnyonnyole mu bigambo ebyangu oluyimba olw'amaloboozi agatuukagana kye lutegeeza. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, engeri ki omusomesa gy'ayinza okuddamu omuyizi mu ngeri entuufu era etegeerekeka?
answer_a: Kukola oluse lwa nnukuta eziddamu eri ekiragiro eky'ekikulu oba ettoniika.
answer_b: Kwekutolontoka n'okudda mu nnanga ku lw'oluyimba emirundi mingi okuva ku nnutti enkulu okudda gy'eri.
answer_c: Kwe kunnyonnyola omulimu mu nkola y'ebivuga ebiragiddwa okutambulira ku ndagiriro y'ennyingo ezikwatagana okwetoloola ennyingo enkulu, nga kikozesa nnyo endagiriro y'obuwulize bw'amaloboozi agatuukagana.
answer_d: Kukola omulimu gw'okuyiiya omuziki nga tuyita mu nkola ez'enjawulo ez'okutereeza n'ebikozesebwa.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina ky’abalenzi n’abawala abali mu mwaka ogw’okusatu mu ssomero eggattule ateekawo ekiruubirirwa eri abayizi okutegeera ennyimba nga bakozesa amagezi ag’enjawulo, obukugu obutaliiko kamogo, n’obunnyufu. Okutuukiriza kino, alonda oluyimba olw’amaloboozi ana okuyimbwa abayizi bonna mu kibiina. Mu ngeri eno, akiraba nti newankubadde bayimba mu bunnyufu era nga bategeera engeri oluyimba lwe luyimbibwaamu nga balutegeera, tebakyusa bigambo mu ngeri entuufu nga bayimba, bwatyo, obukugu obutaliiko kamogo tebutuukirizibwa. Ki ki omusomesa ky’ayinza okwogera, ng’engeri y’okubawaamu amagezi aganaabayamba okuyiga, ekiyinza okwanguya okuyiga kuno eri abayizi?
answer_a: Okunnyonnyola kulungi nnyo nga kuteekeddwa mu ndabika y'omulimu. Kyokka, mu muyimbi omulungi kikulu nti ebiwandiiko bikwatagane n'entindo ezibigoberera, bityo basobole okwogera ku bintu bino byombi wamu.
answer_b: Nkulabirukira ku ngeri gy'onnyonnyodde ebintu mu bwesigwa. Kati, kikulu nti, bwe tunnyonnyola omuziki mu ddoboozi, abayimbi bawuliriziganye okusobola okutuuka ku kwogera obulungi mu bo.
answer_c: Weebale nnyo olw'okutendereza omulimu gwange; naye wakyaliwo we nnyinza okutereezaamu mu ngeri gye nnunnyulamu omulimu. Okukakasa nti nnunnyuludde bulungi ebiwandiiko, nkuwabula okuddamu okubala obubonero emirundi egiwerako.
answer_d: Obukugu obw’amaanyi n’okunnyonnyola omulimu bituukiddwaako. Wabula, okumaliriza omulimu guno, kikulu okwongera okunyweza enjatula y’ebigambo ng’oyimba. Kino kijja kuyamba okutegeera amakulu gabyo n’okufuula okuyimba okutuufu.

question: Mu kitundu 'Okutegeera Abakugu mu Kukola Eby'emikono Ab'omulembe Gunno n'Okuddamu Okukola Emirimu Gyabwe', mu kibiina kya S4, omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi be ku mulimu ogusooka, ogw'okunoonyereza mu bibinja ogulina ekigendererwa kino: "Okunoonyereza ku mitindo egy'enjawulo n'embeera ebyakozesebwa okukola eby'emikono okuva mu bibinja by'abayivu abakola eby'omulembe gunno." Ku nkomerero y'okunoonyereza, omusomesa agenda kukola okukebera okuyigiriza okw'emirimu okusinziira ku lukalala lw'ebipimo. Mu bipimo bino ebigenda okussa mu lukalala lw'okukebera, kiki ekisobola okukakasa obutuukirivu bw'ekigendererwa ekyatuukirizibwa?
answer_a: Banoonyezza mu буnyikivu ekigendererwa eky’okwolesa ebiri mu by’obugubi eby’omulembe ebikikirira ebibinja ebyalondeddwa
answer_b: Bakola omulimu gw'obuyiiya ogw'ekikolwa ky'obuyiiya ekya kati, nga balowooza ku mitindo egikola ekibiina ekyasomeddwa.
answer_c: Banannyonnyola engeri y’ebikolwa by’obugubi eby’omulembe ogwa leero eby’ekibiina ekyalondeddwa, nga babigatta n’embeera z’ebyenfuna n’ebyemabega by’ekitundu.
answer_d: Banoonnyereza ku lwaki balondeddwa ebikolwa by'obugubi eby'omulembe okuva mu kibinja ekyalondeddwa, nga balowooza ku bintu gamba ng'ebyo bye baagala n'enkolagana yaabyo n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Kiki ekibiina ky'ebipimo ekisobozesa okumanya obutuufu bw'ebyo omuyizi by'atuuseeko mu kusoma kwe?
answer_a: Bakozesa obutuufu ennukuta z'oluyimba olukoleddwako.
answer_b: Bakozesa obumanyifu bw’amaanyi n’obunafu nga bwekyetaagisa nga bakuba oluyimba. ■ Bakuumira ddala entindo y’ebiseera nga bakuba oluyimba, nga bagoberera obulungi obubonero obulaga engeri y’okukubaamu oluyimba.
answer_c: Ban ব্যাখ্যা accurately olutindo n'ennyimba ezikwatagana n'omuziki ogwo. ■ Bakozesa bulungi ebintu eby'enjawulo ebikwata ku bwangu n'amaanyi mu kuyimba.
answer_d: Bakola bulungi olutalo n'ennyimba ebifanana n'omuyimba ogwo. ■ Bongeramu ebintu mu kunnyonnyola gamba ng'okuyimirira, okutegeka, n'okwogera, n'ebirala.

question: Ku ntandikwa y’essomo ly’Okusiiga mu Bwangu mu Byafaayo by’Obuwangwa, erikwata ku muwendo ogw’akabonero ogw’ebikolwa mu mbeera z’obuwangwa, omusomesa agenda kukola okukebera okuzuula okumanya oba abayizi be ab’ekitongole eky’omukaaga bategeera ekigendererwa eky’okulaga ekyolekeddwa omulongo gw’ebikolwa. Bw’amala okwekenneenya eby’addamu, akiraba nti abayizi abasinga obungi balaga engeri z’emirongo, enkula, n’ebiragala by’ebisiige, nga tebalaga birowoozo bye biraga. Kino kimutegeeza nti alina okukolagana nabo ku kwegatta kw’okutegeera okw’akabonero okw’ebifaananyi mu bikolwa bino. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisobola okuyamba abayizi okutegeera engeri y’okwekenneenya ekigendererwa eky’okulaga eky’ekikolwa?
answer_a: Omusomesa asaba abayizi okwetegereza ebikolwa by'obuyiiya eby'omulembe guno era balonde ensonga enkulu eziddwamu mu byo.
answer_b: Omusomesa aleeta eri abayizi ebikolwa by'obuyiiya ebya sasaano era n'abasaba okutegeera engeri z'okwolesa n'enkola abayiiya ze baakozesa.
answer_c: Omusomesa aleeta ebifaananyi by’obuyiiya obw’omulembe eri abayizi era n’abasaba okuwandiika ku nneewulira emibala oba enkula ze biraga mu bifaananyi ebyo.
answer_d: Omusomesa alaga abayizi ebimu ku bintu ebikolebwa abakugu mu by'obukugu ebya leero era n'abasaba okulaga endowooza y'ensi abakugu bano gye baalina nga basinziira ku kunoonyereza ku bintu bye balabye mu bintu ebyo.

question: Omusomesa akola omutwe gw'ekitabo Abantu n'Ettaka mu kibiina kya munaana, ng'alowooza ku kiruubirirwa: "Okukola maapu y'obulamu bwabwe nga basinziira ku ndowooza, enneewulira, n'ebirowoozo okuva mu bulamu bwabwe." Okukola maapu eno, omusomesa ateesa okukozesa omutendera gw'okukoola ebintu. Nkola ki ey'emirimu esinga okusaana okukulembera abayizi mu kukola maapu yaabwe ey'obulamu?
answer_a: Kola akakonge ak'ebyamuwandiika ku bulamu bwo, keelereza ebitundu byako eby'enjawulo, ssaawaate ekiwoobe, era oteekemu obutundutundu bw'akakonge ako.
answer_b: Gattako ebifaananyi mu maapu, gamba nga okusiiga n'okukuba ebifaananyi, nonnyereza ku bifo ebiragiddwa mu maapu eyo.
answer_c:
Nze [Erinnya Lyo], nnazaalibwa [Ennaku z'amazaalibwa go] mu [Ekifo gy'ozaalibwa]. Obuto bwange nabumalira mu [Ekifo we wakulira], nga nneenyumirwa [Ebintu bye wayagalanga nga oli muto]. Okusoma kwange kwatandikira ku [Erinnya ly'essomero lyo eryasooka], oluvannyuma ne nneegatta ku [Erinnya ly'essomero lyo erya waggulu]. Mu kiseera kyange ekyo, nnayiga [Ebintu bye wayiga bye wayagalanga]. Kati nsomera ku [Erinnya ly'essomero lyo erya kati] nga nsoma [Kki ky'osoma]. Ebirooto byange bya ku bba [Kki ky'oyagala okukola mu biseera eby'omu maaso].

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina kya S.3, mu mutwe gw'ekigambo Eby'ennyimba Bye Bitulaga, atandika okukwata ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okukola omulimu omutono ogw'ennyimba nga bakolagana nga basinziira ku mbeera y'amaloboozi egimu, nga bakozesa eddoboozi lyabwe, emibiri gyabwe, ebivuga by'ennyimba, n'ebintu ebiwanika amaloboozi eby'enjawulo, okusobola okunoonyereza ku maloboozi agali okumpi agazingizza abayizi." Nkola ki esaanira abayizi okutandika okukolera ku kiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Okunoonya ebintu eby'amaloboozi ebitali bimu ebiyambako mu nkola y'okutondawo ennyimba.
answer_b: Okunoonyereza ku mbeera z'amaloboozi mu byalo n'ebibuga
answer_c: Okutegeera n'okuwuliriza amaloboozi ag'enjawulo agakola obutonde bw'amaloboozi obw'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okulonda ebivuga by'omuziki buli muntu mu kibinja ky'amanyi okukozesa n'abikozesa mu lujjudde.

question: Omusomesa ateekateeka omutwe "Okukuba ebifaananyi n'Ekitabo ky'Omukubi w'Ebifaananyi" ku kibiina eky'Omwaka ogw'Olubereberye, nga yeesigamiziddwa ku kiruubirirwa: "Okumanya n'okukozesa obukodyo bw'okukuba ebifaananyi." Ku somo erisooka, yandironze obukodyo bw'okuzaala ebifaananyi obusobozesa okutandika okuyiga okukuba ebifaananyi era obutuukana n'embeera y'ekibiina, kubanga abayizi tebalina bikozesebwa bya njawulo. Kiki ekijja okusobozesa abayizi okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa ekyateekebwawo?
answer_a: Londa ebifaananyi eby'okukozesa mu kukuba ebifaananyi ku sikuliini.
answer_b: Kola akakomo k'okukuba ebifaananyi nga okotola.
answer_c: Kola dduyiro z'obuwaze ku matiriksi ng'okozesa enkola ya "drypoint".
answer_d: Okutandikawo bizinensi empya nga kisinziira ku mutwe gw'abakyala be balondedde.

question: Okubuulirira abayizi ku kyakola omutwe ogugamba Okumanya Abalanzi b'Ebifaananyi Ab'omulembe n'Okuddamu Okukola Ebikolwa Byabwe, omusomesa wa siniya ategese okukola essomo n'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okuna mw'anaatambulira ku mirimu gya Frida Kahlo, ng'asinga kwetikka obukulu bw'ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwe mu bitonde by'obulunzi bwe. Ng'omulimu, anaasaba abayizi okuddamu okutondeka ekifaananyi ky'omulunzi okusinziira ku birowoozo byabwe n'engeri zaabwe. Mu nkola y'okutonda ebifaananyi ebitonotono, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi bakoppa ebikolwa mu kifo ky'okubiddamu. Bibuuzo ki ebisaana omusomesa okubuuza abayizi okubalagirira n'okwanguya okwolesa ebirowoozo byabwe mu bikolwa byabwe?
answer_a: Ebintu ki ebyaliwo mu bulamu bwa Frida Kahlo bye yayolesa mu bikolwa bye? Birowoozo ki by'olabye nti yali ayolesa? Bifaananyi ki na langi ki ze wandikozesezza okukiikirira ebirowoozo ebyo?
answer_b: Olowooza omulimu gwa Frida Kahlo gwandibadde guteebwa gutya singa yali n’obulamu obutalimu kubonaabona kungi? Wandikiikirizza otya okubonaabona? Biki ebifaananyi n’embalaasi ze wandikozesezza?
answer_c: Biki ebikubaddeko mu bulamu bwo ebikufaananya ku ebyo ebyatuuka ku Frida Kahlo? Birowoozo ki ebijjukizo ebyo bye bikuleetera? Bifaananyi ki na langi ki z’olowooza nti byandiyolesezza ebirowoozo ebyo?
answer_d: Ojukira engeri ebintu Frida Kahlo bye yakozesanga mu kukuba ebifaananyi ze zaali zitya? Engeri gy’akozesaamu ebintu ebirabika ng’ennimi eyongera etya ku ngeri gy’alagaamu enneewulira ze? Bintu ki ku by’akola byandikusiimye okukozesa mu bifaananyi byo?

question: Omusomesa ateesa eri abayizi be okukiikirira omuwendo gw'ebintu n'ebipapula by'ensimbi n'ensimbi eza kyuma, oluvannyuma ne bawandiika ekiikirira kino mu bbaluwa zaabwe. Mulimu ki omusomesa gw'asinga okwogerako mu bikolwa bino?
answer_a: Okugatta
answer_b: Omukutu gw'ebifo
answer_c: Okugeraageranya ennamba
answer_d: Okutumbulula ennamba

question: Lwaki okukozesa ebikokko by'emisingi emingi kusobozesa abayizi okukozesa obulungi okugatta nga balina bye batisse?
answer_a: Kubanga bategeera omukwanaganyo omufupi ogw'okugatta nga twetikka.
answer_b: Kubanga bateeka digito mu nteekateeka entuufu nga bamala ggonjoola ekibalangulo.
answer_c: Kubanga bakwataganya okubala mu bwongo n'ebintu ebikwatika okugattako
answer_d: Kubanga bakuŋŋaanya ebintu mu kkumi okubyongera ku kifo ekiddako

question: Soma ekigendererwa ky'omuyizi ow'ekibiina eky'okusatu kino: "Laga okutegeera okw'omulamwa gwa engelo: okulaga eby'okulabirako bya engelo mu butonde, okubalanguza ekipimo kya engelo, okukozesa engelo eza 45° ne 90° ng'ebipimo". Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera okutegeera kwabwe?
answer_a: Kika ky'enjuyi ez'enjawulo
answer_b: Kola engulu z’ebipimo ebyenjawulo.
answer_c: Tegeera engeri enjawulo z’empuyi mu kiifananyi
answer_d: Pima empimo z'enjuyi ez'enjawulo ng'okozesa ekipima ky'enjuyi.

question: Omusomesa alagira ennamba ez’ekifo ky’ekkumi era bw’amala okwogera: ‘Ttaano n’obukadde bubiri,’ akiraba nti abayizi bangi bawandiise 5.2000. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano wansi, kiruwa ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukozesa okutereeza ensobi eno mu by’abayizi bye bazzeemu?
answer_a: Wandika namba ez'ekifo (decimal numbers) mu bigambo.
answer_b: Sengeka ennamba ez’ekifo ku lukalo lw’ennamba
answer_c: Teeka namba ez'ekifo mu chaati y'omuwendo gw'ekifo.
answer_d: Gerageranya namba ez’ekifo (desimoolo) ezirina omuwendo gw’ebifo ogw’enjawulo

question: Omusomesa asaba abaana okubuulira bannaabwe abantu abakola omuryango gwabwe, nga boogera abakulu bameka, abavubuka bameka, n’abaana bameka abali mu buli muryango. Oluvannyuma, bakola akapanel ke bagenda okuterekako ebifananyi ebyasaliddwa ebiraga omuwendo gwonna ogw’ajjajja, abazadde, abavubuka, n’abaana abali mu kibinja kyonna. Mulamwa ki omusomesa gw’asinga okukolako mu mulimu ogunnyonnyoddwa?
answer_a: Okutwalira awamu okw'obukulembeze
answer_b: Okukwanisa omuwendo
answer_c: Omukwanaganyo gw'ebintu mu ntegeka yaabyo
answer_d: Okusalibwa ng'omusumeeno

question: Kiri ku bino wammanga kiki omuntu ky'ayiga mu kubala ebintu nga abitegeka mu ngeri ennungamu?
answer_a: Okukola ebibazo by’okugatta n’okwawuza ebiragiro.
answer_b: Okutegeera nti ennamba zirina enteekateeka ennamu okuyita mu njawulo z'obunene
answer_c: Okutegeera nti bw'oba osala ekifaananyi ky'ennamba, akabonero kano kategeeza nti ennamba zonna ezaakubaddewo zirimu.
answer_d: Okukakasa nti newankubadde enkyukakyuka mu nteekateeka y’okubala, bulijjo kivaamu ekibuuzo kye kimu.

question: Soma embeera eno: Josefa akola ennyiriri bbiri nga buli emu erimu basirikale b'ekidomola bataano. Omusomesa amusemberera namubuuza: "Waali waliwo abasirikale abasinga obungi?" Oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu, omusomesa akuŋŋaanya abasirikale abalala okuva mu lumu ku nnyiriri namubuuza: "Waali waliwo abasirikale abatono?" Mulamwa ki ogw'ekibalangulo omusomesa gw'ayagala okukakasa mu mbeera eyo waggulu?
answer_a: Okusengeka ebintu mu mutindo.
answer_b: Obusinziiro
answer_c: Okukuuma obutonde bw’ensi
answer_d: Okukyusa obuzza bwe butyo

question: Kibuuzo ki ku bino wammanga ekikubiriza enkulaakulana y’omulamwa gw’okugabanya mu balenzi n’abawala?
answer_a: Joaquín yalina biskuuti 8 n’awa mukwano gwe 4. Yalina biskuuti bimeka ebyasigalawo?
answer_b: Miguel yakola kkeeki 6 era buli kkeeki yalina ebikata 2. Obuwumbi bw'ebikata byonna wamu bungi ki mu kkeeki zonna?
answer_c: Nicolás yazimbye eminaala 5 nga buli munaala alina lego 4. Nicolás yakozesa lego meka okuzimba eminaala gyonna?
answer_d: Ricardo alina ebitebe 6 n’abiteeka ku mmeeza 3, ng’ateeka omuwendo gwe gumu ku buli emu. Waliwo ebitebe bimeka ku buli mmeeza?

question: Mu kibiina eky’omunaana, omusomesa aleeta ekigendererwa kino eri ekibiina: okukola enkyukakyuka ez’ekitendero, ez’ekifo, n’ez’endabirwamu mu lukoloboze lwa Katisiyaani. Oluvannyuma, atekateeka ekibiina mu bibinja okugenda mu kisenge ky’ekkompyuta mw’ateekeddwa pulogulaamu y’ebibalangulo by’ebintu ebifaanaanyirizi abayizi gye bamanyi. Mu pulogulaamu eyo, abayizi balina okukola enkyukakyuka ez’ekitendero eziri mu bubiri ez’ekika kye gimu (enkyukakyuka ez’ekitendero ebbiri nga zikolera ku katengo ke kamu, endabirwamu ebbiri nga zikolera ku layini z’omuteeko, oba enkyukakyuka ez’ekifo ebbiri) omusomesa z’aba awadde. Ku lubaawo, omusomesa awandiika ekibuuzo okulung’amya omulimu. Mu bibuuzo bino wammanga, kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okukozesa okulung’amya omulimu gw’abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekigambiddwa?
answer_a: Kiki ekibaawo ng’omugatte gw’enkyukakyuka gukoleddwa?
answer_b: Buzibu ki bwe wasanze ng'okola enkyukakyuka eziddiring'ana?
answer_c: Buli lukoloboze lwa bifaananyi lusobola lwonna okutegeerekeka nga lweyambisiddwa enkyukakyuka emu yokka?
answer_d: Ebintu ebikozesebwa mu buli nkola y’okukyusa ebintu bwe biruwa?

question: Mu mbeera y’okugonjoola ebizibu nga tukozesa omukolera gwa affine, nsobi ki abayizi ze basinga okukola?
answer_a: Enkyukakyuka zikwatagana butereevu, nga bwe kiri mu mikutule egy'emirongoofu
answer_b: Omusengeko gw'emikutu gyonna egya affine gwa positive kubanga gissibwa mu quadrant esooka ey'ennyanguyirizi ya Cartesian.
answer_c: Enkyukakyuka zikwatagana mu bukwatane obw’omugattiko, obutafaanana nga bwe kiba ku nkola za layini empanvu.
answer_d: Omukutuko ku eksisi-yaki eya ffunsa za afiini zonna nnyoimu kubanga zisiigiddwa mu kyakuna ekisooka eky'ennyanguyirizi ya Kaluteeziyo.

question: Ku biragiro by’okukebera ebikozesebwa wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera ekigendererwa ky’omuyizi ow’ekibiina ekya 10/11 ‘Okulaga omulamwa gwa Pythagorean n’omulamwa ogukyusiddwa ogwa Pythagorean?’
answer_a: Lambulula, nga weekozesa ebintu ebirambika, omukwano oguli wakati w'obugazi bw'ebikwaada ebyazimbibwa ku magulu g'omukoona ogwa layini ne bugazi bwa kikwaada ekizimbibwa ku layini enzigiizi.
answer_b: Ggonomesa ebizibu ng’okozesa akatundu ka Pythagorean ne nkyukakyuka yaako, ng’olambulula buli mutendera.
answer_c: Weetegereze omukwano oguli wakati w’amagulu n’olusekkati olw’ompeto ennesimbu nga osinziira ku nnimi za Euclid.
answer_d: Kozesa ebinyigizo bya Payisagolaasi, okukakasa teolemu ya Payisagolaasi n’ekigattako kyayo.

question: Omusomesa mu Ssomero Eya Wakati ayagala abayizi be bayige 'okugonjoola okwongerako n'okwawuza namba ezirimu akawumbi'. Ku biragiro by'okukebera ebiddwa wammanga, ekiragiro ki ekisinga okuba ekituufu, okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky'omusomesa?
answer_a: Balirira ekivaamu nga mugattako oba okwawuza namba ezirimu omukisa.
answer_b: Balanguula okugatta n'okwawuza namba ez'ekika ky'ekyawuzo ennungi n'embi
answer_c: Londa okwongerako n'okwawuza namba ezirina omugatte ogusobola okukozesebwa okugonjoola ekibuuzo eky'ekiweereddwa
answer_d: Okumala okumanya obukulu bw'ebivaamu ebifunika mu kumalawo ebizibu ebizingiramu okugatta n'okwawuza ennamba ez'ekicweka.

question: Mu siniya, omusomesa ayagala okukozesa engeri z'ebikunizo bya logarithms ng'akolagana n'ebitundu ebirala. Mu bibuuzo bino omusomesa by'ateese, kiki ekisobola okukolebwako nga tukozesa engeri zokka ez'ebikunizo bya logarithms?
answer_a: Omunnyo gwa pH ogw’ekintu gupima embeera y’obutiddwa oba obuzzi bw’ekyo nga tukozesa omugatte pH = −log[H+], we [H+] gy’eri obungi bw’obuziba bwa haidrojeni mu mooli buli liita. Bwe kiba nti omunnyo gwa pH gw’ebbugga guli 3.0, [H+] kiba ki?
answer_b: Puleesa ya hajjeni (pH) mu lukulukuta epima embeera y'obukali oba obunnyogovu bwalyo nga tukozesa omugatte pH = −log[H+], we [H+] kwe bungi bwa hajjeni ayoni mu mooli buli liita. Ki kye kiyinza okuba puleesa ya hajjeni (pH) y'ekintu ekirina [H+] nga 3.4*10−8?
answer_c: Amaanyi agafulumizibwa mu musisi gapimwa ku kipimo kya Richter nga tukozesa omukwanaganyo logE = 1.5R + 11.8, E weeri amaanyi agafulumiziddwa mu ergs ate R bwe bunene bw'omususni ku kipimo kya Richter. Amaanyi agaafulumizibwa mu musisi ogwa Valdivia mu 1960 gaali gatya, nga obunene bwaagwo bwali 9.6?
answer_d: Amaanyi agava mu musisi gapimwa ku kipimo kya Richter nga tukozesa fomula logE = 1.5R + 11.8, E gy'amaanyi agavaayo mu ergs ate R bwe bungi bw'amaanyi ku kipimo kya Richter. Singa amaanyi agava mu musisi guba 1025, obungi bw'amaanyi bwabwo buba bungi ki?

question: Omusomesa w’omu mwaka ogw’okuna mu siniya alina enteekateeka y’ebyo by’agenda okusomesa, mw’asuubira abayizi okutegeera emisingi egikwaatagana n’okugabana okwa bulijjo. Omusomesa agenda kukozesa masomo abiri agejjayo okukwasizaako ku ebyo bye bayize edda ebigenda okwanguya abayizi okutegeera ebipya bye bagenda okusoma. Mu ngeri ki eno wammanga mw’osobola okutegeka amasomo ago mu ngeri esinga okuba entuufu okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Ekibiina 1: Tegeera omulamwa gw'enkyukakyuka eya kyebalanga eyawukana ng'omukwanaganya ebintu ebiri mu kifo ky'okukebera n'ennamba entuufu. Ekibiina 2: Kozesa omulamwa gw'enkyukakyuka eya kyebalanga eyawukana okwekenneenya enkekera z'obukkakkamu mu mbeera ez'enjawulo.
answer_b: Ekibiina 1: Nnyonnyola amakulu g'ekikyusabukyusa ekitali kikomekko. Ekibiina 2: Kozesa emiramwa gy'omukolo gw'obungi n'okugabana kw'obuwangwa mu kikyusabukyusa ekitali kikomekko.
answer_c: Ekibiina 1: Geraageranya engeri z'ebibiina by'ebipimo bibiri oba okusingawo ng'okozesa ebipimo eby'obuwangwa obwa wakati n'ensaasaanya. Ekibiina 2: Kakasa nti aw средний y'ebipimo eby'omugaso ogwa n, ebiggyibwa mu bantu, gisaasaanyizibwa mu бунга nga omuwendo gw'ebipimo bwe gweyongera.
answer_d: Ekibiina 1: Bala era onnyonnyole amakulu g'omuwendo ogwa wakati (arithmetic mean) ogw'ebintu ebitagattiddwa mu bibinja. Ekibiina 2: Bala era onnyonnyole amakulu g'obupimo obwa bulijjo (standard deviation) obw'ebintu ebitagattiddwa mu bibinja.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Mu kibiina eky’okuna, omusomesa akola omulimu oguddako n’abayizi be mu somo ly’ekibalangulo:
1. Bakola ebibinja by’emiti gy’oluyeye 10, bye basiba ne tepi emmyufu.
2. Oluvannyuma, bakola ebibinja bya 10 nga birimu ebibinja by’emiti egisibiddwa ne tepi emmyufu. Bino bisibwa ne tepi eya kiragala.
3. Mu nkomerero, bakola ekibinja ekipya ekya 10 nga kirimu ebibinja ebisibiddwa ne tepi eya kiragala. Bino bisibwa ne tepi eya bbululu.
Ku nkomerero ya buli mutendera, omusomesa abuuza: "Emitti gy’oluyeye emeka gye balina nga gisibiddwa ne tepi?".
Kigendererwa ki omulimu ogwo waggulu kye gusuubira okukulaakulanya?
answer_a: Tegeera nti ekikolwa eky'okwegatta kigendana n'okugatta.
answer_b: Tegeera omugatte gw'omuwendo ogw'ekifo ky'ennamba mu namba.
answer_c: Tegeera engeri енти eya namba ey'ekumi gy'ezimbibwa.
answer_d: Tegeera engeri ennamba gy’eyawulwamu okusinziira ku muwendo gw’ekifo kyayo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okuna mu pulayimale agenda kukolera wamu n’abayizi be okugonjoola ebikwatagana eby’omutendera ogumu nga bakozesa okugatta n’okwawuza, kale nno ayagala okubanjulira, ku ntandikwa y’ekibiina, omukolo ogukubiriza okumanya kw’abayizi kwe baalina edda okukwatagana n’omutwe guno era gubayambe okumanya ebipya obulungi. Ku mikolo gino wammanga, gumu ki gusobozesa omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyateesebwa?
answer_a: Tegeera omukwano ogw’enjawulo wakati w’okugatta n’okwawuza
answer_b: Ggwekolola okugatta nga okukozesa omulingo gw'okwawulaawula
answer_c: Leeza alina ebitabo 15. Agabidde banne 7. Ebitabo bimeka Leeza by'akyalina?
answer_d: Balirira ebiva mu kwongerako n'okwawuza nga mukozesa okubala mu bwongo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa alimu okusomesa enfaanana z'ebifaananyi eby'ekibalangulo, ng'asinga kwetikka ku misingi egifaanagana ku bifaananyi byonna eby'ekika ekimu. Musingi ki omusomesa gw'alina okwogerako eri abayizi be ogw'ebika byonna ebya trapezium?
answer_a: Enkwanizo zaabyo zilingaanira.
answer_b: Enjuyi bbiri zokka ezitali ziggavu ze ziba ezikwatagana.
answer_c: Enkoni enkyamu zokka ze ziba entukuvu.
answer_d: Embalirira zombi ez’enjuyi ezitoolodde ziri mu kwegendana.

question: Soma omulimu oguddako: Mu kitundu kya 'Empalirizo z'ekibalangulo n'okukwanisa', omusomesa w'abaana abato akola ku mutindo gw'ebintu. Okukola kino, agenda kuwa abaana ebintu ebirimu ebintu bibiri ebikyuka n'ekintu kimu ekitali kyakyuka, basobole okukola emisono gyabwe. Nga twekenneereza embeera ennyonnyoleddwa, kiki ku bintu bino ekyetaagisa okukozesebwa abaana okukola olukalala olulina ebintu ebiragiddwa?
answer_a: Empiira ennene n'entono ez'embala bbiri: emmyufu n'emimyale.
answer_b: Emmunyeenye emmyufu ennene n'emmunyeenye enzirugavu entono
answer_c: Bbiika z'ebinywera ez'ekika kye gimu era nga za langi bbiri: enjeru ne kiragala.
answer_d: Ebikopo ebimyufu ebinene n'ebito, ebijiko ebya bbulu ebinene n'ebito

question: Omusomesa akoledde n'abayizi be ku kibalangulo kya 'quadratic function' era ayagala okukebera oba basobola okukwataganya ekibalangulo kino n'embeera za bulijjo. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gwe gujja kubasobozesa okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Abayizi bakola ebikunizo eby'enjawulo ebikwaata ku nkola za kiyunkyo ezikwatagana n'omugereko ogw'okubiri.
answer_b: Abayizi bamala okutegeera enkola za kiy квадратик ezikola модели z'embeera ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Abayizi balondoola okuva ku ggalafu ebipimo ebya waggulu ennyo, ebipimo ebya wansi ennyo, n'emirandira gy'emikwanagiro gya kkyuwaaddiriki.
answer_d: Abayizi basiiga ebifaananyi by'emikwanjo egya kiyunifu egikiikirira embeera ezabulijjo era ne beekebejja ebipimo byagyo.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okusatu yassaawo ekiruubirirwa mu kibiina kye nti abayizi be baddemu ebibuuzo by’ekibalangulo ebiva mu mizannyo gy’obutaala. Ku lw’ekyo, baakola ebibuuzo ebisobola okuddibwamu okuyita mu kugezesa. Mu bibuuzo bino, omusomesa bye yabuuza abayizi, kibuuzo ki ekirimu okukola okwegezesa okw’obutabanguko okukiddamu?
answer_a: Bw’oba ozinguludde ddooli emirundi amakumi abiri, emirundi emeka obwenyi obutunuulaganye gye bugatta obubonero musanvu?
answer_b: Bw’oba ozinguludde eddaala emirundi amakumi asatu, emirundi emeka obubonero mukaaga we bulabikira ku ludda olw’oku ntikko?
answer_c: Bw’oba ozinguludde eddadiro emirundi amakumi abiri, bwe bungi bw’obubonero obusinga obungi obusobola okufunika nga obugatte bw’ebyengulu by’eddadiro ebiri waggulu?
answer_d: Bw’oba ozinguludde eddaala emirundi amakumi asatu, mugabo ki ogw’okuba ebyenyi waggulu bigatte wamu bibeere wansi w’obubonero amakumi asatu?

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okusatu agenda kukebera oba abayizi be bayize okukola ebipande ebiraga omuwendo (ba chati) nga bakozesa ekigera. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, ngeri ki omusomesa gy’asaanidde okukozesa okukakasa nti ekyo kye yabadde ayigiriza abayizi bakimanyi?
answer_a: Banoonyereza ku data ekuŋŋaanyiziddwa okuzimba ekyaati ennyangu erina ekigero.
answer_b: Basalawo ekigeranyo ekituufu ku busimba n’obugalamiro bw’ekyaati okusinziira ku deta eriwo.
answer_c: Bategeka data ebakung'aanyizza mu ngeri entuufu nga tebannagireeta mu chaati erina ekigero.
answer_d: Bakola olukalala lw’ebibuuzo olubasobozesa okufuna data emala okubasobozesa okukola akabonero akangu aka bbaala nga balina ekigero.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omwaka ogw’okubiri ateekateeka ekibuuzo ky’ekitundu kya Jjometri era nga kigenda kubaamu omulimu ogugenda okusobozesa okufuna amawulire agakwata ku mutendera gw’okuyiga abayizi be gwe batuuseeko nga bageraageranya ebifaananyi ebya 2D. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gujja kusobozesa omusomesa okukebera okuyiga okwogeddwako?
answer_a: Noonya ebintu mu magazini ebifaanana ebishushani bya 2D ebitali bimu era obiteme.
answer_b: Lambaaza enjuyi z'ebintu eby'embala ezitaliiko bugulumivu era obale.
answer_c: Londa ekibinja ky'ebifaananyi ebya 2D okusinziira ku muwendo gw'enjuyi ze birina.
answer_d: Londa ebifaanaanyi bya 2D ebikwatagana n’endabika y’ebyengulu by’ebintu ebimu ebya 3D

question: Mu kibiina kya P.3, omusomesa aleeta essomo ng’alina ekigendererwa ky’okuyigiriza abayizi okutegeera engulu mu butonde obubetoolodde n’okubalirira obunene bwazo, ng’akozesa engulu eza 45◦ ne 90◦ nga akabonero. Mu kutumbula essomo, omusomesa yakubye emigga esatu egyetoolodde ku lubaawo okulaga enjawulo mu bipimo byazo. Oluvannyuma yabuuza oba balaba ku ngulu ezo mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo. Omuyizi omu yaddamu: Bwe nzina mu kifo ky’ebizino, omusomesa atusaba okukyusa omubiri gumu ku gumu, era abikuba ku lubaawo mu ngeri y’emu. Nga tutunuulidde okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’essomo, kuddamu kw’omusomesa kwani okusinga okukozesa obulungi okuyingira kw’omuyizi?
answer_a: Tulekeere ku bbaadi ekifananyi ekiraga okukyusa okwa kimu kya kubiri! Engeri y'enkoni ki ekolebwa n'okukyusa okwa kimu kya kubiri?
answer_b: Tulage omutendera ogulinga ekitundu ky'okukyusa mu Cueca! Ekitundu ky'okukyusa kiba diguli mmeka?
answer_c: Tulage ku bbaadi ekifananyi ekiraga okukyuka okwa kimu kya kubiri! Mu mbeera endala ki gye walabye okukyuka okwa kimu kya kubiri?
answer_d: Tulage omutendera ogukwatagana n'ekitundu ky'okukyusa omubiri mu kuzina! Ekitundu ky'okukyusa omubiri kikwatagana n'engero esinga oba etasinga ku 90◦?

question: Omusomesa atadde ekibinja kye eky’abaana abato mu mwetooloole okuzannya omuzannyo gw’ekibalangulo. Okukola kino, akozesa akabokisi akalina akatimba n’obubonero bwa kkadiiboodi; mu muzannyo, ayingiza obubonero obwo kimu ku kimu mu katimba k’akabokisi, ng’akubiriza ekibinja okubala mu ddoboozi erigulumivu. Bw’amala okuyingiza obubonero, abuuza: Mu kabokisi mulimu obubonero bwemeka? Oluvannyuma, akunkumula akabokisi, n’ayiwa obubonero ku kapeti era n’addamu okubuuza: Ku kapeti kuliko obubonero bwemeka? Ku bikwata ku bumanyirivu bw’okuyiga obunnyonnyoddwa, kiki ku bukugu bw’ekibalangulo omusomesa bw’akubiriza mu balenzi n’abawala abali mu kibinja kye?
answer_a: Okugeraageranya
answer_b: Okutegeera ennamba
answer_c: Okulonda Ennamba mu nteekateeka entuufu
answer_d: Okukuuma omuwendo

question: Kiki omwana ky’akola ekiraga nti akulidde okumanya nti omuwendo gw’ekintu tegukyuka wadde nga enkula yakyo ekyuse?
answer_a: Esteban aweereddwa ekibinja ky'obbalaasi munaana, abala era nagamba nti ziri munaana. Oluvannyuma, abuuzibwa okulaga omuwendo gw'obbalaasi ze yabaze ku lukalo lw'ennamba. Esteban alaga n'olugalo lwe ennamba munaana.
answer_b: Emilia aweereddwa ekibinja ky'obukubusi buna, abwetegereza n'agamba omuwendo gwabwo. Oluvannyuma, obukubusi obulala busatu bwongerwako ku kibinja ekyo n'abuzibwa: obukubusi bwonna bwe nnina bwemeka? Emilia agamba nti waliwo obukubusi musanvu.
answer_c: Javiera aweereddwa akabinja k'obukomera butaano, abutunuulidde nagamba nti buliwo butaano. Oluvannyuma, alagiddwa akabinja k'emitayimbwa mukaaga era abuziddwa: mu kabinja kano mubaamu ebintu bimeka?, era ng'abala kinnoomu agamba nti mukaaga.
answer_d: Juan alagiddwa ebibatu mukaaga, n'abibala kinnoomu n'agamba nti biri mukaaga. Oluvannyuma, ebibatu bitwaliddwa ne byawulwamu ebibinja bibiri ebyenkanankana era n'abuzibwa: nina ebibatu bimeka muwera? Amangu ago Juan agamba nti biri mukaaga.

question: Omusomesa omuto ow’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya alina enteekateeka y’ekibiina ng’ekigendererwa kye kiri “Okugonjoola ebizibu nga tukozesa obutenkanankana obutereevu obulina ekintu kimu ekitamanyiddwa”. Nga bwe kitwalirwa mu nsonga nti mu bibiina ebyayita baagonjoola obutenkanankana obutereevu mu kintu ekikyuka kimu, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekiyinza okuba ekituufu okukolebwa mu nkulaakulana y’ekibiina, nga tukuumirawo okutambulira awamu n’ekigendererwa ekyogeddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Ggonomola obutenkanankana nga okukozesa akakodyo k'ekifaananyi era weekenneenye ebijjaamu.
answer_b:
Muwala omuzungu alina obuwunga bwa kkiro 50. Ayagala okukola emigaati. Buli mugaati gwe yakola gwetaaga kkiro 2 ez'obuwunga. Migaati emeka gy'asobola okukola?

Teebereza obutenkano obusobola okugonjoola ekizibu kino era okibuulire mu kifaananyi.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola akabonero k'obutenkanonkano n'amakulu g'ebintu eby'enjawulo ebiyinza okuba nga by'omukyusabukyusa kiyinza okuba nga kitwala, nga bwe buweereddwa embeera.
answer_d: Waayo omukwanaganyo gw’obutaliggwaana era ogumaleewo mu lujjudde egyo egireetawo obuzibu, okukakasa okumanya okwabanjalawo.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibina eky’okubiri ateekawo ekigendererwa kino mu kibiina: “Okulagula ekyo ekigenda okubaawo ku buziba bw’amazzi obwenkana obumu bwe gaterekebwa mu kintu ekirala.” Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira abayizi okukola okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo ekiteereddwawo?
answer_a: Kola ebyo ebibaawo ku buziba bw'amazzi obumu bwe butwalibwa mu kintu ekirala, era osale ebifananyi by'ebivuddemu mu katabo kaabwe.
answer_b: Laga ebyavaamu bye bayinza okufuna nga bakozesa ebintu ebisatu eby'enjawulo okuyiwamu amazzi, oluvannyuma okubissa mu nkola.
answer_c: Tegekera omulimu omwangu mwe balina okupima obungi bw'amazzi ne bagateeka mu bintu eby'enjawulo, nga bawandiika bye balaba.
answer_d: Okakasa nti omuwendo gw'amazzi gusigala nga gwe gumu oluvannyuma lw'okuguyiwa mu bintu eby'enjawulo, oluvannyuma muyanjule ebyo bye muzudde mu lukiiko olukulu.

question: Mu by'obuyambi bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okusaana okutandika nakyo okukola ku kiwakulizo ky'ennamba ezirimu digito bbiri okusinziira ku muwendo gwazo ogw'ekifo mu kibiina eky'okubiri?
answer_a: ebikokko bya 'base ten'
answer_b: Eby'ensimbi eza 10 ne 1
answer_c: Obuwujju obw'embala ez'enjawulo bbiri
answer_d: Akati akalaga omukono ogw'ekifo n'ennamba ezisobola okuggyibwako

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okusatu yakolera wamu n’abayizi be ku kulaga okukubisa ng’okugatta okw’emirundi mingi era n’akola akakeeno okulondoola engeri gye bayizeemu. Mu kakeeno kano, abayizi baalina okuwandiika okukubisa okukoleddwa, engeri gye kulagibwamu nga bakozesa okugatta ennamba ze zimu, n’engeri y’okulagaamu okukubisa mu bigambo mu buli buzibu obumaze okugonjoolwa. Bwe yamaze okukebera, omusomesa yakiraba nti omu ku bo yawaayo eky’okuddamu kino ku kimu ku bibuuzo: Ekibuuzo: Bwe mba n’enkoko 6 era buli emu ku zo erina amagulu abiri, amagulu gonna awamu bawera bameka? Eky’okuddamu: 2·6=6+6=12 "Emirundi ebiri mukaaga". Wadde ng’ekyavuddemu eky’enkomerero kituufu, ki ku bigambo bino eby’okuddamu ekiyinza okuwa omuyizi amawulire ag’omugaso okusobola okutegeera obulungi ebiri mu kibuuzo kino?
answer_a: Watuuse ku namba entuufu, naye waliwo engeri endala ey’okukiikiriraamu ekizibu kino? Kuba ekifaananyi ekiraga embeera eno ate okigeregeranye n’ebyo by’ofunye. Waliwo enjawulo yonna?
answer_b: Ebyo by'ozzeemu byonna bituufu, naye okijjukira nti mu mmeeza z'okubisa emirundi 2 ne 6 kye kimu n'emirundi 6 ne 2? Bifaanagana, naye si kye kimu mu kibazo kino. Okitegedde?
answer_c: Ebyavaamu bituufu, naye olowooza okwolesa okukubisa nga weekozesezza ebintu byonna ebyetaagisa? Weetegereze nti owandiise "emirundi 2 mu 6" so si "emirundi 6 mu 2"
answer_d: Omuwendo gwe obaze mutuufu, naye okakasa nti wagoberedde buli ntambwe okukola ekibuuzo? Ddamu weetegereze okulaba entambwe ki gwe wasubwa.

question:
Omusomesa ow’abaana abato akola ku nnamba okuva ku emu okutuuka ku kkumi, ng’asaba abaana okumaliriza olutalo lw’ennamba okuyita mu luyimba "Enjovu Emu Ng’etengejja". Oluvannyuma, okukola ku muwendo, abayita mu luggya okuzannya ng’enjovu.
Mu mbeera eyo eragiddwa, muzannyo ki ku egiddwa wammanga oguyinza okukozesebwa okukola ku musingi gw’omuwendo?
answer_a: Kola amaka g'enjovu, ogabunge okusinziira ku muwendo omulagirwa omusomesa.
answer_b: Geereza omuzeeyi bw’ali ewala, era gerera olubalalo lw’entambula lw’alina okukola okumutuukako.
answer_c: Tambula mu nnyiriri z'enzige, ng'obala amadaala ge bakuba okusinziira ku namba omusomesa gy'alaga.
answer_d: Kola ennyiriri z'enjovu, nga zeekakasa okuva ku nene okudda ku ntono oba okuva ku ntono okudda ku nene, okusinziira ku ekyo omusomesa ky'alaga.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana ali n’abayizi be nga bakola ku kubisa n’okugabiza ennamba ez’omugatte. Mu kiseera ky’ekibiina, omuyizi agamba bwati: “Bwe mbisa ennamba ennambulukufu ennungi bbiri, bulijjo nfuna ekinunulo ekisinga ku nnamba ezo. Bwe kityo kye kimu kibawo bwe mbisa ennamba ez’omugatte ennungi bbiri?” Mu kunnyonnyola okukulu kuno omusomesa kw’awaayo okuddamu omuyizi mu bujjuvu era mu kiseera kye kimu ne kyanguya okutegeera ebyo bye banyumizzaako mu kibiina?
answer_a: Ekibinja ky'ennamba eziteekeddwa mu mutindo gwa kyesiguzo kyeyongerwako ku kibinja ky'ennamba eza bulijjo; n'olwekyo, ekyava mu mpalizo z'ennamba eziteekeddwa mu mutindo gwa kyesiguzo ezirungi kikuuma obulungi bwazo. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako nga tukuba \(\frac{7}{3} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_b: Okusinziira ku makulu, ekyava mu kubisa namba ennungi bulijjo kiba kirungi; n’olwekyo, ekyava mu kubisa namba ezisondeka ennungi nazo zikola ku kiragiro kino. Ka tukole ekimu ku kyokulabirako eky’okubisa \(\frac{7}{2} \cdot \frac{5}{3}\)
answer_c: Ekinunulo ky'ebigera ebirambulukufu ebirungi kiba kinene okusinga ebintu ebigendereddwaamu singa byombi biba binene okusinga 1; n'olwekyo, kimale okuba nti ekintu ekimu kiba kitono okusinga 1 ekintu kino kireme okukola. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako eky'ekigendereddwaamu kya \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_d: Okukiikirira ekifaananyi eky'ekibala ky'emiwendo ebiri egiri waggulu wa ziro kigwa mu kwegatta kw'ebifaananyi bya buli kimu ku miwendo egyo; n'olwekyo, ekyo ekivaamu kiba kisaanye okuba ekitono okusinga egyo. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako nga tukozesa \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{2}{5}\)

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omusanvu alina ky’ayigiriza ku mugatte gw’ennamba nga tezirina kabonero. Bw’abadde ng’akola olusoma olumu olwabadde ku lubaawo, omuyizi omu amubuuza: “Lwaki ebivaamu biba bibi singa wabaawo akabonero akabi mu maaso g’omugatte gw’ennamba nga tezirina kabonero? Wagambye nti omugatte gw’ennamba yonna nga tezirina kabonero guba gwa bulijjo mulungi, kale sitegeera lwaki kibeera kityo.” Mu nnyonyola zino wammanga, ennyonyola ki eddamu ekibuuzo kino obutuufu, ng’ekozesa olulimi omuyizi w’ekibiina eky’omusanvu lw’asobola okutegeera?
answer_a: Akabonero akabi akali mu maaso g'ekigambo kitegeeza "omuwendo ogwongerwako ogwa inverse." Okuva absolute value bulijjo kubeera nene oba okulingana ne zeero, omuwendo gwayo ogwongerwako ogwa inverse bulijjo guba muto oba okulingana ne zeero.
answer_b: Akabonero akalaga obubi (negative) nga kali mu maaso g’ekigambo kitegeeza nti “kyusa akabonero.” Okuva omutindo ogwa absolute value gubeera gwa waggulu oba gulingaanwa ne ziro, okukyusa akabonero kivaamu omuwendo oguli wansi oba ogulingaanwa ne ziro.
answer_c: Akabonero akalaga obubi mu maaso g'ekigambo kyenkanankana n'okukozesa etteeka ly'obubonero mu kubisaamu ennamba nzijuvu. Okuva omutindo ogwa kyenkanyi bulijjo guba mukulu okusinga oba gwenkana ne ziro, nga bwekituukana nti "ennamba ennungi bw'ekubisibwa mu mbi kivaamu mbi," ekivaamu bulijjo kiba kito okusinga oba kyenkana ne ziro.
answer_d: Akabonero akabi akali mu maaso g'ekigambo kyenkanankana n'okuba n'ennamba embi mu maaso g'obuteebentezi. Okuva omutindo ogwa ddala bulijjo guba mukulu okusinga oba gwenkanankana ne ziro ate akabonero akabi kakyusa akabonero munda mu buteebentezi, omuwendo gwakyo bulijjo guba muto okusinga oba gwenkanankana ne ziro.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana agenda kwogera ku kigendererwa "Okutegeera omulamwa gw’omukolwa ogugatta ebintu ebibiri ebikyuka" ng’ayita mu ngeri ez’enjawulo mu ngeri entengejje. Okusooka, agenda kunnyonnyola omulamwa gw’omukolwa ng’akozesa engero z’ekyuma, oluvannyuma agenda kulaga enkolagana wakati w’ebintu ebikyuka eby’omukolwa ng’ayita mu kintu ekikolebwa ekiyamba abayizi okukyusa okuva mu ndagiriro emu okudda mu ndala. Ku bino ebikolebwa wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga era ekiyinza okwanguya enkyukakyuka y’endagiriro eno?
answer_a: Lamba omukolo ku lukoba lwa Kalutaasiyaani.
answer_b: Kiikirira omukwanaganyo nga okuyita mu mmeeza y'ebibalangulo.
answer_c: Londa ebipooli ebirongoofu ebiri mu kiyingiza omukolo.
answer_d: Teekateeka mu ngeri y’ekibalangulo ekinnyonnyola ekintu ekikiikirira omukolo.

question: Omusomesa ateekateeka amasomo g'ekitundu kya Jjometri; naddala, essomo eririna ekigendererwa kino: "Okukozesa omugatte gwa Pyithagolaasi mu kunoonya obuwanvu bw'embiriizi z'empuyira ennesimbu ezitamanyiddwa, ng'olambulula engeri ezikozeseddwa." Buki ki obumanyirivu abayizi bwe balina okuba nabwo okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a:
1) Okumalawo obugazi bw'ebifo bya ssaabusatu.
2) Okumalawo obugazi bw'ebifo bya kwadratu.
3) Okugonjoola ennyingo ezitali nkakafu ez'omulongoofu.
answer_b:
1) Okumala okutegeera emirandira gy'ebibalangulo eby'obutonde.
2) Okumala okutegeera obugazi bw'empuyi ssatu.
3) Okumala okutegeera obugazi bw'ebiramuula.
answer_c:
1) Okumala okutegeera emirandira gy'ebibalanguzo ebya kyebiriga eby'ennamba ez'obutonde.
2) Okumala okutegeera obugazi bw'ebibalanguzo ebya kyebiriga.
3) Okugonjoola ennyingo ezitali za mugalamivu.
answer_d:
1) Okumala okutegeera emirandira gy’ebibalangulo egya kyebiriga egy’ennamba ez’obutonde.
2) Okumala okutegeera obugazi bw’empuyi ssatu.
3) Okugonjoola ennyingo ezitali nkakafu ez’omulongoofu.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku mutwe gw’ekibalangulo gwa Aligebra, era mu masomo ge agagenda okuddako, agenda kwogera ku kigendererwa “Okukiikirira obutenkanankana mu ngeri entuufu, mu bifaananyi, oba mu bubonero.” Okutuuka ku kino, omulimu ogusooka gwakussa essira ku kuleetawo okumanya okwetaagisa okuyamba okutuuka ku kigendererwa kino. Kumanya ki omusomesa kw’alina okusooka okuleetawo mu mulimu ogusooka?
answer_a: 1) Okukyusa okuva mu lulimi obulijjo okudda mu lulimi lw'ekibalangulo. 2) Okukendeeza ku bigambo ebifaanagana
answer_b: 1) Okukolagana okwa namba enzijuvu. 2) Okugonjoola enkyenkanyaanamba ezitali za mugalamivu nga tuyita mu ngeri ez'enjawulo ez'okuzikiikirizaamu.
answer_c: 1) Okutegeera amakulu g'obubonero >, <, ≥, ne ≤. 2) Okunnyonnyola obutenkanankana nga tukozesa olupimo olutali lulungamu.
answer_d: 1) Okulaga obutenkanonkano nga tukozesa ebifaananyi. 2) Okunnyonnyola ebyavaamu okugonjoola obutenkanonkano.

question: Omusomesa ow'ekibiina eky'omukaaga akolera wamu n'abayizi be okugonjoola ebikwatagana eby'olubereberye n'ekintu kimu ekitamanyiddwa, ng'akozesa enkola ez'enjawulo. Mu kiseera ky'ekibiina, omusomesa ayogera ku nkola y'okwawula n'okukwatagana omuntu omu ku muntu omu wakati w'ebigambo ku buli ludda lw'ekikwatagana. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga nti abayizi bayize okukozesa enkola eno mu kugonjoola ebikwatagana?
answer_a:
1) Laga omukwanaganyo 14 = 6 + x mu ngeri entuufu; ng'ekyokulabirako, okukozesa minzaani etali ntende, ng'erina obukubusi 14 ku luuyi olumu n'obukubusi 6 ku lulala.
2) Laga omuwendo gw'obukubusi obupima minzaani eyo waggulu.
3) Laga eky'okugonjoola mu lulimi lw'ekibalangulo: x = 8
answer_b:
1) Muwendo ki bw'ogattako ku 6 ofuna 14?
2) Zuula namba ng'okozesa omukutu 6 + 8 = 6 + x.
3) Laga eky'okuddamu mu lulimi lw'ekibalangulo: x = 8
answer_c:
1) Laga ekizibu "Namba ki bw'ogattako ku 6 ofuna 14?" ng'okozesa ekibalangulo 14 = 6 + x?
2) Ggonjoola ekibalangulo ekyateereddwawo, ofune x = 8.
3) Ddamu ekizibu.
answer_d:
1) Laga ekibuuzo "Bwe mbadde mpeereddwa ppensulo 6 ate kati nnina 14, nnina ppensulo mmeka ku lubereberye?" nga okukozesa ekikwatagana 14 = 6 + x.
2) Ggonjoola ekikwatagana ekyateereddwawo, ofune x = 8.
3) Ddamu ekibuuzo.

question: Enkola ki omusomesa gy’akozesa esobozesa abayizi okutegeera ebiri mu kigendererwa kino: “Okukulaakulanya amateeka g’obubaanirivu, etteeka erigattira awamu, etteeka erikubisaamu, n’omugatte gwabyombi, mu ngeri entuufu, ey’ebifaananyi, n’akabonero, mu mukono oba/era ne pulogulaamu za kompyuta ezisomesa, mu mbeera y’okugonjoola ebizibu.” Mu ngeri zino wammanga, yipi emu ku zino omusomesa z’ateekateeka y’esobozesa abayizi okutegeera ebiri mu kigendererwa kino?
answer_a:
Waaliwo omupiira ogw’omutwe ogusuuliddwa waggulu. Kiki ekiriwo okusinga, okugwa omutwe oba omukira?

Omusawo akebedde abantu 100 okuzuula obulwadde. Ku bantu 100, 40 balina obulwadde. Omusawo alonda omuntu omu ku bantu 100 mu butanwa. Kiki omukisa gw’omuntu oyo okuba ng’alina obulwadde?

Omwana alina ebbala 10 mu nsawo. Ebbale 5 za bbulu, 3 za kyenvu, ate 2 za kiragala. Omwana aggyawo ebbale emu mu butanwa. Kiki omukisa gw’ebbale okuba nga ya bbulu?

Omuntu azannya omuzannyo gw’okusuula eddayisi. Eddayisi erina enjuyi 6, era buli lujuyi lwandikugwawo mu ngeri y’emu. Kiki omukisa gw’omuntu okusuula ennamba 6?

Mu ssomero, abayizi 60 ku 200 bakozesezza entandika y’ekiddaala. Singa olonda omuyizi omu mu butanwa, gwe giki omukisa gw’omuyizi oyo okuba nga yakozesa entandika y’ekiddaala?
answer_b: Okugattika kw'ebintu n'okukutula kw'ebintu kitegeeza ki?
answer_c: Nnyonnyola engeri fomula gye ziggibwamu nga tukozesa ebifaano by'emiti.
answer_d: Londa embeera buli fomula oba etteeka mwe bikozesebwa.

question: Omusomesa wa siniya ey’okusatu ateekateeka amasomo mw’anaakozesa ekigendererwa kino: “Okugonjoola ebizibu by’ekibalangulo kya Euclidean ebikwaata ku misingi gy’emigereko wakati w’emikutu, emisalosalo, n’entenga ku ssaaziringi.” Kiki ku bino ebiri wammanga ekyetaagisa abayizi okukimanya obulungi nga tebannatandika kukozesa kigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Okufaanagana kw'emiramwa gy'ensatumusatu
answer_b: Okukwatagana kw'emiramwa gy'ensatu
answer_c: Ekitundu ky’omuseetwe n’ekitundu ekyasaliddwa mu museetwe
answer_d: Obugazi n'omwetooloolo gw'ekibulungirizo

question: Mu mitwe gino wammanga, gwe guleetera omuntu okusobola okwongera okutegeera ebipimo bya trigonometeri mu mpuyisatu esitudde?
answer_a: Ebifaananyi ebigerekereddwa
answer_b: Omulamwa gwa Euclid
answer_c: Okufaanagana kw'emiramwa gy'ensatumusatu
answer_d: Empewo mu mpeto esatu ennesimbu

question: Soma embeera eno: Oluvannyuma lw’okunnyonnyola abayizi obukulu bw’okujjukira mu bulamu bw’abantu, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga eky’okutegeka ebintu ebikola okujjukira. Olw’ekigendererwa kino, omulimu gw’okunoonyereza ku mutwe guno gusseewo, okukolebwa mu kiseera ky’ekibiina okumala essaawa bbiri, mu bibiri bibiri, mu kisenge ky’ekkompyuta. Omulimu gw’ekibiina: 1. Zuula bintu ki ebikola okujjukira ebiyambako mu nkola y’okujjukira. 2. Kola ekiweebwa ekiraga engeri ebintu bino gye bitegekeddwamu okusinziira ku nkolagana yaabyo mu nkola, ng’oyawula buli kimu ku byo mu ngeri entangaavu. 3. Gamba ku kiweebwa kyo n’obunnyonnyofu, obumpi nga bwe kisoboka, okulambulula engeri okujjukira gye kwatondebwa. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, engeri ki eraga obulungi akabonero k’okukebera akafaanana n’omulimu omusomesa gwe yateese?
answer_a: Abayizi balambulula era boogera ku bitundu by’obwongo ebikuumira ebintu.
answer_b: Abayizi baawula ebitundu by’obwongo ebikola ku kukwatula ebintu n’okukebera enkolagana yaabyo.
answer_c: Abayizi balambulula ebitundu by’obwongo ebikola ku nzijukira era ne bakebera enkolagana yaabyo.
answer_d: Abayizi balambulula ebitundu by’obwongo ebikola ku kukwata ebirowoozo era bannyonnyola buli kimu ku byo.

question: Soma endogologo eno eterekeddwa omuyizi omukulu mu siniya: Ekigendererwa ky’essomero ebya waggulu kwe kutuukirira. Omwaka gwa siniya gwe guba ekigendererwa ky’essomero ebya waggulu. Omwaka gwa siniya kwe kutuukirira. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, eruwa ekiraga ensobi omuyizi gy’akoze?
answer_a: Ennambuluzo erina ebigambo ebisukka mu bisatu.
answer_b: Ekigambululo ekikulu kirimu ekigambululo ekitono mu nnyingo yaakyo ey’amakulu agatuukirawo.
answer_c: Obunene mu kigambululo ekisooka businga obunene mu kigambululo ekyokubiri.
answer_d: Ensonga emu ku nsonga ezikozesebwa ntono, n’olwekyo omuliisa tegusobola kuba gwa bonna.

question: Soma omusango guno: Omusomesa asaba abayizi be okukwataganya endowooza za Plato ne Aristotle ku butuufu bw’ebintu nga bayita mu birowoozo oba endowooza. Enkyukakyuka ki eyogerwa abayizi eraga obulungi enjawulo wakati w’abawandiisi bano?
answer_a: Obulamu n'okufa
answer_b: Ensi n'olusozi lwa Katonda olw'Ekikristaayo
answer_c: Amazima n'obulimba
answer_d: Obusawo n'essomo ly'ebiramu

question: Soma omusango guno: Omusomesa aleeta ebirowoozo bya Jean Paul Sartre ku ddembe ly'omuntu. Omuyizi ayingirawo okulaga nti kimuzibuwalira okutegeera ekirowoozo ky'omuwandiisi nti tewali muntu wa butonde. Mu nnyanukula zino wammanga eziyinza okuyamba omuyizi okutegeera ekirowoozo kya Sartre?
answer_a: Obutafaanana ng’abantu, ebintu ebyakolebwa omuntu, omukozi ng’eky’okulabirako, tebisobola kuba na ntandikwa nga tebinnaba kubaawo ng’omukozi abikola.
answer_b: Okufaanana n'abantu, ebintu ebyakolebwa omuntu, ng'omukozi w'emikono, bisobola okuba n'obuntu obwateekebwawo, naye era, okusobola okubaawo, biteekwa okubaawo.
answer_c: Ffe abantu tetwatondebwawo muntu yenna, kale nno tewali mutindo oba ngeri ya buntu ebibaddeewo nga tetunnaba kukozesa oba okutuukiriza eddembe ly’okukola bye twagala.
answer_d: Abantu baatondebwawo omuntu eyatuwa eddembe ery’okukola (obuyinza okwesalirawo); n’olwekyo, tukola ekyo kye tubeera nga tusinziira ku bikolwa byaffe.

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu mutera gw'ekitabo "Empula z'abantu abaaliko mu Amerika nga Columbus tannajja", omusomesa, bw'aba ng'annyonnyola ebintu ebikulu ebyali bigendererwa mu nkola y'ebyenfuna ey'Abainca, akiraba nti ekibinja ky'abayizi be tekyetegeera kigambo "enkola y'ebyenfuna ey'okugabirira". Awo asalawo okuddamu okunnyonnyola amakulu g'ekigambo ekyo, naye ku mulundi guno ng'akozesa olugero olufaananyi. Ku lugero olufaananyi olulondoolwa wano, lulina akakwate akasinga obulungi ku nkola y'ebyenfuna ey'okugabirira?
answer_a: Ekitundu ky’eggombolola kyazzaayo ssente ezisasulwa omwaka oguwedde olw’okukungaanya kasasiro eri abakadde baamu.
answer_b: Olutalo lw'okunoonya ssente olwa Telethon lwatongozza kampeyini empya okukunganya ssente ezisinga omwaka oguwedde era n'okuzimba nazo eddwaliro eddala erijjanjabira abalwadde abazzeemu obulemu.
answer_c: ONEMI yakozesa obuyambi bwa Gavumenti obwali buteereddwawo okukola ku buzibu obwava mu katyabaga n'okuddamu okuzimba ekitundu ekyakosebwa amataba.
answer_d: Ekitongole kya Hogar de Cristo kyakkendeereza ku bbeeyi y'amayumba gaabwe ag'obuyambi eri abantu abetaaga.

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina eky'omukaaga ku kiruubirirwa kino: okumanya ebifaayo by'ebitundu by'eggwanga eby'ebyobufuzi n'obukulembeze. N'olwekyo, asalawo okugatta omutwe guno ku mawulire gano agakwata ku kutondebwawo kw'essaza lya Ñuble n'okukola okunoonyereza ku nsibuko y'amawulire: Olukiiko lw'abakulembeze lukkirizza okutondebwawo kw'Essaza lya XVI erya Ñuble. Enteekateeka eno, kati etegekeddwa okulangirirwa, era etondawo amasaza amapya asatu. Chile egenda kuba n'essaza lyayo erye kkumi na mukaaga. Kino kyasaliddwawo Olukiiko lw'abakulembeze ku Lwakusatu luno oluvannyuma lw'okukkiriza n'obululu 26 obuwagira, bubiri obuwakanya, n'obutaalina n'omu ataalonze mu nkola yaabwe ey'okusatu omuteeko ogutondawo Essaza lya Ñuble eripya. Enteekateeka eno, kati etegekeddwa okulangirirwa, era egenda kutondawo amasaza amapya asatu: Diguillín (Chillán, Chillán Viejo, Quillón, Bulnes, San Ignacio, El Carmen, Pinto, Pemuco, ne Yungay), Punilla (San Carlos, Ñiquén, Coihueco, San Fabián, ne San Nicolás), ne Itata (Quirihue, Cobquecura, Ninhue, Treguaco, Coelemu, Portezuelo, ne Ránquil). Kika kya mawulire ki omuyizi ky'ayinza okuggya mu mawulire ago agakwata ku nteekateeka y'ebyobufuzi n'obukulembeze bwa Chile?
answer_a: Ebisaanyizo eby'obukugu eby'okukozesa okutondawo eggwanga
answer_b: Enkola y'ebifo eby'enjawulo mu kitundu ng'ekifo ekifugibwa.
answer_c: Ensonga ezisobozesa okukyusa ekitundu okukifuula eky’obuwangaazi
answer_d: Obukulembeze bw'ekitundu nga bwe butondekeddwaawo mu by'obufuzi.

question: Omusomesa ateekateeka okukola okukebera okw’ekiseera n’abayizi abali mu mwaka ogusooka mu siniya okugera ekituukiriddwa ku kiruubirirwa ky’okwekenneenya engeri obuwangwa bwe bukosebwa obutonde bw’ensi yonna okusinziira ku bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo. Ku mirimu egiddannyuma gino egy’okukebera, bayizi ki gye basaanye okukola?
answer_a: Empaka z'okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bintu ebyava mu kutabaganya ensi yonna ku kibuga mwe babeera
answer_b: Okukungaanya ebirowoozo okuteeka enkola y'okutabaganya ensi yonna mu mbeera y'ebiseera.
answer_c: Omuzannyo ogw'okuzannya ogukwata ku bukulu bw'okuyiiya ebipya mu tekinologiya mu by'empuliziganya
answer_d: Omwoleso ku nkola y’okutwalira amateeka g’amawanga amalala mu maka gaabwe emyaka egiyise.

question: Mu kibiina kya Siniya ekya waggulu ekisoma Ebyafaayo by'Amagezi, omusomesa n'abayizi be bakolera ku nzikiriza z'eby'amagezi eza R. Descartes. Mu bigambo bino ebiri wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n'obuzibu abayizi bwe bayinza okusisinkana, obukwata ku kutegeera omulamwa "Ndirowooza, kale ndi"?
answer_a: Fumiikiriza okubaawo kw'endowooza ya Descartes ey'okuba nti "ndowooza, kale ndiwo" (Cartesian cogito)
answer_b: Okubeerawo okukwataganye n'okukozesa okubuusabuusa okw'entegeera.
answer_c: Tegeereza nti obubaawo bukwatagana n’omulimu gw’endowooza.
answer_d: Laga engeri obubaawo bwa "res cogitans" gye bukwaatagana n'obubaawo bwa "res extensa"

question: Omusomesa wa siniya ali mu kuteekateeka essomo ku nkola ya Kant ku ngeri gye tusobola okufunamu okumanya; okukola kino, alina okumanya ebintu abayizi bye bamaze okuyiga ebyetaagisa okusobola okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nkola eyo. Kiki omusomesa ky’alina okukiraba nti abayizi bakimanyi okusobola okutandika okuyiga ku nkola eyo?
answer_a: Tegeera endowooza za D. Hume ne J. Locke ng’ezisoose okuteekateeka endowooza ya I. Kant.
answer_b: Tegeera endowooza y'Abangereza ey'obukakafu n'eyokugezesa ng'emigendo egyakulembera ekirowoozo kya Kant
answer_c: Londa endowooza z'ebiseera n'obwengula ng'enkola y'ebirowoozo ekyetaagisa okumanya, okusinziira ku I. Kant
answer_d: Tegeera endowooza z’ekintu ekirabika (phenomenon) n’ekintu ekitera kulabika (noumenon) ng’obunnyonnyofu bwa Kant ku ekyo ekisobola okumanyika.

question: Omusomesa ayagala okukebera ng'ayita mu kuwandiika okukola abayizi be okulaba oba bategeera ebyavaamu Ennaku Enzimbe okuggwaawo. Ku mirimu egisabiddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikebera ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Kyogere ku nkyukakyuka mu byobufuzi ezaateekebwawo Gavumenti ya Glasnost mu USSR ng’emu ku nsonga eziviiriddeko Ennaku Enzimbe okuggwaawo.
answer_b: Ggavumenti za Reagan ne Gorbachev zaakola ki okukomekkereza olutalo olw'ebbanga?
answer_c: Lagawo engeri emu empanvu n'enjawulo emu wakati w'engeri bbiri ez'ebyafaayo ezikozesebwa okwogera ku nkomerero y'olutalo olw'ebbanga.
answer_d: Okugabana kw'amaanyi mu byobufuzi n'ensi yonna kwali kuteebwa kutya oluvannyuma lw'olutalo olw'ebbanga?

question: Omusomesa agenda kutandika omutwe ogugamba ku 'Enkola z'ebyenfuna n'engeri gye zikosaamu ekitundu', ng'alina ekigendererwa ky'okuleetera abayizi be aba siniya okwekenneenya enkyukakyuka ebibadde mu kifo eky'obuwangwa olw'enkolagana wakati w'ebyenfuna, abantu, n'enkola z'ebifo. N'olwekyo, asazeewo okutandika essomo ng'ajjukiza amakulu g'ekigambo ekifo eky'obuwangwa, ng'ayitira mu kubuuza abayizi mu bibinja. Mu by'abayizi bye baddamu, ebyalaga ekifo eky'obuwangwa ng'ekintu eky'omubiri oba eky'obutonde kyokka byasinga, nga bagamba nti kintu ekitali kyangu kukyuka mu bbanga eritali limpanvu nnyo. Nga tutunuulidde emisingi gy'obuyigiriza egikulembera okusomesa geography, kiki ku gyo ekikulu okukozesa okugaziya endowooza y'ekifo abayizi bano gye balina?
answer_a: Omukwanaganyo
answer_b: Ekifo
answer_c: Okukwatagana
answer_d: Obuvaaviirizi

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina ekisookerwako, mu somo erigenderera "Okunnyonnyola embeera y'obuntu bw'ensi ey'obuwangwa bw'Abaruumi", asaba abayizi okuwandiika olulimi lw'olugendo okuyita mu kitundu ky'ekizinga kya Italy, we balina okusisinkana ebintu by'ettaka n'endabika y'ebifo bye balambula, nga bakozesa ebigambo by'ebyobuntu bw'ensi bye bayize. Okukola omulimu guno, abayizi, nga bayambibwako omusomesa, bateekawo oluguudo lw'olugendo era ne bakisiiga ku maapu, nga balonda ebibuga by'Abaruumi bye banaayitiramu, nga bakozesa amawulire okuva mu nsonda ez'enjawulo okuteekawo engeri z'ebyobuntu bw'ensi ez'ebitundu byonna. Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiruwa ekisaana okukozesebwa okukebera obukugu bw'abayizi okukwatagana n'ekigendererwa ky'omulimu ogwakoleddwa?
answer_a: Banuunye ebitundu obuwangwa bwa Rooma mwe bwakulira mu butuufu.
answer_b: Balaga enkulaakulana enkulu ez’obuwangwa bwa Rooma mu lugendo oluteereddwawo
answer_c: Bannyonnyola ebipimo ebikulu ebikola obutonde bw’ensi obulabika ku maapu y’ekkubo.
answer_d: Baawula empisa ez’enjawulo okuva mu bitundu by’ensi omwatandiikirwa obuwangwa bwa Rooma.

question: Omusomesa ategeka okukwasaganya ekigendererwa kino ekikulu eky’Obutonde bw’Ebyenfuna n’Embeera z’Abantu: 'Okutegeera emirimu egikolebwa abantu b’omu maka gaabwe n’ebyalo byabwe n’omugaso gwabyo eri obulamu obwa bonna.' Bubonero ki obusinga okusaana okukulaakulanya ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Tambula mu katale akali okumpi era osabe abaana bagule ebibala n'enva bwe muba mutambula.
answer_b: Tegekka enteekateeka ey'omuzadde okukyala, ajje annyonnyole engeri ekitundu mwe tuli gye kyatandika n'engeri gye kikyuseemu okumala ebbanga.
answer_c: Mugende mu maduuka agali okumpi nammwe era musabe abaana babuulire abantu abakolerayo nga mwekwatiridde ebibuuzo bye mwategeka.
answer_d: Tambula okwetooloola ebbali w’essomero era mu bifo ebimu, saba abaana okusiiga ebifaananyi by’abantu ababawunyisa.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu "Obwetwaze bwa Chile", akola enteekateeka eno: Ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga: Okunnyonnyola engeri obwetwaze bwa Chile gye bwakulakulanaamu, ng'otunuulira abantu n'ebibiina ebyayambana, abasajja n'abakazi ab'amaanyi, okugenda mu maaso n'okuddirira kw'ensonga z'eggwanga, n'ebimu ku bintu eby'amaanyi ebyaliwo. Ekigendererwa ky'ekibiina: Okwawula engeri abagwira n'abafuzi bwe baali balabaamu ku nsonga y'okweggyako obufuzi. Obukugu bw'okulowooza obukuzibwa: Okulowooza enkalakalira. Ku bikolwa ebiyinza okubaawo wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n'ebigendererwa by'ekibiina era ekisobola okuteekebwa mu nteekateeka?
answer_a: Maliriza omutemwa ogw'ebifaananyi ng'olaga ebiseera by'Obwetwaze.
answer_b: Zimba olubaawo lw'empapula oluliko ebifaananyi n'ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku bazira b'Obwetwaze.
answer_c: Njagaliza okubategeeza nti sisobola kukola ekyo kye munsuubira. Ndi muyambi wa bya bigambo era sisobola kukola bifaananyi.
answer_d: Kola vidiyo ya ddakiika bbiri ng'ozzaawo ekimu ku bintu ebyaliwo mu kiseera ky'Obwetwaze.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu “Enkola y’ebyobufuzi mu Chile”, ateekateeka essomo mw’anaakolera ku musingi gw’obukiikirizi era n’awa ebyokulabirako by’ebifo ebirondeddwa akalulu k’abantu bonna, n’ekigendererwa abayizi be aba 6 oba 7 okutegeera “Obukulu bw’okulonda kw’abantu bonna eri enteekateeka y’eddembe ly’eggwanga lya Chile”. Nga tutunuulidde ekigendererwa ky’essomo, ku biragiro bino wammanga kiki ekisaana okukozesebwa okukebera abayizi ku nkomerero y’essomo eryo?
answer_a: Balondoola abakulu b'ebyobufuzi abalondebwa okukiikirira bannansi.
answer_b: Banannyonnyola obukulu bw’abakungu okulondebwa okusalawo ku nsonga ezikwata ku bantu bonna.
answer_c: Banannyonnyola emirimu egikulu egy'abakungu abakiikirira abantu bwe bamala okulondebwa.
answer_d: Bikola eby'enjawulo ku ngeri z'okwetaba mu demokulasiya ezibaawo mu bulamu bw'abantu n'ebitundu byabwe eby'okumpi.

question: Abayizi mu kibiina ekyokusatu balina okukiikirira engeri ebyafaayo by'omulembe ogwa kati gye byagenda bitondeka okusinziira ku mulembe omukulu ow'ebyafaayo Eric Hobsbawm gwe yassaawo, nga bakola olukalala lw'ebiseera. Okusobola okutuukiriza omulimu guno, omusomesa yabawadde ebiragiro bino: 'Laga ekitundu ekikiikirira "ekyasa ekya 19 ekiwanvu" n'ekitundu ekigatta "ekyasa ekya 20 ekimpi".' Kyokka, bwe yamaze okukebera ebyo abaana bye baakoze, bingi byali bikyamu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu kyokulabirako kino: Miteeko ki egirina okugattibwa mu bayizi okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky'omulimu ogwateereddwawo?
answer_a: Ekintu eky'omugaso ennyo n'embeera enzibu
answer_b: Obugendererevu n'enkyukakyuka
answer_c: Obudde obw'ebyafaayo n'obudde obuteebereza.
answer_d: Ensibuko n'ebivaamu

question: Ku nkomerero y’ekibiina ekikwata ku “Enkola y’Akatale,” omusomesa akola okukebera okw’omukutu okumanya oba abayizi be bategeera ebintu ebireetawo enkyukakyuka mu bwetaavu bw’ekintu. N’olwekyo, omusomesa abasaba okulonda okuva mu by’okulabirako ebiwerako okukozesa embeera eno ku bulamu obwa bulijjo. Mu by’okulabirako bino wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’omukozi w’omuyizi akolerera okutuukiriza ekyo omusomesa ky’asuubira?
answer_a: José: Emyaka nga ebiri emabega, nnali nzimba caaka za chocolate ku kiyosiki ky’essomero, naye okuva etteeka lwe lyakyuka, kati nzirina okuzigula wabweru n’okuzireeta mu nsawo yange ey’omukono.
answer_b: Claudia: Wiiki ewedde twagenda ku mizannyo n'abakozi baffe, naye olw'okuba twakererewa, tetwasobola kufuna tiketi, kwe kusalawo okukozesa ssente ku pizza ne sandwiichi.
answer_c: Jacqueline: Mu luwummula olw'ekyeya, twategeka ne tupangisa ekisaawe okuzannyira omupiira gw'ebigere omulundi gumu buli wiiki, kale nneetaaga okuba ne pesos 1,200 buli wiiki.
answer_d: Ignacio: Okutuusa omwaka oguwedde, nnali nkolaasa ssente ze bampa ku byuma ebikwata ku alubaamu, naye kati olw’okuba sikyagala alubaamu, nterekera ssente ezo okuzikozesa ku kintu ekirala.

question: Omusomesa, oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza omutwe ogugamba ku “Enkola y’amateeka”, agenda kunnyonnyola kiki kye yandikoze okusobola okukakasa oba abayizi be ab’omu mwaka ogw’okuna mu siniya basobodde okutegeera emisingi egigendererwa mu mateeka. Ku bino ebikolebwa wammanga, kiki ekiyinza okumuyambako okukung’aanya obujulizi okusobola okukebera oba ekigendererwa kituukiddwaako?
answer_a: Okukozesa ensibuko, nnyonnyola omulimu gw'eggwanga mu kukuuma obwetwaze bw'ettaka lyalyo.
answer_b: Laga ng'ekyokulabirako okuva mu mawulire eky'omukulu w'ekitongole kya gavumenti ng'annyonnyola ebikolwa bye.
answer_c: Enyonyola obuvunaanyizibwa bw'eggwanga okukuuma obulungi bwa bonna
answer_d: Enjawulo ku bukulu bw’okwetaba mu kulonda mu kutondawo eggwanga

question:
Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okusatu abadde akolera wamu n’abayizi ku mbeera ez’enjawulo ez’obulamu obwa bulijjo obw’Abayonaani ab’edda. Bwe babadde boogera ku nteekateeka y’embeera z’abantu mu byafaayo eby’edda, omuyizi agamba nti: “Abayonaani baali babi”. Omusomesa amubuuza lwaki ayogera bw’atyo, omuyizi n’amuddamu: “Kubanga baalina abaddu”.
Nsobi ki mu kunoonyereza ku byafaayo erabika mu byo omuyizi by’ayogedde?
answer_a: Akebera ebintu ebikulu mu buwangwa bw'Abayonaani ng'ayoleka obusosoze mu mawanga.
answer_b: Yeenyigira mu kukyamya engeri abantu ba Giriki gye baali batengejjerwamu n'engeri Abaruumi gye baali batengejjerwamu.
answer_c: Ateenyoomereza busiraani bw'obuwangwa bw'Abayonaani eri embeera z'abantu ez'omulembe guno
answer_d: Amuwandiikira ebintu eby'omugaso mu byafaayo by'Abayonaani ng'akozesa ebipimo ebiriwo kati.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekinaana akuŋŋaanya abayizi mu bibinja n’abasaba okunoonya amawulire ku yintaneeti agakwata ku butonde bw’ensi obusangibwa mu Chile. Oluvannyuma, abasaba okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bukulu bw’obutonde obwo, ekyandibaddewo singa bubula, n’engeri gye tuyinza okubukuuma leero. Mu nkomerero, buli kibinja kirina okwanjula ebyo bye bazuulidde mu maaso g’ekibiina. Kitiisa ki omusomesa ky’asinga okugenderera okukulaakulanya okuyita mu mulimu ogwo waggulu?
answer_a: Okubuuliriza
answer_b: Okulowooza okukwata ku bwagaagavu
answer_c: Okukozesa obubaka obw'ebifo ebitali bimu (Sources)
answer_d: Okulowooza okw'amagezi

question: Mu kibiina kya ‘kindergarten’, omusomesa agenda kukozesa empapula z’okwetegereza ng’ekyakukozesebwa okukebera okuyiga kw’abaana abato okusinziira ku biragiro bino ebikwata ku mutima gw’okutegeera embeera z’obuwangwa n’obulamu: Anyumya ku bikolwa eby’omumulembe mu kitundu kyabwe. Annyonnyola engeri gy’etabamu mu bikolwa eby’omumulembe mu kitundu kyabwe. Kiki ekiyigirizibwa ekiyinza okukozesebwa okwetegereza okukakasa ebyo abaana bye batuuseeko okukwatagana n’ebiragiro ebyo?
answer_a: Loboza ebikolwa ebibaawo mu kitundu ky'ebyenjigiriza.
answer_b: Mubu mwe muli okwaniriza, baagala okumanya kye mwakola ku wiikendi.
answer_c: Nga mukuŋŋaanidde mu bubinja obutono, mukoppe ebikolwa bya bulijjo bye mukola awaka.
answer_d: Mu bibinja, mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku mirimu ab'omu maka gye bakola mu mikolo gy'amasanyu.

question:
Omusomesa akola ku kitundu ky'Emanya mu mwaka ogwokusatu mu siniya n'abayizi be, era ng'omulimu ogugenderera okutuukiriza ekigendererwa: "Okutegeera obutandikwa bw'okumanya kw'omuntu", bateesa okusoma n'okunnyonnyola Ekitabo kya Descartes eky'Okusooka ku Kulowooza ku By'obutonde.
Kino ku bintu abayizi bye baasooka okuyiga kiki ekyetaagisa okuba nga baakimanyiira ddala okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky'ekibiina?
answer_a: Enneeyisa z'Obwongo n'Obukakafu obw'Embeera
answer_b: Amakulu g'ekigendererwa ky'obuntu n'engeri y'okumanya ebintu.
answer_c: Endowooza ya Tabula Rasa n'ebipimo
answer_d: Empewo z'ensolo n'akatimba ka pineal

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa abadde akolera wamu n’abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya ku mutwe "Okunyweza Eggwanga n’Enkyukakyuka mu Demokulasiya y’Abantu mu Chile mu Kitundu Ekisooka eky’Ekyasa ekya 20". Okukebera oba abayizi bategeera enkola y’okutondawo Ekkubo ly’Abantu Abatutumufu mu Chile, abasaba okukung’aana n’abayizi bannaabwe bataano balonde ekimu ku bibinja by’ebyobufuzi ebya wakati-ku-kkono ebyaliiwo mu Chile mu 1937 ng’omutwe (abalwanirizi b’obukomunisti, abakomunisti, abakyukakyusi, n’abajeemu) era nga basinziira ku biwandiiko ebyakozesebwa mu masomo agayise, baddemu ekibuuzo kino: "Lwaki ekibiina kyandegattiddwa ku Kkubo ly’Abantu Abatutumufu?".
