Oluvannyuma abasaba okukoppa olukiiko lwa paalamenti omuli buli kibiina ekikola kirage ensonga lwaki ekibiina ky’ebyobufuzi kyandegattiddwa oba tekyandegattiddwa ku Kkubo ly’Abantu Abatutumufu. Nga twekenneereza ekitundu ekyokubiri eky’omulimu guno, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisobola okukeberwa?
answer_a: Bano bategeera embeera eyavaako ekibiina kya Popular Front okubaawo
answer_b: Baawula endowooza ezaakola omusingi gw'Ekibiina Eky'Obugagavu.
answer_c: Banannyonnyola emisingi gy'endowooza y'ekibiina kya Popular Front.
answer_d: Bannyonnyola ensonga lwaki Ekitongole kya Popular Front kyatondebwawo

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri mu siniya, mu mutwe ogugamba Nti Okuva mu Nsi Eyawuliddwaamu Ebibinja Ebibiri okudda mu Nsi Enzigumivu: Olutalo Olunyogovu, alina ekigendererwa ky’okukolera ku kigendererwa kino: "Okutegera enkyukakyuka enkulu ez’ebyobufuzi n’ensi yonna oluvannyuma lw’olutalo olunyogovu", ng’asinziira ku by’omukulu ebiri mu by’okusomesa eby’endowooza y’ebyafaayo. Okukola kino, omusomesa awa abayizi maapu bbiri ez’obuaya, emu eya 1960 n’endala eya 2000, ng’abasaba okunnyonnyola ebintu bisatu ebifaanagana n’ebintu bisatu ebyawukana mu by’obufuzi n’ensi yonna. Kintu ki ekikulu mu by’okusomesa ekyogerwako ekisinga okukolebwako mu mulimu ogwoogeddwa?
answer_a: Tegeera ebifaayo ebikulu eby’ebiseera ebyayita mu budde n’ebifo eby’enjawulo.
answer_b: Laga engeri ebintu by’omu byafaayo gye bikyukaamu okusinziira ku biseera.
answer_c: Lagawo enkolagana wakati w'ebipimo eby'enjawulo n'ebigero by'obunene bw'ebifo eby'ebintu ebigwa ku bantu
answer_d: Tegeera nti ebyafaayo kyakuzimbibwa kw'abantu ekikulaakulana mu biseera n'ebifo.

question: Omusomesa akola ku ntandikwa y’ekivvulu ky’obufuzi eky’omu 1973 n’abayizi be ab’ekitongole eky’omukaaga. Omu ku bo amuyimiriza okumubuuza kino: “Omusomesa, sitegeera bw’otugamba nti: ‘Embeera eno yali nsonga y’ekivvulu ky’obufuzi eri munnabyafaayo ono, naye si eri omulala.’ Kati, Abamerika baalina obuyinza bungi ku kivvulu ky’obufuzi eky’omu 1973? Yee oba nedda?”. Kiki ekikyamu ekiyinza okutegeerwa okuva mu kibuuzo ky’omuyizi kino ekikwata ku byafaayo, ng’essomo?
answer_a: Okukendeeza ebyafaayo ne bibeera ng’ebikwata ku nkola za bweru eze ggwanga.
answer_b: Okutaputamu ebirowoozo by'obufuzi mu nnyingo z'eby'afaayo
answer_c: Endowooza y'ebyafaayo ng'ebbaluwa entuufu etaliimu bulimi ku bintu ebyayita
answer_d: Ennyonnyola y'ekintu ekimu ekireetera ebintu eby'emabega okubaawo

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana akola ku mutwe gw’ogw’okuyimuka kw’Obwakabaka bw’Amawanga, ng’agenderera okukulaakulanya obukugu bw’okusoma n’okwekenneenya ensibuko z’ebyamazima, naddala obwesigwa bw’ensibuko, ng’asinziira ku by’omukulu ebikwata ku kutendeka okulowooza okw’eby’emabega. Okutuukiriza kino, ateesa okusoma ensibuko eno wammanga: Tewali n’omu ayinza okuwakanya nti amaanyi [...] g’abafuzi geeyongera nga eby’obugagga by’ebyenfuna n’omuwendo gw’amaggye bwe byeyongera. Ate era, etteeka lyakuumanga abantu ssaako n’amaanyi ag’amateeka ag’abaami. Bannamateeka be bamu ku bintu ebikulu eby’okukyusa obwakabaka. Era kino kyali kituufu naddala mu nsi omutindo gw’obwannamateeka [...] gwe gwali guzimbye ku mateeka g’Abaruumi ab’edda [...] (Bulaaya ey’Enkyukakyuka. 1517 - 1559, Elton Geoffrey (1999).) Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekigenda okukulaakulanya butereevu okwekenneenya obwesigwa bw’ensibuko abayizi kye bakola?
answer_a: Okakasa ekika ky'ensibuko, oba ya ntandikwa oba ya bubiri, okusinziira ku mwaka we yasindikiddwa.
answer_b: Tegeera Elton Geoffrey bw’ali n’ekigendererwa kye bwe yali awandiika ensibuko.
answer_c: Laga obumanyifu bw'omuwandiisi ku byafaayo by'obwakabaka bw'amawanga.
answer_d: Ekitabo kino bwe kigamba ku maanyi ga kabaka kiyamba kitya okutegeera okukula kw’obwakabaka obw’eggwanga?

question: Omusomesa ateekateeka okukola emirimu esatu egy’omuddiring’anwa, ng’akozesa obubaka, abayizi be ab’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya basobole okutegeera obutakkaanya mu ndowooza obwakulembera amaanyi amakambwe mu kiseera ky’olutalo olw’obutiti; mu nkola eno, akoze enteekateeka z’emirimu egy’enjawulo egisoboka. Ku mirimu egidiring’ana gino wammanga, guli gwani ogutuukira abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyatuukirizibwa?
answer_a:
1: Ku maapu y’ebyafaayo eraga ekiseera ky’olutalo olw’ebbanga, balaga ebifo we waaliwo obutabanguko obw’amaggye obutali butereevu wakati w’amawanga amanene.

2: Bwe bamala okubigattira awamu, balonda lumu ku ntalo ezo ze balaze ne boogera ku nkyukakyuka ze zaleeta mu byobufuzi n’ensonga z’ensi.

3: Bakola akatonnyeze akalaga entalo ezo, nga balaga obuwanguzi n’ebigwi bya buli limu ku mawanga amanene mu ntalo ezo.
answer_b:
1: Balambula ebipande bya propaganda okuva mu US ne USSR, nga bagerageranya embeera mwe byakolerwa, ekigendererwa, n'ebirala.

2: Bwegattira awamu, balonda kimu ku byamaguzi eby'amaanyi era bakola ekipande ekikikiikirira.

3: Bategeka olukung'aana n'ebipande wansi w'omutwe "USA vs USSR," okusalawo okuyita mu kulonda obuyinza obusukkulumu bwali bwa ani.
answer_c:
1: Balambulula ebiwandiiko okuva mu bitongole by'obukessi ebikulu ebya buli ggwanga (KGB ne CIA), nga bategeera ebigendererwa byabyo.

2: Nga batadde wamu, bakola ekiwandiiko ekiraga mu bwangu ensonga eziweereddwa buli kitongole ku ngeri gye kikolamu emirimu gyakyo.

3: Bakola akatabo akageraageranya buli pulaani y'ebyobufuzi ebitongole by'obukessi eby'amawanga gegezaako okutaasa.
answer_d:
1: Beebuuza ku mitimbagano gy'enternet okunoonya ensibuko z'ebikwata ku nkola enkulu ez'eby'amagye amaanyi agaalina mu kiseera ky'olutalo olw'ebbanga.

2: Bwe bamala okubikuŋŋaanya, basoma ensibuko ezo ne bafuna endowooza enkulu eza buli emu.

3: Baleeta endowooza zaabwe mu maaso g'ekibiina, nga balaga enjawulo n'obufaananyi mu nkola ezaakozesebwa buli limu ku maanyi ago.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu ekiyigiriza ku Nkomerero y'olutalo olw'ebbanga, yategeka omukolo eri abayizi be aba 10 okwetegefuza okwekenneenya ensibuko enkulu. Olw'ensonga eno, yabaleetera okusoma n'okuddamu ebibuuzo nga basinziira ku katundu kano okuva mu kitabo ekyawandiikibwa omuntu ku bulamu bwe: Entandikwa y'endowooza ya "perestroika" yali kukakasa okw'amaanyi nti tetuyinza kuddamu kubeerawo nga bwe twali. Mbadde nkyogera ku kino emirundi mingi era ssigezaako kuddamu kukyogera wano. Sijjuddeko, wadde akatundu akatono, nti nze nnali ntandisi w'enkyukakyuka ey'amaanyi mu bulamu bw'eggwanga lyaffe. Ebyajjira mu butangaavu ku byafaayo byaffe, nga byebaziddwa "glasnost," byakakasa mu ngeri ey'obukambwe n'etakyuka nti enkola eyakolebwa okusinziira ku mitindo gy'obukangavvu n'obufuzi bw'ekinnakyemalira tekyali kigumiikirizika, si lwa nsonga za mpisa zokka, wabula era n'olw'ensonga z'omusingi z'eggwanga mu by'enfuna n'eby'embeera z'abantu. Kyali kisindise eggwanga ku nkomerero era ne kiteeka ku kizingo ky'obuziba. Era kyagenda mu maaso okubaawo okuyita mu maanyi, eby'obulimba, okutya, obutafaayo bw'abantu, wamu n'obuyambi obw'omusaayi ogw'ekinnakyemalira ogwasaasaanya ebyobugagga era ne gunafuya obusobozi bw'ebiseera eby'omu maaso. The August Coup. The Truth and its Consequences, Mikhail Gorbachev. Kino kye kimu ku bibuuzo ebyaddiddwa omuyizi nga basinziira ku mutundu oguli waggulu: Kiki ekyali kifaanaanyi ekiri mu mbeera mwe biteekeddwawo enkola za Perestroika ne Glasnost mu eyali USSR? Perestroika: okukkiriza nti omuntu tasobola kuddamu kubeerawo nga bwe yali. Glasnost: nkola eyakolebwa okusinziira ku mitindo gy'obukangavvu n'obufuzi bw'ekinnakyemalira nga tekikyali kigumiikirizika. Bunafu ki obulabika mu kuddamu kw'omuyizi, ku bikwata ku busobozi okutaputa ensibuko?
answer_a: Muwe eky’okunnyonnyola ensibuko okuva mu ndaba y’omuntu ku lulwe.
answer_b: Tebissa byeyoleka obutereevu obuteetaaga kunnyonnyola.
answer_c: Essira ku kunnyonnyola ensibuko y'ebigambo awatali kubuusabuusa ku biteeso byayo.
answer_d: Leeta ennyingo ezinnyonnyola ebiri mu bigambo by'omuwandiisi nga tolowoozeza ku ky'abadde aluubirira.

question: Mu kibiina kya musanvu, mu somo erikwata ku Myaka wakati, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa: "Okukulaakulanya okutegeera ebyafaayo nga twawula enkolagana z’ensalo wakati w’Abakristaayo, Abasiraamu, n’Abayudaaya mu kibuga ky’e Iberian." Okutuukiriza kino, asaba abayizi okukola olugero olulaga enkolagana ezaaliwo mu kiseera ekyo. Bw’aba ng’alondoola omulimu guno, akiraba nti abayizi bangi tebategedde bulungi nkolagana z’ensalo wakati w’Abasiraamu, Abakristaayo, n’Abayudaaya. Ng’ekyokulabirako, asanga emirimu mingi egirimu ebintu ebifaanana bino: "Erinnya lyange nze Muhamed, ndi Musiraamu omuto abeera mu Bufuzi bw’Abasiraamu obwa Cordoba, famire yange yonna egoberera eddiini y’Obusiraamu era tutunda emikeeka mu katale. Tetukolagana na Bakristaayo wadde Abayudaaya kubanga bakaafiiri." Nga twetegereza obujulizi obukuŋŋaanyiziddwa, mulimu ki omupya omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi okukwasaganya ekigendererwa ekyateesebwa, ng’asinga kwesigama ku kukulaakulanya okutegeera ebyafaayo?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola buli omu ku lwabwe bw’alowoza abantu abaabeeranga ku lukalu lwa Iberian bwe baabeeranga era nga bwe bakolagananga, ng’osinziira ku kulaba ebifaananyi.
answer_b: Mu bibinja, mukiikirire embeera ez’enjawulo ez’obumu ezabangawo mu kibuga kya Iberian Peninsula, nga musinziira ku biwandiiko by’abantu ab’enjawulo abaakibeeramu.
answer_c: Maliriza chati ku bikwata ku nzikiriza z’amadiini ez’abantu abaabeera mu kitundu kya Iberian Peninsula, nga osinziira ku kusoma ekitabo ekikulungamya, ng’olambulula engeri gye zaakosa enkolagana yaabwe.
answer_d: Weebale okutangaaza enkolagana eziriwo wakati w'Abakristaayo n'Abasiraamu nga tusinziira ku mawulire agali ku yintaneeti, ng'olaga obufaananagana n'enjawulo ku ebyo ebyaliwo ku lukalu lwa Iberian mu myaka gy'enkulakulana.

question: Ku mirimu egiddwa wammanga, kkiru ki ekikulaakulanya obukugu bw’abayizi mu kukebera ensibuko z’ebyanjuliziddwa?
answer_a: Bakyalira eggwanika erimu eby'obuwangwa by'Abazungu ebiragiddwa mu bifaananyi n'ebintu.
answer_b: Balonda ebifaananyi ebikwaata ku nnono z'eggwanga okuva mu bizinga by'ebifaananyi by'amawanga ag'enjawulo.
answer_c: Babuuza abantu abava mu nsi ez’enjawulo ne boolekera bannaabwe mu kibiina empisa enkulu ez’ennono z’ensi ezo.
answer_d: Bakola pposita ezikwata ku ngeri z’okugattika enzikiriza z’abantu abava mu mawanga amalala nga basinziira ku bifaananyi eby’enjawulo era ne bazireeta mu kibiina.

question: Omutendesi y’alina okusooka kukola ki eri abayizi be mu kibiina nga bayita mu kusomesa okwesigamiziddwa ku pulojekiti?
answer_a: Leetawo ekibuuzo ekiggusa oba ekizibu kinene ddala, era okibuulirire.
answer_b: Makuluza g’ebiruubirirwa by’okuyiga n’ebivaamu.
answer_c: Kola okunoonyereza ku mbeera y'ebikolebwa ebipya ebitali bimu.
answer_d: Lungereza abayizi mu bitundu ebitannanoonyerezebwaako.

question: Soma embeera eno: Abayizi abali mu S.6 bamaze okuzuula ekizibu mu ssomero lyabwe: tewaliwo we basobola okugula emmere ennungi ey’akawungeezi mu kiseera ky’okuwummula. Okuddamu, bawadde ekirowoozo ky’okuzimba akakiosk akatunda ebibala n’omukyomo, nga bakaddukanya bokka. Bayinza kukolagana na somo ki okutumbula omulimu guno?
answer_a: Mu by'obuyiiya, okuyambako n'obumanyirivu mu nkola y'ebyamamawulire mu kutondekawo akabonero (logo) okubamanyisa.
answer_b: Mu essomo ly'Ekibalangulo, okukola okunoonyereza okw'ekibalangulo okusobola okuzuula omuwendo gw'abayizi abaagala emmere ennungi eri obulamu.
answer_c: Mu by'Obulamu, okukebera ebiriisa n'amaanyi agali mu by'emmere ebitundibwa.
answer_d: Nga tukozesa okusomesa kw’ebyemizannyo, twongere ku mulamwa gw’emmere ennungi n’okukola dduyiro.

question: Ekibiina ky'abayizi kitegeeza omusomesa waabwe ow'Eby'emikono nti baagala okuyiga ku nkola y'okukola pulogulaamu za kompyuta kyokka ne balaga nti tebamanyi ngeri gye banaatandikaamu omulimu guno kubanga bagutwala nga mugumu nnyo. Kintu ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okukubiriza abayizi n'okubanguyiza okuyiga essomo lino?
answer_a: Yanjula abayizi eri enkoode z’ebiterekezo bya pulogulaamu ze bamanyi era ze bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo.
answer_b: Yanjula abayizi eri ennimi z'okukoodinga ze bamanyi, gamba nga Java, C++, oba PHP
answer_c: Laga abayizi eby'okulabirako bya simulato ezisobozesa okutegeera enkozesa y'ebipimo bya data eby'oluse olugolokofu.
answer_d: Tuyigirize abayizi ebintu ebikulu ebikozesebwa mu pulogulaamu, gamba nga aligolizimu, nga bikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.

question: Okusinziira ku bwetaavu bw’obutonde bwabwe, abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw’omunaana bazimbye ebitebe ku kisaawe ky’abaana abato mu ssomero. Nga twekenneereza embeera ennyonnyoddwa, biragiro ki omusomesa by’alina okutunuulira okusobola okukebera ebintu ebyakolebwa abayizi, okusinziira ku abo abagenda okubikozesa?
answer_a: Okukozesa ebintu ebitagasa nnyo oba ebintu ebyakakozesebwa, bityo okukendeeza ku nsaasaanya y'ebintu.
answer_b: Okukozesa ebintu ebiddamu okukozesebwa oba ebyo ebirina obuzibu bw’obutonde bw’ensi obutono oluvannyuma lw’obulamu bw’entebe obw’omugaso
answer_c: Okulonda ebintu ebimala ebbanga era nga binywevu ebisobozesa okukola ebintu eby’enjawulo ebiyamba entebe okuba enkalubo n’okunywevu.
answer_d: Okukozesa ebintu ebikkiriza okubaawo kw'endabika ennungamu etuukana n'empisa z'essomero.

question:
Mu kibiina kya Tekinologiya, abayizi ab'ekitabo eky'okutaano bazimba akabonero k'emmotoka aka kkalekeeti ke baakubise, nga bakozesa ebintu n'ebikozesebwa eby'enjawulo, omuli n'ebimu ebisala.
Kiragiro ki ekisooka omusomesa ky'asaanidde okuwa abayizi basobole okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebisala obulungi?
answer_a: Tegeka ekifo weegenda okusalira nga tonnatandika kusala.
answer_b: Londa ekintu ekikaluba era ekyenkanankana okusalako ebintu.
answer_c: Laba nti ebikozesebwa biri mu mbeera nnungi era nga birina obuwaze obutereevu.
answer_d: Londa ekyuma ekisala okusinziira ku mulimu n'ebintu by'ogenda okukozesa.

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, omusomesa w’ebyemikono asaba abayizi be okunoonyereza ku ngeri ekifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebipapula, ebbinika, butulo za pulasitiki, n’ebibokisi bya tetrapack gye kikosezzaamu abantu abali okumpi n’essomero. Okusinziira ku mbeera ennyonnyoddwa, engeri ki ey’okusomesa esinga okuba entuufu abayizi okuyiga okumanya engeri ekifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu gye kikosezzaamu abantu?
answer_a: Leeta ebifaananyi ebiraga oba ebintu ebirala ebiraga engeri kazambi ono gy’akosaobutonde bw’ensi, era okusinziira ku kino, olonde ebirungi ebiri mu kifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu mu kitundu.
answer_b: Bawe abaana abali ku mutindo ogw’oku Intaneeti ogw’ebibuuzo n’okunoonyereza okusobola okukozesebwa ku bantu abangi, era mwembi mukole ku nsonga ez’okwebuuzaako okusobola okuzuula ebinavaamu ekifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu mu kitundu.
answer_c: Zimba ekifaananyi ekiraga abayizi nga beekubaganya ebirowoozo era nga balaga obubi obuva mu kika ky'akasasiro kano, n'obulungi obuli mu kuddamu okukozesa ebintu by'ekika kino okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuleeta obulamu obulungi mu kitundu.
answer_d: Noonyereza wamu n'abayizi ku bikozesebwa bya TIC ebisobola okukozesebwa okwebuuza ku bantu abali okumpi n'essomero, okukung'aanya ebirowoozo byabwe ku bukulu bw'okuba n'ekifo ky'okuddamu okukozesa ebintu ebiyoonoonwa ebiri mu maka.

question: Mu kiseera ky’okuteekateeka omulimu gw’okuweereza abalala, ebibinja by’abayizi ba siniya bisoomooza omusomesa abakulembera mu ngeri ezitali zimu. Ng’addamu ku kimu ku byo, omusomesa abawa amagezi okukola eki चार्ट kya Gantt. Nga tweyambisa amagezi ago waggulu, kibuuzo ki ekiyinza okuba nga kyasoomooza ekibinja kino?
answer_a: Ebikozesebwa bye twetaaga okukulaakulanya obuweereza bwaffe tebikwatagana na byo bye tulina.
answer_b: Tulina ebifo bingi eby'amawulire ebiri ku mukutu ogwa Web kyokka tetumanyi kye kigenda okuba eky'omugaso ku buli mulimu.
answer_c: Waliwo emirimu mingi gye tulina okukola era tweraliikirira okubula obwesimbu, okusaanyawo obudde obutono bwe tulina okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa.
answer_d: Ekizibu kye twazuula kirina engeri ez’enjawulo ezisobola okugonjoolwa, twetaaga akabonero akatuyamba okusalawo engeri esinga okuba entuufu.

question: Mu kibiina ky'ebyemikono mu Ssomero Eya Wakati, omutendera gw'okukola enteekateeka y'okuweereza gwe gukolebwako. Omusomesa asabye ebibinja by'abakyizi okukola olulango olulaga enkulaakulana mu mutendera guno ogw'emirimu gyabwe. Okusinziira ku nkola y'omulimu guno, mugaso ki ogw'okulaga abayizi bonna enkulaakulana mu mutendera gw'okuteekateeka?
answer_a: Okukolera awamu, nga mulaga obweteefu bw’ekibiina n’obwesigwa okufuna ebiteeso n’endowooza okuva eri banno ku mulimu gwammwe.
answer_b: Okwekenneenya obukulu bw'enteekateeka ya ssente ezikozeseddwa okutuusa kati n'okuteekateeka enkyukakyuka ezigenda okusobozesa okutuukiriza ebigendererwa by'omulimu guno.
answer_c: Okukola omulimu ogw’omugaso mu kuteesa okw’okulambulula ensonga ez’obuwaze ezaakolebwa mu kutuukiriza omulimu okusinziira ku bigendererwa by’omulimu ogwo.
answer_d: Okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nkulaakulana mu nteekateeka ya serivisi, okufuna endowooza y’ebibiina byonna n’okugattako obulungi obutongole okusinziira ku kiruubirirwa ekyasooka.

question: Omukulu w’essomero atunuulidde okweyongera okunene mu kukozesa amazzi era n’ategeeza abasomesa b’essomero ekyo. Omusomesa w’ebyuma ow’ekibiina kya II Medio asalawo okuleeta ekizibu kino eri abayizi be, mu mutwe gw’ekitabo “Okutereeza enkozesa y’ebintu”, nga alina ekigendererwa eky’okunoonya eby’okukola okumalawo ekizibu ekyo. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku guyinza okusobozesa abayizi okuwa eby’okukola okumalawo ekizibu ekyo?
answer_a: Nnonyezereza ku byokulabirako eby’engeri endala ez’okukozesaamu amazzi obuvunaanyizibwa mu mbeera z’ebyenjigiriza endala ebisobola okukoppebwa mu ssomero
answer_b:
Ebiragiro Ekkumi Eby’Okukendeeza n’Okukuuma Enkozesa y’Amazzi mu Ssomero:

1. Tegeka enkola y’okukozesa amazzi mu ssomero lyonna era oginyweze.
2. Londa akakiiko k’abayizi akakwasisa empenda z’okukozesa amazzi mu ngeri entuufu.
3. Longoosezza amazzi agava mu nkuba era ogakozese mu ngeri endala nga okunaabiriza ebinaabiro.
4. Kozesa ebikozesebwa ebiketereza amazzi nga omuliifu ezitakozesa mazzi mangi.
5. Ziba engira zonna ezitonnya mangu ddala.
6. Gamba abantu bonna ku bubaka obw’okukendeeza amazzi nga oyita mu bubaati n’ebitabo by’essomero.
7. Tegeka empaka z’okukendeeza amazzi wakati w’ebibiina by’abayizi.
8. Fundiza ebimera by’oku ssomero mu makya oba akawungeezi okwewala amazzi okwanguwa okukala.
9. Kozesa amazzi agakoleddwa okunaaba engoye okunaabiriza ebinaabiro.
10. Yigiriza abayizi n’abakozi bonna ku bukulu bw’okukuuma amazzi n’engeri y’okukikola.
answer_c: Kaweefube ow’okukozesa amazzi obulungi n’engeri obutakikola bwe kiyinza okukosa ensi yonna, era n’omu ssomero, mukulu nnyo. Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku nsonga eno.
answer_d: Kebera engeri amazzi gye gakozesebwa mu bifo eby'enjawulo mu ssomero okusobola okuzuula wekitandise ekizibu.

question: Omusomesa yeetaaga okulonda omukutu ogw’okuyigiriza okukozesa enkola enzibu, ekwatagana n’okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby’amasannyalaze. Okusingira ddala, asuubira abayizi be okuyiga okukozesa ebikozesebwa ng’asinga okussa essira ku butebenkevu bwabwe bo bennyini n’obw’abalala mu kubikozesa. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, ngeri ki esobola okukwasaganya okuyiga kuno butereevu?
answer_a: Teekawo bigambo ebikulembera
answer_b: Omusomo ogw'ekikwaata
answer_c: Okulaga ng'obuyambi bw'omuntu omukulu.
answer_d: Okukonjoola ebizibu

question: Mu tekinologiya zino wammanga, y’erina eyinza okusobozesa omusomesa ow’ekitabo eky’okutaano okulaga mu butereevu engeri enkulaakulana y’ebyuma bya tekinologiya gy’etuukirizaamu ebyetaago by’abantu?
answer_a: Okukola batiri eya kikulukuto (ecological battery) eyejjusa amanyi buli lw’etambula, nga kyakukola okusobola okukendeeza ku masannyalaze agakozesebwa.
answer_b: Okufulumya jacket erimu obusannyalaze bw'amatabaala agasobozesa okukola amasannyalaze, nga kuddamu eri obwetaavu bw'okuchajiinga essimu ez'omu ngalo.
answer_c: Okukola ekyuma ekisobola okukyusa empapula ezikozeseddwa mu woofiisi n’azifuula obupiira bw’okwetukuza, nga kigendereddwa okukozesa obuyambi obulungi.
answer_d: Okukulaakulanya ebirime ebisobola okuvaamu ekitangaala awatali bwoki, nga kye kyetaago eky’okukyusa engeri ez’ekiddaala ezikozesebwa n’endala ezikola obulungi.

question:
Abasomesa b'ebyemikono ne ssaayansi mu kibiina eky'okutaano bakkaanyizza okukolera awamu ku mulamwa gwa ssaayansi guno: okukula kw'ekimera. Okusobola okukola kino, omusomesa w'ebyemikono asabye abayizi be okukola olulimi lw'okunnyonnyola ku nkula y'ekimera, okusobola okunyweza okumanya kwe bafunye mu ssaayansi era n'okwongerako, okutondekawo ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa abayizi b'ekibiina eky'okusatu, abetaaga okuyiga ku nkula eno.
Mu bikozesebwa eby'omukono ebigattiddwa wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukozesebwa mu kuteekateeka olulimi olwo, nga tutunuulidde ekigendererwa n'omutendera gw'abayizi?
answer_a: PowerPoint, nga tukozesa ebiwandiiko n'ebifaananyi
answer_b: Omukozi wa firimu, okukwata n'okulongoosa vidiyo
answer_c: AnimatorDV, okukola katuni akalaga omutendera ogwo
answer_d: Padlet, okufulumya ebintu ebigasa okutegeera omulingo omukolwa gye gutambuliramu

question: Abayizi mu kibiina eky’okutaano babadde bakola ku mutwe ogwogera ku kigendererwa ky’okuyiga “Okukola ebintu eby’omulembe okugonjoola ebizibu, nga bakebera era nga bakyusa ebintu.” Babadde balina okulonda ebizibu ebitagonjoleddwa mu maka gaabwe era ne balonda ekintu ekimu, nga bwe kikyusiddwa, kiyinza okubigonjoola. Balina okwanjula ebyava mu mulimu gwabwe eri ekibiina okufuna ebirowoozo okuva eri bannaabwe. Mu bigambo bino wammanga, biruwa ebiri ebituukirawo okuteekebwa mu mulamwa gw’okukebera ogukozesebwa abayizi okuwa bannaabwe ebirowoozo ku kutuukiriza ekigendererwa?
answer_a: Balonda ekintu ekisobola okukola ku bwetaavu obulambuluddwa mu maka. Bawa amagezi ku nkyukakyuka mu kintu ekyo nga bakozesa ebifaananyi oba dayagulaamu.
answer_b: Balondoola eky’okukola okugonjoola obwetaavu obulabiddwa mu maka. Batuumuula era bannyonnyola ebikolwa ebyetaagisa okutereeza ekintu eky’omulembe.
answer_c: Bannyonnyola era ne basinnyonnyola ebintu ebyetaagisa okukolebwa okutereeza ekintu eky'omulembe. Balonda era ne bannyonnyola engeri egenda okukozesebwa okutereeza ekintu ekyo.
answer_d: Balondoola ebyo ebivaamu nga tukozesa ebintu byobutonde n'engeri gye bikosa abantu. Balonda ebikozesebwa n'ebyuma ebyetaagisa buli kitundu ky'ekintu kye bagenda okukyusa.

question: Mu butonde bw'essomo "Okukebera n'enkola y'ekikozesebwa", omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'omunaana ateekateeka essomo lye, nga alina ekigendererwa eky'okuddamu okukola ekintu eky'omulembe ekyalondeddwa, nga yeesigamiziddwa ku mawulire agakuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu kukebera abakozesa. Mu bino ebikwata ku bukugu, kiki omusomesa ky'asaanidde okugumya okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyogeddwa?
answer_a: Kozesa engeri z'okulaga n'okukiikirira ebintu nga weekozesa ebifaananyi.
answer_b: Laga ebintu ebikulu n'obuyambi ebikozesebwa mu kukola ebifaananyi.
answer_c: Manya obukodyo obukozesebwa mu kukungaanya obubaka n’okuvaamu eby’okumalirizo.
answer_d: Manyike ag’okukungaanya amawulire n’engeri gaalina.

question: Ku mirimu egiddwa wammanga, kkiru ki ekisinga okukwatagana n’endagiriro y’ebisomesebwa ku kulambika ebirowoozo eby’amagezi mu somo ly’Ebyuma n’Tekinologiya?
answer_a: Abayizi banoonyereza obujulizi mu nsibuko ez’enjawulo ne ku mikutu gy’emikutu gy’ebyempuliziganya ku nkwe eyo, era bageraageranya okubuusabuusa kwe kireetawo n’amawulire ag’ekikugu agaliwo.
answer_b: Abayizi bakola olukalala lw'ensonga eziyinza okuba nga ze zaviiriddeko obuboddomu era ne bazikenneenya nga basinziira ku mbeera z'ebyenfuna, eby'embeera z'abantu n'eby'ekikugu.
answer_c: Abayizi bakola ebibuuzo eby’okubuuza omuntu eyali ku mwezi nga bye bayita ebirowoozo byabwe ku byo abantu bye balowooza ku nsonga eyo. Oluvannyuma, banoonyereza ku byo abantu abaagenda ku mwezi bye baayogerako mu bitabo eby’enjawulo.
answer_d: Abayizi balaba filimu ennyonnyofu “Ddala Omuntu Yatuuka ku Mwezi?”, eyooleka obujulizi obuliwo obukwata ku kutuuka kw’omuntu ku mwezi mu 1969. Oluvannyuma, bawandiika omulimu ogw’okuwandiika (essay) nga balaga endowooza yaabwe ku nsonga eyo.

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina kya P6 ayagala okuyigiriza abayizi be endowooza z’obugulumivu, empuyi, n’enteekateeka, basobole okukiikirira ebintu bye bateekateeka mu bifaananyi. Ku bikolwa by’omusomesa bino wammanga, kiki ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okutegeera enkola y’okukola endowooza ezo?
answer_a: Saba abayizi balowoole ekitebe nga "kibuuka" mu nsonda y'ekisenge era bakimulisize nga kikwatagana butereevu ku bisenge n'ettaka. Laga nti ebisiikirize ebirabika bikwatagana n'endaba buli emu. Oluvannyuma, babuuze ebibuuzo bino: ndaba meka eziriwo? Mukwano ki oguli wakati waazo?
answer_b: Saba abayizi okulowooza ku ndabika enkulu ey'ekintu oba ekitundu era balonde ekisiikirize ekituufu ku buli ndege, okufaanana ezo eziri mu kibiina. Oluvannyuma, balage nti endege ezo ziyitibwa endege ey'obugulumivu, endege y'enteekateeka, n'endege y'ekifaananyi, ng'ebifaananyi ebisiigiddwa ku buli emu ye ndabika y'obugulumivu.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola abayizi nti ebifananyi ebiragibwa by’ekintu biyitibwa ndaba, kubanga buli kifaananyi ekiragibwa kifaananira ddala endaba gye twandibadde nayo ku kintu ekyo singa tukitunuulira nga tuli wala nnyo, nga tukozesa lensi ey’amaanyi ennyo, mu bwangu bw’emisaana egiraga.
answer_d: Buuza abayizi: Ekintu kirina endabaazi mmeka? Endabaazi mmeka ku zino ze twetaaga okukiikirira ekintu? Oluvannyuma, nnyonnyola nti byonna bisinga kwesigama ku kifo ekintu we kiri okutunuulira ennyanguyirizi ezisiiga ebifaananyi, era nti mu nkola ekintu kirina okuteekebwa mu kifo eky’engeri eyo nti obwenyi bwakyo obusinga obungi buba bugendagana oba butunuulidde ennyanguyirizi ezo.

question: Mu kwogera eri abayizi abali mu kibiina kya munaana, omusomesa ayanjula omulamwa gw'okukaddiwa okwategekebwa (planned obsolescence - PO), ng'ayogera ku ngeri gwe gukosa okukung'aanyizibwa kw'ebisasiro bya tekinologiya. Bwe baba beekenneenya engeri y'okulwanyisa ekizibu kino, abayizi balaga okubuusabuusa era ne bagaba ebirowoozo eby'enjawulo ku ngeri bwe kizibu okukyusa omugendo gw'akatale ogw'okukola n'okutunda ebintu bingi. Mu nnyonnyola zino ez'omusomesa, ennyonnyola ki eyandigonjodde obweraliikirivu bw'abayizi era n'ekulaakulanya obukugu obusuubirwa okukuzibwa mu somo?
answer_a: “Mazima ddala, ekintu kya PO kitulaga nti enkulaakulana y’ebyuma erina obubi bwayo ku mitendera egy’enjawulo era tekiyinza kulowoozebwa ng’ekintu kirungi kyokka nga tetubuuza bibuuzo, oba tujja kuba tuleeta okwonooneka kw’obutonde obutalikyuka.”
answer_b: “Okuva kino bwe kizibu ky’ensi yonna, kyeyoleka bulungi nti obweteefu bw’amawanga gonna bwetaagisa okukigonjoola; n’olwekyo, tuteekwa okussaayo omwoyo ku nkiiko ez’enjawulo ezibaawo ezinaatusobozesa okukola endagaano ku mutendera gw’ensi yonna.”
answer_c: "Akatale tekakola kokka, kaddamu eri ebyetaago by'abaguzi, era ekizibu kino kiraga nti tulina okwekenneenya n'okuddamu okwetegereza empisa zaffe ez'okukozesa ebintu okulaba engeri gye twenyigiramu mu muzingo guno omubi n'engeri gye tusobola okugukyusaamu."
answer_d: "N'olwekyo obukulu bw'ebibiina okubeera abakulembeza enkyukakyuka, ng'ebibiina by'abantu abalwanirira eddembe bwe bikola nga byolesa obuzibu buno eri abantu bonna, abakulembeze balyoke bakole ekintu, ng'ekyokulabirako ekibiina kya SOP (Awataaliiwo Kukaddiwa Kutegekeddwa)."

question: Omusomesa w’ebyemikono mu S.2, agenda okutandika omulimu gw’omukutu, asazeewo okukozesa okukebera okuzuula obumanyirivu bw’abayizi be ku mitendera gy’omukutu, egyali gyayigirizibwa omwaka oguwedde. Nga tutunuulidde ekigendererwa n’ebigenda okukeberwa, kiki ku bino wammanga ekisaanidde okukozesebwa okukebera?
answer_a: Olukalala lw'ebigambo olukung'aanya endowooza enkulu mu ssomero ku bikolwa eby'enjawulo ebikolebwa mu buli mutendera gw'omulimu ogutegekeddwa.
answer_b: Akakalu ka kalonda akalimu obubonero bw'omutindo obuteekwa okubaawo mu nkulaakulana ya buli mutendera gwa pulojekiti era nga busobozesa okukakasibwa mu mirimu egikolebwa.
answer_c: Omubuuzo oguwandiike ogulina ebibuuzo ebyetaaga okwanukuddwa mu bujjuvu, omuli okukubuuza ekyokulabirako, olonde ebiseera eby'enjawulo eby'omulimu era owa obujulizi ku by'olonze.
answer_d: Omutindo gw’ebirubulirwa ogulina ebiragiro ebifa ku mutendera gw’obukugu obulagiddwa mu bitundu by’omulimu, nga bwe bakulaakulanya buli kimu mu mulimu gw’ekibinja

question: Abayizi ba siniya bali mu nkola ya kuteekateeka omulimu gwabwe. Okubayamba okukulaakulanya enteekateeka zaabwe, omusomesa asalawo okwewaayo essaawa emu mu ssomo okuyiga engeri y’okukozesa ebifaano bya PERT, mwe balina okussaawo enkolagana y’obwesigamizo bw’ebikolebwa okusobola okuteekateeka omulimu gwabwe. Ku nkomerero y’essaawa y’essomo, omusomesa asalawo okukebera amangu okutegeera kw’abayizi ku bifaano bino bye biri n’omugaso gwabyo, okusobola okukyusa enteekateeka y’essaawa eddako okusinziira ku by’addamu ebiweereddwa. Ku bikozesebwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisobozesa omusomesa okukuŋŋaanya amangu era mu ngeri entuufu amawulire agakwata ku kutegeera kw’abayizi n’omugaso gw’ebifaano bya PERT?
answer_a: Omuko ogw’okwekebejja omuntu ku muntu, abayizi mwe babuuliriziganya nti, “Engeri y’okuzimbamu ekibalangulo kya PERT,” ate oluvannyuma ne bakolera awamu okutereeza eby’okuddamu byabwe
answer_b: Tiketi y’okuva, ng’esaba abayizi okulaga ebintu bisatu bye bayize mu kibiina n’ebibuuzo bibiri bye bakyali nabyo ku bikwata ku dayagulaamu za PERT n’omugaso gwazo.
answer_c: Omutindo ogw'okubaza okutegeera, nga gutondeka abayizi mu bibinja okusinziira ku mutendera gw'okutegeera kwabwe okwesigamiziddwa ku by'addamu byabwe ku kibuuzo: “Ekibalanguzi kya PERT kye ki?”
answer_d: Akakodyo k’okubuuza abayizi okuddamu bye bayize ku kikwaatiriro kya PERT n’ekigendererwa kyakyo, okusinziira ku mitendera gino: “Nkimanyi bulungi; mmanyi, naye sisobola kukinyonnyola; era simanyi.”

question:
Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri mu siniya alina enteekateeka y’okuyigiriza ey’ekigendererwa “Okulaga embeera ez’enjawulo eziva mu nkulaakulana y’ebyuma eziriwo kati, ezireetawo enkyukakyuka ennungi oba embi mu bulamu bw’omuntu, mu mbeera z’abantu, obutonde bw’ensi, amateeka, ebyenfuna, oba mu bintu ebirala.” Ku somo erisooka, bagenda kwetegereza ekigendererwa kino: “Okuteebereza ebiriva mu nkulaakulana y’ebyuma ezaayita.”
Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku mirimu ki ogusobola okuyamba omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’agenda okukolerako mu somo erisooka?
answer_a: Laga abayizi vidiyo eraga engeri ebintu bya tekinologiya eby’enjawulo gye byakolebwa era ne bikulaakulana, n’engeri gye bikosezzaamu abantu ba leero, oluvannyuma obasabe okulaga ebyo ebikoze bubi okusinga.
answer_b: Balangirira abayizi ku ngeri akabonero k’obwolekero (compass) gye kakolera emirimu emirungi n’emibi, oluvannyuma mubasabe okunoonyereza ku bintu ebirala ebikoze ebintu bye bimu okusinziira ku kino.
answer_c: Laga abayizi vidiyo ekwata ku kyuma ekikozesa omukka n’engeri gye kyakyukaamu ne kireetawo ebipya. Oluvannyuma obabuulire okwogera ku bintu ebyaleetebwawo okukula kwakyo okw’eddaala ku ddaala.
answer_d: Laga abayizi engeri ekintu eky’omulembe omuteekinologiya gye kyatondebwawo, gamba nga telegulaafu, n’engeri gye kikosezzaamu embeera z’abantu mu kiseera kino. Oluvannyuma, basabe okuzuza ekyaati nga balaga emiganyulo n’obubi bwabyo.

question:
Omusomesa mu ssomero lya secondary asomesa abayizi be omutwe "Emikisa n'Okusoomoozebwa kw'Ebyuma bya Tekinologiya Ennaku Zino" era ng'adda mu birowoozo by'abayiizi bye baasoose okuba nabyo ku mirimu gy'ekibiina. Nga bagabana ebyo bye baazuula, enkozesa y'omulamwa "okuddamu okukozesa" eddamu emirundi mingi okutegeeza ekikolwa kyonna ekikwaatagana n'okuddamu okukozesa ekintu kya tekinologiya. Abayizi baleme okutabukirwa, omusomesa abawa ebyokulabirako bibiri bibiri okubayamba okwawula omulamwa gw'okuddamu okukozesa n'okuddamu okukola ebipya.
Mu bigere by'ebyokulabirako bino wammanga ebiraga okuddamu okukozesa n'okuddamu okukola ebipya, kiki ekisobola okuyamba abayizi okwawula enjawulo wakati w'emiramwa gino?
answer_a: Kyusa omulimu gw'ebintu ebisaasaanyizibwa obusaasaanyi, gamba nga okukola ebintu omuteekebwa obbalaamu okuva mu byuma by'ebinywebwa, era okukyusa ekintu, gamba nga okufuula eccupa ya pulasitiika okuba akasuuluulu k'okufukirira.
answer_b: Kozesa olupapula ku njuyi zombi olyoke olusuule mu bintu ebiteerekebwamu ebiri mu bifo ebirongoofu mu kitundu, era leeta akasawo ko bw’ogenda mu dduuka, obutetaaga kapya.
answer_c: Kola kompoosi y’ebimera nga okukozesa ebikuta by’ebibala n’ebisigala by’enva endiirwa, era okukozesa ebikozesebwa mu bujjuvu nga okwongera omuwendo gw’emirundi gye bikozesebwa.
answer_d: Okukyusa ebipipa bya caayi ebikozeseddwa nga tubisaanuusa n'okubiumba obutya okukola ebikopo oba ebijiiko by'ebimuli, n'okuwaayo engoye ezitakyakozesebwa eri abantu abalala.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana atandika omulimu n’abayizi be nga alina ekigendererwa eky’okuwa obuweereza eri abakadde mu kifo ekivunaanyizibwa essomero. Ku lw’ekyo, mu mutendera guno, beetaaga okukung’aanya amawulire agakwata ku bantu ababeera mu kifo kino n’ebyo bye beetaaga. Ku bino ebikolebwa wammanga, kiki ekiyinza okuyambako abayizi okuyiga okuzuula ebyetaago by’ekibinja ky’abantu?
answer_a: Zimba omuti gw'ebizibu okuzuula embeera embi, ng'olaga ebintu ebigiviiriddeko n'ebigivaamu.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okukung’aanyizaamu amawulire, gamba ng’ebibuuzo n’okuyita mu kubuuza abantu, era olambike emigaso gyabyo n’obubi bwabyo.
answer_c: Noonyereza ku mukutu gwa SWOT era okomekkereze omulagirizi ku nsonga, ng'olaga amaanyi, emikisa, obunafu, n'ebintiisa.
answer_d: Lowooza ku bizibu ebiyinza okuba nga bibakosa, oluvannyuma nonde engeri z’okukungaanya amawulire.

question: Mu kibiina kya P.8, mu somo erisooka ery’essomo erikwata ku Bintu eby’Tekinologiya Ebikola Obulungi Ate Ebigumirawo, omusomesa atandika ng’annyonnyola amakulu g’ekigambo okugumirawo. Okusobola okuyamba abayizi okutegeera, omusomesa asalawo okukinyonnyola ng’akozesa olugero olufaananyi. Lugero ki omusomesa lw’ayinza okukozesa okusobola okwongera okutegeza abayizi amakulu g’okugumirawo?
answer_a: Mu maka, bafumba paketi y’obuwunga bwa noodles ku kyekiro eri abantu bana. Basatu bokka be batuula okulya era olw’enjala ennyingi, balyawo obuwunga bwa noodles bwonna. Omuntu eyabadde abuze bw’atuuka, amaka gaddamu okukozesa amaanyi n’amazzi okufumba obuwunga bwa noodles obulala eri omuntu eyabadde abuze.
answer_b: Omulimi w’akatale akatono asiga ebika by’enva ez’enjawulo ezirina obwetaavu bw’emmere enjawulo, gamba nga ennyaanya, karoti, n’omumwaanyi omwaka ogumu, ate obulo, obutungulu, n’ebbeetisi omwaka oguddako, okusobola okukuuma ettaka nga lirimu ebirungo ebyetaagisa okusobola okusiga ebirime ebirala mu biseera eby’omu maaso.
answer_c: Omuyizi alina essimu erina batuli entono era natandika okugi-chaajiinga. Mu kiseera kye kimu, atandika okuzannya omuzannyo, naye omuzannyo gunywa batuli mangu okusinga ekyuma ekichaajiinga bwe kigizzaawo. Mu ngeri eyo, essimu ejja kuggwaamu amaanyi oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, kale omuyizi akyusa n'akozesa ekichaajiinga ekyaanyiiza amangu.
answer_d: Omukugu akola emmeeza ateekateeka era akola emmeeza mu ngeri nti bw'asalako ebiceere okuva ku lubaawo olw'omuti, omukugu akola emmeeza akozesa olubaawo mu bujjuvu era awa ebikutule emirimu emirala, ng'akendeeza omuwendo gw'ebintu ebikozesebwa era ng'atumbula enkola eno ng'ekintu ekimanyiddwa okwongera ku ntundwe.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omunaana akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku pulojekiti erimu okuzimba ekifananyi ky’amasannyalaze g’ennyumba. Bw’akebera emirimu gy’abayizi, akiraba nti ekibinja kimu tekisobolodde okukola ettaala za LED mu bisenge eby’enjawulo okukolela awamu n’okuzikirawo buli emu kuayo. Ku bikolwa bino omusomesa by’ayinza okukola, kiki ekiyinza okuyamba ekibinja kino okutegeera engeri y’okuzimbamu omutendera gw’amasannyalaze gwe beetaaga?
answer_a: Balage nti enkolagana wakati w’amatala erina okuba nga ya mugattiro (parallel) gasobole okuba nga geeyimiriddeko. Oluvannyuma, basabe bakole ekifaananyi ekiraga enkolagana eno era bagikope mu muzingo gw’ekyokulabirako.
answer_b: Landiisa engeri z’omutendera gw’amasannyalaze ogwa seriizi n’ogwa paraleli, ng’olaga nti mu gwa seriizi, amasannyalaze gakwata ekkubo limu, kale ettaala tezeeyimiridde. Oluvannyuma, basabe bakwatte ettaala mu mutendera gwa paraleli era bakebere ebijja muvvuddemu.
answer_c: Mutunule ekifaananyi ky’omulandira gw’amasannyalaze gwe bazimbye era mubannyonnyole nti okusobola amatala okukola nga tegakwatagana, galina kukwasibwa mu nkola ey’omukwanaganyo. Oluvannyuma, mbasabe bongere bakole ekifaananyi ky’amasannyalaze nga bakwasa amatala gonna okuva ku nsibuko era bazimbe omulandira gw’amasannyalaze omupya.
answer_d: Munoonyereze nabo engeri ettaala gye zeeyisaamu nga zikwasiddwa mu nsengeka eya siriizi n’eya paraleli nga muliko ezimu muziggyako. Oluvannyuma, mwekkaanye ekifaananyi ky’omukutu gw’amasannyalaze gwe bazimbye okusobola okumanya enkyukakyuka ze bagenda okukola. Mu nkomerero, mbasabe bakwasize ettaala zonna eziri mu kyoogerero okusinziira ku kifaananyi ekipya.

question: Omusomesa ow'ekibiina eky'omukaaga agenda kukebera abayizi be ng'akozesa ekigendererwa kino: "Okukyusakyusa ebyuma ebiriwo mu tekinologiya n'okuzuula obwetaavu bwe byaddamu mu mbeera mwe byakuzibwa." Ku bikolwa by'omuyizi bino wammanga, kiki ekisobozesa okulaga nti ekigendererwa omusomesa ky'ateese kyatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Bageraageranya engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okugonjoola ebizibu ezikwatagana n’ekibinja ky’obwetaavu obumu obwateekebwawo.
answer_b: Bageraageranya ku bwetaavu obubadde buzzeewo mu bitundu eby’enjawulo eby’enkulaakulana y’embeera z’abantu n’enkyukakyuka zaabyo okuyita mu biseera.
answer_c: Bannyonnyola okufaanagana mu mbeera z'ebyafaayo ebyakozesebwa okuteekateeka ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'ekika kye kimu okumala ekiseera.
answer_d: Bageraageranya ebyetaago ebyaliwo mu kutondeka ebintu bya tekinologiya ebifaanagana okusinziira ku mulembe mwe byatondekerwa.

question:
Omusomesa aleeta eri abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekya munaana, ng'omutwe gw'ekibiina, ebirivaamu okukozesa ekkompyuta ennyo ku by'okusoma. Oluvannyuma lw'okwanjula omutwe, asaba abayizi okunoonya ebimanyiddwa ku mutwe ogwo ku yintaneeti.
Kiki ky'ayinza okubawa ng'amagezi abayizi basobole okufuna ebimanyiddwa ebituufu ku mutwe ogwateereddwawo ku byuma eby'enjawulo ebinoonyeza ebintu ku yintaneeti?
answer_a: Noonya obuwandiike obusookerwako n'ebbanka y'ebiwandiiko endala, nga weekubira mu ezo ez'ebibiina ebimanyiddwa oba ebikiikirira, ng'osooka okufuba okulonda emikutu gyabyo egya yintaneeti emikulu okuyita mu mannya ga domini zaabyo: .org (ekibiina), .gov (gavumenti n'ebitongole byayo ebitongole) ne .edu (eby'enjigiriza). Kozesa omulamwa ogusalako bulungi ekyo ekinoonyezebwa, oba okirambike ebigambo mu kyuma ekinoonya, okusobola okukendeeza ku bivaamu.
answer_b: Okukozesa ebifananyi ebiri ku sikaani, okunoonya ebivaamu ebyangu okuyita mu bigambo ebikozeseddwa mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, gamba: okukozesa ebifananyi ebiri ku sikaani, nga tetukozezza bubonero. Oluvannyuma okukendeeza ku kunoonya nga tuwandiika ebigambo ebinnyonnyola obulungi, gamba: okukozesa ekifananyi ekiri ku sikaani okumala essaawa 8 nga tonnawummuza. Era n’okuteeka eggwanga, olulimi, ebigambo ebikulu, n’ekiseera eky’okukyusaamu ebiriwo ku mutwe gw’ekigambo. Teeka ekigambo mu bubonero era okozese obubonero + ne –, okwongera ekigambo ekikulu oba okuggyawo bye tutayagala.
answer_c: Londa ennyanguyirizi ennyangu era eyanguwa (jukira nti ennyanguyirizi bw’eba ng’eyingira mu dayatabeesi ennyingi, yegendereza). Oluvannyuma nonya amawulire ng’olonda eggwanga ly’oyagala okumanya ebikwata ku ly’eryo n’ekitundu ky’omutwe gw’ogenda okunoonya, gamba nga: ssaayansi, tekinologiya, eby’amasanyu, emizannyo. Okunoonya, kozesa ebigambo ebikulu, tokosa bubonero oba ennukuta ennene; bw’oba omanyi engeri ekigambo gye kirina okweyoleka, kikube mu bunnuku “nga bw’ekiri”, n’ebigambo byonna.
answer_d: Okukola enteekateeka y'emirimu erimu okukungaanya ebyawandiikibwa ebikwata ku mulamwa ogunoonyerezebwako. Oluvannyuma lw'okutuuka ku mutendera guno, genda mu nsibuko z'amawulire, gamba ng'ebitabo, magazini, ebiwandiiko, ebifo by'ebitabo ku yintaneeti, omulamwa gye gwekenneenyezebwa mu bujjuvu. Weegendereze ennyukuta ennene n'ennene entono ng'owandiika ebiwandiiko. Fuba okussa obubonero ku bigambo oba ebinyonyola by'oyagala okunoonya, okwongera okunoonyereza n'okukendeeza ku bivaamu.

question: Omusomesa ow’omu middle school asabye abayizi be okwekenneenya engeri omulimu gwabwe gye gukoleddwamu okukakasa oba kyeyambye okugonjoola obwetaavu obwazuulwa ku ntandikwa y’omulimu. Abayizi bwe bakeenenya ebyavaamu, bakizuula nti abantu be baakolera tebalowooza nti enteekateeka yaabwe egonjodde ekizibu ekyaliwo era, kyekiva gibalemesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa omusomesa kye yali ateese. Ku bikolwa bino eby’obuyigiriza, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okuyamba abayizi okwaŋŋanga obuzibu mu kuteekateeka omulimu gwabwe?
answer_a: Baawe amagezi ge banaawa omukozesa, agamuyamba okutegeera ebintu ebyo obuweereza bye bukola obulungi.
answer_b: Bateese okukola okunoonyereza ku mawulire agafuniddwa okusobola okuzuula n'okutereeza ebitundu ebitatuukirizibwa mu nkulaakulana y'obuweereza.
answer_c: Baanike amagezi ku ngeri y’okutereezaamu obuweereza obwo obuweereddwa era mubasabe okuddamu okunoonyereza ku byetaago by’abakozesa ebituufu.
answer_d: Bakubirize okukola enkyukakyuka ez’amaanyi mu pulojekiti yaabwe era obasabe beebuze ku bakozesa emirundi emirala, nga bassira nnyo ku bitundu ebyali tebikulaakulanyiziddwa bulungi mu pulojekiti yaabwe.

question: Mu kitundu Eky’okwagala okukolera awamu n’Omusuubuzi, abayizi abali mu Siniya ey’Omwaka ogw’Olubereberye bakola ku kukola omulimu gw’enteekateeka. Mu mbeera eno, ekibinja kisalawo okuzimba ebintu ebikuŋŋaanya amazzi g’enkuba okusobola okukozesa amazzi ago agakuŋŋaanyiziddwa. Bateekateeka okunoonyereza, oluvannyuma ne bayiiya ebintu ebyo okusinziira ku bungi bw’amazzi gebayinza okuŋŋaanya. Oluvannyuma bagenda kumalawo ekifo we bagenda okubiteeka n’ebintu ebyetaagisa. Era bagenda kuteekateeka ekkaati ya Gantt n’ensimbi ezigenda okukozesebwa mu mulimu ogwo. Nga tutunuulidde okuyiga n’enkola ekolebwamu, buzibu ki obuleetebwawo mu kukola omulimu ogwo ogw’enteekateeka abayizi bwe bakoze?
answer_a: Ebirowoozo ebikozesebwa mu pulojekiti tebikwatagana na buzibu oba bwetaago obwali bumaze okutegeerekeka abayizi.
answer_b: Ebirowoozo ebikulu ebikozesebwa mu pulojekiti tebirimu nteekateeka ya mirimu eginaakolebwa abayizi mu buli mutendera gwa pulojekiti.
answer_c: Ebirowoozo ebikulu ebikozesebwa mu pulojekiti tebiraga biragiro bya tekiniki abayizi bye balina okutunuulira nga bazimba ebiyungirizi by'amazzi g'enkuba.
answer_d: Eteeka erikwata ku pulojekiti teritwala mu ngeri nti abayizi bageraageranya enteekateeka z'ebintu ebiteekebwamu amazzi g'enkuba ebiri ku katale nga tebannatondekawo zaabwe.

question:
Mu kibiina kya S.4, omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi ku kiruubirirwa kino: “Okutegeera obutandikwa n'amaanyi g'ebintu ebireeta obucaafu mu nampewo.” Ng'omukolo, omusomesa asaba abayizi okukolera mu bibinja okunoonyereza ku bintu ebyo n'amaanyi gaabyo, n'okuteekateeka olutindo lw'obubaka (PowerPoint presentation) nga mulimu amawulire ge bazuula. Ng'ebibinja biyanjula emirimu gyabyo, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi abasinga bamaliriza nga bagamba nti ebintu ebireeta obucaafu mu nampewo biva ku bantu bokka.

Kati mu bigambo bino omusomesa by'ayogera, ebiruwa ebiyinza okuba eby'omugaso okuyamba abayizi okutereeza emirimu gyabwe n'okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa?
answer_a: Kituufu, olaze nti ebikolwa by’abantu birina omukosa omubi nnyo ku bwengula. Wabula, mikutu ki emirala egivaamu obucaafu bw’empewo egitaliimu bikolwa bya bantu? Mikosa ki egiva mu mikutu gy’obucaafu gino?
answer_b: Obulungi obw'enjawulo, mu kwolesa kwo wasinziddeko nti ffenna tukosebwa obucaafu bw'empewo. Eky'okukola ekisigadde kwe kwongera ku kunoonyereza kuno nga tuddamu ebibuuzo ku tekinologiya ki azza obucaafu mu bbanga? Kiki ky'osobola okuteesa okukendeeza ku bukosefu bw'ebintu ebyo ebivaamu obucaafu?
answer_c: Omulimu mulungi nnyo, okirizza nti amafuta agasimbibwa mu ttaka ge nsonga enkulu evaaako obucaafu bw’empewo olw’okukozesebwa kwayo ennyo mu bikolwa by’abantu eby’enjawulo. Wabula, olowooza nti ngeri ki amafuta gano agasimbibwa mu ttaka gy’agalina ku mbeera y’obutonde n’obulamu bw’abantu? Ngeri ki ezo ngeri ezo ze tuyinza okukozesa okukendeeza ku buzibu obwo?
answer_d: Kulungi, olaze bulungi obubi bwa kaboni monoksaidi ng’ekintu ekizza omukka. Naye olina okubuuza nti omuwendo gwa kaboni monoksaidi oguva mu mmotoka z’abantu gwenkana ki ku mwonoonefu gw’omukka? Tuyinza kukendeeza tutya obungi bw’ekifulumizibwa nga tukozesa entambula y’olukale?

question: Omusomesa mu mwaka ogw’olubereberye ogw’amasomero agawaggulu asaba abayizi be okuteekateeka ekyaati ya Gantt okukola enteekateeka y’obuweereza bwe bategeka okukola mu ssomero. Mu kuteekateeka kwayo, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi tebabala bulungi budde obunaabatwalira okukola buli ku mirimu era, n’olwekyo, tebagenda kusobola okumaliriza okuteekateeka okukola obuweereza ku budde. Mu ngeri ki omusomesa gy’ayinza okuyambamu abayizi okuddamu okuteekateeka emirimu gyabwe okusobola okutuukiriza omulimu ogwabaweereddwa?
answer_a: Laga abayizi eky'okulabirako ky'omulimu ogwa bulijjo ogwetaagisa okulowooza ku budde obwetaagisa okukola oguddako.
answer_b: Saba abayizi okulowooza ku kigendererwa ky'omulimu gwabwe era okuva ku kyo bakole entereeza y'ebintu byonna ebyetaagisa okukola omulimu oguteereddwamu.
answer_c: Waayo abayizi embeera ey’okufaananira ddala ng’abalina obuzibu okukola ekintu olw’okuba tebasoose kukola kirala ekyetaagisa okukikola.
answer_d: Ng’oli wamu n’abayizi, kola okunoonyereza ku ngeri y’emirimu egiteereddwawo, gikwataganye n’ebiseera ebyassiddwaawo, era weerabire oba ebyo ebyassiddwaawo bituufu.

question: Mu kitundu ekiyigiriza ku Nkulaakulana n'Okuteekerateekera Omuwendo mu kibiina ky'omwaka ogusooka mu Siniya, omusomesa agenda okutandika okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ku nteekateeka y'emirimu gy'ekibinja omwaka gwonna. Okusobola okutuuka ku kino, ekigendererwa ekisooka kye bagenda okukoleraako kwe: "Okutegeera obwetaavu n'emikisa egikwaatagana n'okutondekawo omuwendo". Misinde ki gy'emirimu omusomesa gy'alina okukolera awamu n'abayizi be okusobola okutuuka ku kigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Omusomesa annyonnyola omulamwa gw'obwetaavu n'obuweereza era n'awa ebyokulabirako ebitangaala ku miramwa gyombi. Oluvannyuma, asaba abayizi okunnyonnyola n'okulambulula ebika by'obuweereza eby'enjawulo mu bibinja okusinziira ku bwetaavu bwe bukola.
answer_b: Omusomesa aleeta embeera z’obwetaavu ezibaddewo mu mbeera ez’enjawulo ezedda era nga zaagonjoolwa okuyita mu buweereza obw’enjawulo. Oluvannyuma, abasaba okunoonyereza mbeera ki ezireeteddeewo obuweereza obupya bubiri obw’omulembe guno ogwa 21.
answer_c: Omusomesa abuuzizza abayizi kye bategeera mu ky'etaago. Bawandiika amakulu ge bakkaanyizzaako. Oluvannyuma, bawa ebyokulabirako ne basaba abayizi okukubaganya ebirowoozo mu bibinja ku biruwa ku bino ebiyinza okugonjoolwa ekikolebwa eky'omulembe. Bwe bamala okutuula mu lukiiko olukulu, babawa obukodyo obumu obw'okutegeera etaago.
answer_d: Omusomesa annyonnyola amakulu g'omulamwa gw'obwetaavu era n'awa abayizi eby'okulabirako. Oluvannyuma, abasaba okukola okunoonyereza ku mirimu egiriwo mu bitundu byabwe. Abasaba okuteekateeka omulimu mu lulimi oluddako mwe banaayogererako ku mirimu egyo n'okunnyonnyola engeri gye giwaamu eby'okuddamu eri obwetaavu.

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa ow’abaana abato alina ennyiriri bbiri ez’ebizimbiso nga zirimu omuwendo gwe gumu, naye ng’ennnyiriri emu efaanana ng’eri mpanvu okusinga endala olw’okuba ebizimbiso byawukanye. Omu ku baana ajja eri omusomesa n’agamba nti, ‘Musawo, olunyiriri luno lulina ebizimbiso bingi okusinga olulala.’ Okusinziira ku tteeka lya J. Piaget, ndowooza ki eyoleka endowooza y’omwana eno?
answer_a: Okukozesa ebirowoozo ku kintu kimu.
answer_b: Okutabika kw'enzikiriza oba obuwangwa
answer_c: Okukyusa ekintu
answer_d: obutakyuka

question: Omwana, ng’atambula ne kitaawe mu nkuba, atunula waggulu mu ggulu n’alaga ebire ng’agamba: ‘Ebire byeraliikirivu, y’ensonga lwaki bikaaba.’ Okusinziira ku Jean Piaget mu nkola ye ey’obwongo, kiki ekiraga endowooza y’omwana eno?
answer_a: Obusukkulumu bw'emyoyo
answer_b: Okutabika kw'enzikiriza oba obuwangwa
answer_c: Obukole bw'abantu
answer_d: Obubumanyifu

question: Mu kibiina ky’abaana abato, abalenzi n’abawala bali mu kusiiga ebifaananyi n’ekkalaka ku lusuku lw’essomero. Fabián agamba omusomesa nti tayagala kusiiga kubanga ekkalaka eya pinki y’esigaddewo ate nga pinki bbala lya bawala. Omusomesa amugamba nti langi za buli muntu, si za balenzi oba abawala bokka, era alina okugezaako okusiiga nayo nga abasiizi bwe bakola. Mu butonde bw’omuntu, ndaga ki okusomesa kuno kwe kuyambako okukulaakulanya?
answer_a: Okusiima omuntu bwe yeejjisa.
answer_b: Endowooza omuntu gy’alina ku bubwe
answer_c: Obuntu bw'omuntu obukwata ku by'okukwatagana kw'abantu ng'abaami n'abakyala
answer_d: Endagabuntu y'ekikula ky'omuntu

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa ategeka omukolo oguyitibwa 'omutongole ow'olwaleero', ogw'omwana, buli lunaku, okugabana n'abayizi banne byayagala, ebyo byasiraamu, n'eby'amasanyu bye yayagalira ddala okuyita mu bifaananyi, ebintu byajjukira, ebizannyisibwa, n'enjogera ezirimu obumanyirivu. answer_a: Amakulu
answer_b: Omukwano
answer_c: Obumu
answer_d: Obulamu obulungi

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okuna ng’ali n’abayizi be ku ddembe ly’abaana abalaga embeera eno: “Anita yakubwa omutwe ennyo bwe yagwa okuva ku siriidi ng’azannya ne banne mu luggya lw’essomero. Oluvannyuma lw’akabenje, Anita yatwalibwa mangu omusomesa we mu ddwaaliro, gy’afunira obujjanjabi obwetaagisa.” Oluvannyuma, omusomesa asaba abayizi okutegeera eddembe Anita ly’akozesa mu mbeera eyo era oluvannyuma, okuleeta embeera endala omutwalirwa eddembe lye limu. Ku biraga ebiri wammanga, kiraga ki ekikulu okukebereza okuyiga kw’abayizi mu mulimu ogwo omusomesa gw’aleese?
answer_a: Balaga eddembe enkulu ery'abaana.
answer_b: Balaga eby'obuyinza bye bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo nga bakozesa eby'okulabirako ebifaako.
answer_c: Bakola endowooza ku bukulu bw’okukola dduyiro n’okukuuma eddembe lyabwe
answer_d: Bategeera ebiseera ebyo eddembe ly'abaana we lityoboolerwa.

question: Omusomesa ategeka omulimu omuli abalenzi n’abawala mu kibinja kye mwe banaakyalirwa ekibiina ekisooka okuva mu ssomero. Bwe banaatuuka, buli mwana owa pulayimale anaatuula ku lusegere lw’omwana ow’ekibiina ekisooka, era bakubirizibwa okumanyigana nga bayita mu kwogera. Oluvannyuma, bajja kukola omukono ogw’okusiiga awamu era bafulume mu luggya okugabana emizannyo. Mu nkomerero, bajja kwogera mu kibinja ekinene ku byo bye bayiseemu awamu. Mu nsonga z’obuyigiriza eziddirira, nsonga ki ey’obuyigiriza ekulizibwaamu nnyo mu bumanyirivu buno obw’okuyiga?
answer_a: Obumu
answer_b: Omukwano
answer_c: Amakulu
answer_d: Okuyitimusa

question: Okusinziira ku muzannyo ng’ekikolwa eky’omubiri ekitegekeddwa, myaka ki omuntu weetaaga okutuukiriza ekimu ku bintu ebikulu eby’omuzannyo, nga kino kiba kwenyigira ng’omuntu kinnoomu okusinga okukolera awamu?

answer_a: Piaget

question: Mu birowoozo bino ebikulu, kiki ekiraga omukwano ogw’amazima wakati w’enkulakulana y’omukwano n’emikwano gy’omu maaso; okusinziira ku Bowlby's theory?
answer_a: Abantu abakulaakulanya enkolagana ey’okwegattako n’omulabirizi atali maama omuzaazi tebasinga kuteekawo nkolagana za bwesige.
answer_b: Abantu abalabirirwa abalabirizi abakyusa obungi bw’obujjanjabi bwe bawa mu myaka egy’obuto balaga okukulaakulana okw’amaanyi mu bwetwaze bw’enneewulira.
answer_c: Abantu ababa n’abantu be banyumattira nabo nga bakyali bato bayinza okutandikawo emikwano emirungi egibatereeza naye batera okukula nga tebeesiga bantu.
answer_d: Abantu abataakulaakulanya mukwano mu myaka egyasooka mu bulamu balaga omutindo ogw’okunoonya obuyambi n’okubeera okumpi, wamu n’okwolesa enneewulira, ka zibeere nnungi oba mbi.

question:
Enkola eno yakozesebwa nnyo mu kusomesa abaana abato nga bayita mu kunoonyereza ku bintu eby’enjawulo ebyakolebwa abantu abakulu nga bakozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo gamba ng’ebyawandiikidwa, ebifaananyi, ne vidiyo. Abaana nabo beenyigira mu kunoonyereza kuno nga boogera ku byo baagala, enkaayana zaabwe, ebyabatuukako, n’embeera endala nnyingi eziyinza okuyambako okusalawo ku nsonga z’okusomesa era nga kiyamba okukulaakulanya engeri zaabwe.
Nteekateeka y’ebisomesebwa ki eyogerwako mu mutundu ogwo waggulu?
answer_a: Waldorf
answer_b: Omutendera ogwa High Scope
answer_c: Montessori

question:
Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato asomera akabinja ke ak'abaana abalenzi n'abawala olugero 'Ennyenje Enjala Ennyo', balukubaganyaako ebirowoozo, oluvannyuma n'abagamba bakole omulimu ogw'okwanjula ebikwata ku mmere ennungi n'embi n'ebivaamu. Okukola kino, agabanya ekibiina mu bubinja bubiri obutono: akamu kajja kukola olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere ennungi n'akalala, olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere embi. Okumaliriza, banjula wamu era bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku by'ebafunye.

Kuyiga ki omulimu guno gwe gukutiriza okusinga mu baana?
answer_a: Okukola ebipande ebiwandiikeebwako ebikulu
answer_c: Okussaamu ekitiibwa okwetaba n'obuyambi bw'abalala
answer_d: Okumanya embeera ezisobozesa okwekulaakulanya.

question: Ekibiina ky’abaana abakulu mu senaali kirimu abaana kkumi. Bonna batambula n’obuvumu era banyumirwa ebikolwa eby’okutambula. Batandise okulaga okwagala mu kusoomoozebwa gamba ng’okutikka, okukweka, okutuuma, n’okugatta ebintu. N’olwekyo, omusomesa ateekateeka okukwata ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: “Okwegezaamu ebintu nga bakola ku mbeera eziriwo ddala, gamba ng’okutuuka ku bintu, okunyiga obutambi ku byuma ebivuga, okuggya ebizannyisibwa mu bintu bye biterekebwamu, okukung’aanya ebintu, n’ebirala” era “Okulaga okwagala n’okumatira nga batambula awatali buzibu mu mbeera eza bulijjo n’emizannyo”. Nga twetegerezza empisa z’ekibiina ky’abaana bano, nkola ki ey’okuyiga eyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okukwata ku bigendererwa ebyo ebirondeddwa?
answer_a: Omuzannyo ogw'okukebera: abaana bakebera, bakwatakwata era bagatta ebintu, nga bazuula ensi ku sipiidi yaabwe.
answer_b: Omutendera gw'ebyemizannyo: abaana bamaliriza omusinde ogw'ebizibu eby'enjawulo, nga bagoberera enteekateeka entongole.
answer_c: Akabba ka byabugagga: abaana bakebera nga batuula okwetooloola akabba akajjuziddwa ebintu ebya bulijjo n'ebyo ebirondeddwa
answer_d: Ekifo ky'ebyamazina: abaana bazannya, batambulatambula era bakolagana n'ebintu ebirabika obulungi ebiterekeddwa mu kifo.

question:
Omusomesa yeetaaga okulonda ekyuma eky’omulembe ekisobozesa empuliziganya wakati w’abali mu buli kibinja era naye; ekisobozesa okugabana n’okukyusa ebiwandiiko mu budde bwennyini; era nga kisobola okuteekawo emirimu n’okugigabira buli muntu mu kibinja.
Kiki ku bintu bino wammanga ekisinga okutuukana n’ebyo omusomesa byetaaga?
answer_a: Akataffeesi ak'omukutu ogwa kompyuta akagabanyizibwako emikutu gya yintaneeti nga Symbaloo
answer_b: Enkola y'okukozesa okuteesa ebirowoozo nga Stormboard
answer_c: Enkola y'okutereka ebipapula ku intaneeti nga Google Drive
answer_d: Omukutu ogw'okukyusa endowooza nga okukozesa ebifaananyi, okufaanana nga Marqueed

question: Soma okunnyonnyola kuno wammanga: Emu ku ndowooza ze ezisinga obukulu mu by’enjigiriza y’enjogera y’Obumanyirivu Obutabaganyiziddwa (Mediated Learning Experience - MLE), obukyusakyusa mu bwongo bw’omuntu mwe busibuka. MLE kitegeeza omutindo gw’enkolagana y’omuntu n’obwetooloole bwe, omuli okunnyonnyola engeri obwongo gye bukola ng’ekivaamu okusaasaanya obuwangwa. Okusinziira ku ndowooza eno, enkola y’okutabaganya etwalibwa ng’eyongera ku busobozi bw’omuntu okutuuka ku njigiriza ey’omugaso, ng’okutegeera nti okuyita mu yo, omuntu asobola okukyusa enjigiriza etuukiddwaako mu mbeera enjawulo era n’asobola okugikozesa mu mbeera oba embeera endala, ng’ekubiriza okuggya obumanyirivu bw’omuntu ku bubwe mu njigiriza empya. Mu bawandiisi abalondeddwa wammanga, ani alowoozebwa okuba n’enjogera eno ku nkola y’okuyigiriza n’okuyiga eyannyonnyolwa mu mutundu oguweddeko?
answer_a: John Dewey
answer_b: Paulo Freire
answer_c: Albert Bandura
answer_d: Reuven Feuerstein

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina ekyokusatu, mu kitundu ekikwata ku ddembe ly'abaana, yalonda ekitundu kino okuva mu lubalo *Omuwala Ataalina Erinnya*, olwa Saúl Schkolnik, okutandika okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ku ddembe ly'okumanyika: Waaliwo omuwala ataali na linnya lyonna. Si nti yalina erinnya eryewuunyisa, oba erimu okwogera kyazibu, oba erimu ku mannya ago amakadde ennyo, oba mpozzi ery'amawanga... Nedda! Yali talina linnya lyonna. Eky'amazima kiri nti, omuntu bw'aba nga ye Maria era omuntu n'ayita: —Maria! Omuntu akoola endabika ya Maria era n'addamu: —Ani ampita? Naye, omuntu bw'aba nga talina linnya lyonna, olwo tasobola kukola ndabika y'omuntu... Era ebintu bitandika okubula okutuusa omuntu lw'akomawo ng'atalina matu. Ku bibuuzo bino wammanga, kibuuzo ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okubuuza okukwataganya butereevu ebyasomeddwa n'eddembe erigenda okusomebwa mu kibiina?
answer_a: Kiki ku bikwata ku muwala ali mu lubalo ekikukutte ennyo omwoyo n'olwaki?
answer_b: Kitu ky’olowooza nti kissaanye n’eddembe ly’abaana mu lugero luno?
answer_c: Olowooza kiki ekiyinza okuba nga kye kyavaamu omuwala mu lugero okubula erinnya?
answer_d: Engeri ki emboozi gy’eyinza okuggwamu mu ngeri ennungi eri omuwala ali mu mboozi?

question: Omusomesa w'abaana abato, oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okuzuula obuzibu, ateekateeka engeri z'okusomesa ezisobozesa ekibinja ky'abalenzi n'abawala okwogera ku nneewulira zaabwe. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, y'eriwa etuukana n'ekigendererwa ky'omusomesa?
answer_a: Muzannye omuzannyo ogw’ekigambo era musabe abalenzi n’abawala okulaga enneewulira emboozi gy’ebaleetera.
answer_b: Saba abalenzi n'abawala okujjukira n'okusiiga ebifaananyi by'embeera ezabaleetera engeri z'ebiwuubaalo ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Muzannye omukube gw'ebipimo by'emyoyo, musabe abalenzi n'abawala okuguyiringisa n'okwatuukiriza erinnya ly'omwoyo oguvaamu.
answer_d: Baliriza abalenzi n'abawala okuzina, nga balaga enneewulira ezitali zimu nga bwe ziggwayo mu luyimba.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina kya ‘kindergarten’ ategese ekibiina mu bifo eby’emizannyo era ng’ayongeddeko ebintu ebipya eby’okukozesa ebisensa, gamba ng’emmeeza z’amazzi, ekitangaala, omusenyu, n’ensigo. Abaana balaze essanyu lingi okuzannya n’ebintu ebipya; kyokka, wabaddewo obutakkaanya wakati waabwe nga babikozesa. Nga tutunuulira omutendera gw’abayizi, engeri ki ku zino wammanga esinga okukulaakulanya obumu mu baana?
answer_a: Omusomesa yeegatta ku bazannyi b'abaana ng'ayingira mu kutereeza enkaayana ezibaawo era ng'alaga enkozesa entuufu ey'ebikozesebwa.
answer_b: Omusomesa akolawo akabanga ak’okwogera n’abaana okuzimba endagaano ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa n’okugonjoola enkaayana mu mirembe.
answer_c: Omusomesa assaawo amateeka agafaanagana ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebipya mu biseera by’okuzannya era abajjukiza buli kiseera okukutumbula obumu.
answer_d: Omusomesa akola enteekateeka ey’okukyusa ebibinja ng’akozesa ebibinja ebitono eby’abazannyi okwewala enkaayana n’okukutanya emirembe mu banno.

question: Omusomesa omukulu ow’ekika kya Siniya Kinda gaddemu alambise ekigendererwa kino okuva mu mutima gw’okubeera awamu n’obumannyi: "Okutegeera ebikolwa ebituufu n’ebikyamu olw’okubeera awamu mu ngeri entuufu mu kibinja, ebyolekeddwa mu mbeera ez’enjawulo ezabulijjo n’emizannyo". Okutuuka ku kino, mu bbanga ly’okwogera, bateekateeka amateeka agafuga okubeera awamu okuzuula eby’okukola ku buzibu obw’enjawulo obubaawo mu bannaabwe. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyayogerwa?
answer_a: Mu kiseera ky’okwaniriza, omusomesa abuuza ku mateeka, era Rafael agamba: "Olina okutambulira munda mu kibiina so si kudduka."
answer_b: Mu budde bw'emmere, Daniela alya ku mmere ya munne, era akaaba. Ignacia, bw'amulaba nga akaaba, agenda eri omusomesa n'amugamba: "Munnange yeetaaga obuyambi."
answer_c: Mu biseera by’okuzannya obwereere, Matías atunuulira Alejandro ng’azannya loole, oluvannyuma n’amusemberera, n’amuggyako eky’okuzannya n’agamba: “kati ge magezi gange, omusomesa yagambye tulina okugabana.”
answer_d: Mu biseera by'okukola mu bitundu, Leonor ne Sebastián basuula ebikondo by'emiti okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala mu kisulo. Agustín abasemberera n'abagamba: "Temusaanye kukola ekyo, muyinza okututomera ebikondo."

question: Bikugu ki ebikuzibwa mu bawala n'abalenzi okuyita mu mizannyo egikolerwa mu mateeka?
answer_a: Okubonero kw'embeera ezibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_b: Okutegeera obulungi embeera z'abalala n'okumalawo obutakkaanya
answer_c: Ebintu ebiyamba mu mbeera z'obukulembeze okuli okukkiriziganya n'okukyusakyusa mu mirimu.
answer_d: Okuyiga emicito n'obuvunaanyizibwa ebiteekeddwawo mu nsi

question: Ku mutendera gw'abaana abato, abakugu mu by'enjigiriza beetaaga okukebera mu bulamu obwa bulijjo ekigendererwa kino okuva mu mutima gw'okunoonyereza ku butonde: "Okunnyonnyola ebimu ku bintu ebikulu ebikwata ku butonde bwe banoonyereza, gamba nga langi, obuwewufu, obunene, ebbugumu n'ebirala." Kiki abaana kye bandikoze okukiraga nti ekigendererwa kino kituukiddwaako?
answer_a: Mu kiseera ky’okuyiga, Santiago asiiga amayinja ag’enjawulo mu bunene.
answer_b: Mu kiseera ky’ekyemisana, Pablo atunuulira akajiiko era bw’alaba ekifaananyi kye ng’akyeyoleka agamba: “Laba, Pablo!”
answer_c: Mu kiseera María ky’amaze mu luggya, akuŋŋaanya ebika by’amatabi g’emiti egy’enjawulo mu kabaati.
answer_d: Mu biseera by’okuzannya obwereere mu luggya, Soledad akuba ensigo mu ngalo ze nagamba: “Nneneenya”

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina ekisooka ateekateeka omulimu gw’ekibinja okukolera ku bukugu bw’okunoonyereza awamu n’ekigendererwa ky’ekibiina: "Okutegeera obwongo n’omulimu gwabwo." Okutandika omulimu guno, agenda kuwa buli kibinja omutooke, omucungwa, n’omupeera, era agenda kubasaba okuwunyiriza, okulaba, okukwatako, n’okulega ku buli kibala. Nga twetegereza embeera eno waggulu, ku mirimu egiddako omusomesa gy’ayinza okuteekamu abayizi okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekigguddwaayo?
answer_a: Mu lupapula olulambika engeri z’ebibala eby’enjawulo, lamba eby’okuddamu ebibuuzo ebiyinza okuddibwamu nga tukozesa obutegeevu bwaffe: Kibala ki ekya kyenvu? Kibala ki ekiwooma? Kibala ki ekikakanyavu? Kibala ki ekiwunya bulungi?
answer_b: Ku lupapula omuli ebintu ebimanyiddwa okuyita mu birowoozo (ebiwoma/ebikaawa, obuwunga/omukaka, ebiwewuka/ebikakali, akaloosa akasanyusa/akaloosa akabi), ssa ebiriiso mu bibinja okusinziira ku bintu ebyo.
answer_c: Mu lupapula omuli ebifaananyi ebikiikirira buli kimu ku bumanyirivu, lamba eby’okuddamu ku bibuuzo bino: Bumanyirivu ki bwe wakozesezza okukiraba nti ebbugga lya kyenvu? Bwe ki ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti ppere lya matamiivu? Bwe ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti ekikuta ky’ebbugga kirungiirivu? Bwe ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti omucungwa guwoomerevu?
answer_d: Ku lupapula olulaga ebifaananyi by'ebibala bino nga kuliko empandiika enzirugavu erimu obwenyi obusanyufu n'obwenyi obunakuwavu, kozesa langi okuddamu ebibuuzo bino: Bw'abadde olya ekitundu ky'omucungwa, owulidde essanyu oba obunakuvu? Bw'obadde olaba langi y'e'nnanansi, ogisiimye oba togisiimye? Bw'obadde okwata ku kikuta ky'omupeera, owulidde essanyu oba obunakuvu? Bw'obadde owunya omucungwa, ogusiimye oba togusiimye?

question: Okukozesa omulimu ogw’okunoonyereza, omusomesa ayagala okwogera ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte. Okutuukiriza kino, alaga abayizi be eccupa erimu amazzi, amayinja, amafuta, n’omunnyo. Omusomesa alina eccupa eziwerako ezitegekeddwa nga zirimu ebintu bye bimu. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gyo gwonna gwandisobozesezza abayizi okuyiga ku nkola z’okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte ate era ne bakulaakulanya obukugu bwabwe mu kukebera obutuufu bw’ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi?
answer_a: Mu bibinja, basalewo tekiniki ki esinga okuba ey’omugaso okwawula omugatte era oluvannyuma bannyonnyole ensonga lwaki balondedde etekinki eyo.
answer_b: Nga bali mu bubiri bubiri, baawula omugatte nga bakozesa obukodyo bwe balaba nga butuufu, era balambulula okutuuka ku kigero ki obusobozi bwabwe okukola ekyo bwe bwali.
answer_c: Nga buli omu ku lwabwe, bawa ebirowoozo byabwe ebyasooka ku nkola ey’okugoberera, ne bateekawo enkola ey’awamu, oluvannyuma ne bagissa mu nkola.
answer_d: Kinnoomu kinnoomu, bagoberera enkola omusomesa gy’abalaze okwawula omutabulo ate oluvannyuma ne balaga tekinologiya ki ey’okwawula eyakozesebwa mu buli mbeera.

question: Omusomesa mu ssomero ly'abaana abato akola ku kiruubirirwa kino okuva mu mutendera gw'Olulimi: "Okutegeera, okuyita mu kuwuliriza n'obwegendereza, ebiri mu bitabo eby'okusoma n'ebitabu ebitali bya kusoma, okutegeera ensonga enkulu, okulaga by'osinga okwagala, okwogera ku bintu mu ngeri ennyangu, okubuuza ebikwata ku biri mu bitabo." Okukola okwekebejja kw'engeri omulimu gye gutambula, akabonero kano kateereddwaawo: Ategaera ebiri mu bitabo eby'okusoma. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gyo gwe gusuubirwa okukozesebwa okufuna obukakafu ku mutendera ogw'okutuukiriza akabonero ako?
answer_a: Omusomesa alaga abaana ekifaananyi ekiri ku katabo k'olugero olwa "Akalulu n'Enkwawa" oluvannyuma n'ababuza kye balowooza ekitabo kino kigenda kwogeraako.
answer_b: Omusomesa ayita abaana okuzannya olugero "Empologoma n'Embeera" ate n'ababuuza essomo eriri mu lugero n'engeri zaalwo ze zituyigiriza.
answer_c: Omusomesa abalira abaana olugero olwa "Ekimuula Eky'embala" oluvannyuma n'abuuza abaana embala ki engeri z'ebimuula eky'embala kye kyasobola okutegeera ze yalina.
answer_d: Omusomesa asaba abaana okuzannya omuzannyo ogw’ekiggo ogwa "Toseka, Pepe" ate oluvannyuma ababuuza ekitundu kye baasinze okwagala mu lugero era n’abakubiriza okukola enkomerero endala ku lugero.

question: Omuyizi alina kuba ng’alina bumanyirivu ki okusobola okumanya ennyiriri eza hendecasyllabic?
answer_a: Tegeera enjawukana mu bigambo ebituukana.
answer_b: Okutegeera anaphora
answer_c: Okutegeera enjawulo wakati w'ebitontome ebitono eby'obuyiiya
answer_d: Tegeera ebitundu bya bayiti bisatu (tercet) n'ebitundu bya bayiti bina (quartet)

question: Omusomesa akola ku mutindo gw’okutegeera ebyo omuntu by’alowooza ng’asinziira ku kusoma olugero olumpi olugattiddwa wano: Empummula Omwaka ogujja famire yange etegeka okugenda ku mwezi. Maama yagambye nti nkyaleete mukwano gwange bwe mba njagala, okwewala okukoowa y’alowooza bw’atyo. Ekituufu kiri nti ssiri musanyufu nnyo, simanyi, sikyagalanga kuva ku planet eno nnyo, nsinga kwagala kulya nuddles ne ssausi wamu ne cheese. Wadde kiri kityo, mukwano gwange agamba nti yandyagadde nnyo okugenda, naye aŋŋamba nti yeetaaga bikini empya, bagamba nti abakazi abali ku mwezi balabika bulungi nnyo, naye sikikkiriza. Tunaasula ku wooteeri ya Armstrong era tunaatambulira ku Pullmanmoon (nsuubira nti erinaayo toilette). Nnaaleeta entangawuuzi. Catalina Yáñez Kibuzo ki omusomesa ky’ayinza okubuuza abayizi okukubiriza okusoma ku mutindo gw’okutegeera ebyo omuntu by’alowooza?
answer_a: Omutabani omukulu awulira atya ku lugendo olw’okudda ku mwezi?
answer_b: Olugendo lw’okuwummula ku mwezi lwandibadde luteekwa kubeera lulitya?
answer_c: Lwaki maama w'omutabani omukulu amugamba okuyita mukwano gwe?
answer_d: Omutwe gw'omulamwa atwala atya olugendo ku nkomerero y'olugero?

question: Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka gw’essomero, omusomesa w’abaana abato ayagala okukebera ekigendererwa kino okuva mu somo ly’Ennimi z’Obuyiiya: “Okulaga okwagala mu mawulire nga okuyita mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, gamba ng’okwogera nga omwana omuto, ebikolwa, okumwenya, n’ebirala.” Ngeri ki esinga okuba entuufu okukozesa okukebera embeera eno?
answer_a: Muwe abaana ffuluti ne kalirimba, mulinde era mulabe bwe bazikozesa.
answer_b: Leeta ebiseera ebitali bimu eri abaana, bikube era obireke babeere nabyo.
answer_c: Laga abaana ekintu ekireeta eddoboozi, oluvannyuma okibikke n'olugoye era obalindirire okukinoonya.
answer_d: Laga abaana ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo eby’ensolo ezifuyibwa mu maka basobole okukola ebivuga ebyazo.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekitongole eky’okutaano ayagala abayizi be okumanya, nga basinziira ku nteekateeka, ennyimba eziri mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo. Kiki ekikolwa ekisaanira abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino waggulu?
answer_a: Kola olukalala lw'ennyimba nga lwesigamiziddwa ku bubaka obuggyiddwa mu kubuuza.
answer_b: Noonya omutwe ogukwata ku nnyimba z'omu bibuga n'engeri gye zikolera ku bantu ba leero.
answer_c: Zzimba oba ovvuunule ennyimba ezimanyiddwa okuva mu lutalo lw'abavubuka olw'enjawulo olubakiikirira.
answer_d: Kola okunoonyereza ku baliraanwa bo era okuŋŋaanye amawulire agakwata ku ngeri z'ennyimba ezisinga okusiimwa mu kitundu kyammwe.

question: Ku mirimu gy’okukebera egikolebwa nga tebannazimba kifo we bagenda okuteeka ebintu byabwe, kiki ku bino wammanga ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okumanya omutindo gw’ebyo bye batuuseeko mu pulojekiti zaabwe?
answer_a: Basiima, nga bayita mu mboozi, obubonero bw’emirimu gyabwe, nga bannyonnyola olulimi olw’ebyobulabi olutegekeddwa.
answer_b: Bakebera emirimu gyabwe, nga balondoola engeri endowooza zaabwe, ebintu bye bakozesezza, n'olulimi olw'ebyobuwangwa bye baalonze bwe bikwatagana.
answer_c: Balaga ebintu ebikozesebwa mu by'obugubi eby'abakugu ab'omulembe guno era obigerageranye n'ebyo ebirondoolwa mu pulojekiti zaabwe.
answer_d: Bayiga ku pulojekiti z’okuteekawo ebintu ezikolebwa mu matendekero amalala era ne bazikenenula nga basinziira ku ndabika y’ennimi ezikozesebwa.

question: Mu mutima gw'emikwatagana egy'ekibalangulo n'okubala, omusomesa w'abaana abato akola omukolo gw'okuyiga ogw'engeri eno n'abaana: mu bibinja ebitono, abasaba okutwala emigogo ebiri egya pulasitiiki erimu omuwendo gwe gumu, okukola akapiira akanene n'ogumu n'obupiira obutono n'omulala. Oluvannyuma, abuuzza abaana: "Mulowooza wa weeri pulasitiiki ennyingi?". Nga tutunuulidde embeera eno, busobozi ki bw'okulowooza okw'ekibalangulo bwe bukuzibwa n'omukolo guno?
answer_a: Okubalilira
answer_b: Okukuuma obutonde bw’ensi
answer_c: Okuvunza
answer_d: Okukwatagana

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omukaaga akola omulimu ku mitendera esatu era ateekateeka omukolo omuli abayizi okukola emitendera esatu ena nga emipanvu gyayo gye gi: Omutendera ogusooka: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 11 cm. Omutendera ogw’okubiri: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 9 cm. Omutendera ogw’okusatu: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 7 cm. Omutendera ogw’okuna: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 5 cm. Oluvannyuma, babasaba okwetegereza bye bazimbye n’okubigeraageranya ne bannaabwe okukakasa nti buli omu alaba ekintu kye kimu. Kiki ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’omukolo ogwo ogugambiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Gerageranya empuyi ssatu okusinziira ku buwanvu bw’embiriizi zaazo n’obunene bw’enz угол zaazo.
answer_b: Teebereza ku mbeera ezibeera zeetaagisa okuzimba e misambaggu.
answer_c: Weewaawo ebyo by’olabye ku mukwano oguli wakati w’enjuyi n’empeto z’omus المثلث (triangle).
answer_d: Kika kya busatu nga twesigama ku buwanvu bw’embiriizi zaabwo nga tunnyonnyola emitindo gy’okukisaawula.

question: Omusomesa omwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya, amalirizza omutwe ogw'enamba entuufu n'abayizi be era ayagala okukebera oba basobola okukola ebibuuzo ebitalina bimala mu namba ez'omugerageranyo. Ku bikolwa ebikozesebwa okukebera bino wammanga, kiki ekinaasobozesa omusomesa okufuna amawulire agakwata ku kino?
answer_a: Mennya obuwanvu bw’empuyi essatu ezilingana nga buli lumu lulina obuwanvu bwa 2.
answer_b: Balirira namba ezitaliimu mutonnyeze okuva wansi n'okusiimattuka waggulu
answer_c: Londa mizizi gy’ebikwatule ku lukalo lw’ennamba, ng’onyonyola enkola ekakasa.
answer_d: Manya obuwanvu bw'amagulu g'omusalaba ogw'ekika ekya isosceles ogwa layiti ogulina oluweweeso olupima 2/sqrt(2)

question: Ttiimu y’eby’enjigiriza mu kibiina ky’abaana abato etegeketege okunyweza okusiima enjawulo okusinziira ku kiruubirirwa kino ekikulu mu kumanya obutonde bw’eby’embeera z’abantu n’ennono: “Okutegeera ebikulu ebyabaddewo mu byafaayo byabwe bo ku bwabwe n’eby’amaka gaabwe, mu mbeera ezitali zimu.” Mu nkola zino wammanga, y’erina engeri gy’ekwatagana n’ekiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Kukola ngabulo ku buli maka g'omwana, ng'oyanjula abantu baamu.
answer_b: Teekamu ebintu ebikozesebwa mu maka omuli ebikozesebwa mu kufumba n’ebintu omuterekebwa ebintu abaana bye bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo.
answer_c: Tegeka ebifo by'okukolera omulimu omwana gy'akiikirira ebintu eby'enjawulo by'akola n'ab'omu maka ge.
answer_d: Muteeketeeke akadde k'omukolo ogw'ekibiina omwana yenna lw'ayogera ku mulimu gw'omuntu omu mu famire yaabwe.

question: Okusinziira ku kigendererwa kino: "Soma pulaani ennyangu ez'ebitundu by'obulamu bwo, ng'okozesa ebifo eby'enjawulo n'ebika by'ebifo ebiraga obunene bwabyo," bikorwa ki ebisaana okukozesebwa okukekeera omwana mu mwaka ogw'okubiri?
answer_a: Loba ekiifananyi ekiraga enteekateeka y'ekisenge ky'eklassi.
answer_b: Tegeera amakulu g'obubonero obuli ku pulaani y'ekibuga
answer_c: Lambulula ebifo we bisangibwa ku maapu eno.
answer_d: Okakasa endagiriro z'obubonero obuweereddwa ku katimba.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana, ku nkomerero y’essomo, agenda kukebera obusobozi bw’abayizi be okusunsula ensibuko z’ebyamawulire, ng’asinziira ku bwesigwa bwazo. Okukola kino, ategeka akatabo akamuyamba era akoze n’ebipimo bino: 1. Balaga omuntu eyawandiise ebyo. 2. Bannyonnyola mu bufunze gye byaggyiddwa oba embeera ebyo we byaggyiddwa. Mu bipimo bino ebiri wammanga, ekirala kiki ekikwatagana n’ebyo era ekigya kuyamba okumaliriza akatabo kano?
answer_a: Balaga ekika ky'ensibuko y'ebyo bye bakozesezza.
answer_b: Bakaayana ku makulu g'ebyawandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Bategeera ekyo ekigendererwa ekiri mu nsibuko y'ebyo bye basoma.
answer_d: Bakebera obutuufu bw'ebyo ebiri mu ssaabu y'ebyanjuliziddwa.

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato atendeka abaana be ku kigendererwa kino: "Okugeraageranya engeri ebintu bya tekinologiya gye bikolebwamu, omugaso gwabyo, n'engeri gye bigasa mu ngeri ez'enjawulo." Okukola kino, omusomesa asooka n'aleeta ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'enjawulo, ng'abuuza abaana kye babimanyiiko nga tannaba kubannyonnyola mugaso gwabyo. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abasaba okunoonyereza, okwetegereza, n'okunnyonnyola ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'enjawulo ebikozesebwa awaka: amasimu, obusawo bw'enviiri, ebyuma by'okukaliza enviiri, essaawa, leediyo, mbooki, n'ebirala. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa agabanya abaana mu bibinja era n'abalagira okukungaanya ebintu bya tekinologiya, nga bajjukira bye baalabye. Ekimu ku bibinja kikungaanya ebintu mu ngeri etali ntegeerekeka. Bwe babuuziddwa, abalimu bagamba nti tebamanyi ngeri gye bakikolamu. Kukola ki omusomesa ky'asaanidde okukola okwongera okunyweza okuyiga mu kibiinja kino?
answer_a: Omusomesa ajja n’abalaga ensobi gye bakoze. Abaalaga engeri y’okugattamu ebintu n’annyonnyola lwaki kikolebwa bwe kityo, oluvannyuma n’abalagira okugenda mu maaso nga bagoberera ekyokulabirako.
answer_b: Omusomesa ababuuza: Mujjukira bye twalaba? Twayogera ku ki? Buli kimu ku bino kigendererwa ki? Kati, muyinza okubigattika mutya? Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde okubigattika n'abalondoola.
answer_c: Omusomesa ajja gyebali n’abagamba nti bakola bulungi, naye balina okwetegereza engeri ebintu gye bifaanana okusobola okubigattulula mu biti byabyo mu ngeri entuufu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde obulala okuddamu okugezaako.
answer_d: Omusomesa agamba nti baayogera ku mirimu gya buli kintu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa alaga nti ebimu bikozesebwa mu ffumbiro, ebirala mu kaabuyonjo, n'ebirala bya kukoleramu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde okubigattulula.

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okutaano, mu kitundu eky'Ebipimo by'ebintu eby'omulembe ogw'omulembe guno, ateesa eri abayizi okukola empaka ku by'okuggwaawo kw'ebintu mu bwangu n'enkolagana yakwo n'obugunjufu. Oluvannyuma lw'ebiva mu mpaka, akiraba nti ekibinja ky'abayizi kigatta endowooza y'okuggwaawo kw'ebintu mu bwangu n'omutindo gw'ebintu. Nga tuloowoza ku mutendera gw'abayizi, kwe kulaga okunnyonnyola kw'omusomesa okuyinza okuyamba okwolesa endowooza eno?
answer_a: Kwe kusalawo oba okuteekateeka enkomerero y’obulamu obugasa obw’ekintu oba tekinologiya, era tekikwatagana na mutindo gwakyo, nga bwe kiba nga waliwo ekintu ekisinga obukugu oba ekirina emirimu emipya kiyisiddwa ku katale.
answer_b: Kwe kusalawo, mu kiseera eky'okukola ebintu, omuntu okumanya ebbanga ekintu kyekinaamala, okukikakasa nti kizzibwa buggya ku nkomerero y'ekiseera ekyo. Kikwatagana n'omutindo ng'ekintu kitandise okubaako obuzibu n'okwonooneka oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera.
answer_c: Ggwe lwe kiseera ebalirirwa omukugu akola ebintu ng’akola ekintu, okukiggwaako omugaso n’okulekeraawo okukozesebwa, nga tekyonoonye mutindo gwakyo, nga bwe kiba nga waliwo ekintu ekirala ekisingako obulungi ekifulumiziddwa ku katale abantu ne bakikyusa n’ekyo kye balina.
answer_d: Kuba kusalawo okutuukirizibwa mu ngeri ezitali zimu, okugeza, olw’obutabaawo bw’ebitundutundu eby’ekiyungirizo oba obwetaavu bw’okugula ekintu ekipya ekijja mu kifo ky’ekyo, okukyuka kw’ebintu okwa bulijjo n’okwegomba kw’abantu okukyusa bye balina, nga tekikwatagana na mutindo gwabyo

question:
Omusomesa w'ekibiina ky'abali mu Siniya emu mu ssomero eggattule abagamba okukola omulimu oguyitibwa "Emprendemás." Mu mulimu guno, abayizi balina okutandikawo kkampuni ewaayo obuweereza okugonjoola obwetaavu bw'ekitundu ky'abantu ekimu. Abayizi bwe baleeta ebirowoozo byabwe nga bannyonnyola obwetaavu bwe bagenda okugonjoola n'obuweereza bwe bagenda okuwaayo, omusomesa akiraba nti ttiimu ezimu tezisobola kutegeera kitundu ky'abantu obuweereza bwe bugenda okutuukirira.
Kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okuteesa abayizi basobole okumanya ekitundu ky'abantu obuweereza bwe baagala okuwaayo kye bugenda okutuukirira?
answer_a: Saba abayizi okwekenneenya empisa z'abantu be baazuulamu obwetaavu, balyoke bategeere obubaka, oluvannyuma bakole maapu y'okutegeera okumanya kye baagala.
answer_b: Lagiriza ttiimu okulaba vidiyo eraga obuweereza obuweebwa abavuganyi era bategeere ekika ky'abantu be baweereza, oluvannyuma babigeregeranye n'abo abayinza okukozesa ebintu byabwe.
answer_c: Lagiriza ttiimu okunoonyereza ku bitundu by’abantu ebyo mpaka ze ziwa obuweereza obufaanana n’obwezo ze zitegeka, basobole okubyekenneenya era balondoolole enjawulo, nga bategeka omugaso gw’obuweereza bwe bawaayo.
answer_d: Saba abayizi bakole era baweereze ebibuuzo ku mikutu gy'enternet eri abantu ab'enjawulo nga bababuza oba bandikozesezza omulimu gwe balagira, era bakuŋŋaanye ebifaanaanyi okuva eri abo abazzeemu, gamba ng'emyaka, omusaala, omulimu, eggwanga, n'ekikula.

question: Ku mirimu gy'eby'obuwangwa egiddirira, kkirina ewa omwana omukisa omungi okukulaakulanya ekitone kye eky'obuyiiya?

answer_b: Okukozesa empapula ez’enjawulo okukola ebifaananyi nga ozizinga.
